## Reporting helpers

```{r step1-03-reporting-helpers, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

smart31_preview_table <- function(
    x,
    caption = "Diagnostic summary",
    max_rows = 12L,
    max_cols = 10L,
    digits = 3L) {

  if (inherits(x, "sf")) {
    x <- sf::st_drop_geometry(x)
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  total_rows <- nrow(x)
  total_cols <- ncol(x)

  shown_rows <- if (total_rows > max_rows) {
    seq_len(max_rows)
  } else {
    seq_len(total_rows)
  }

  shown_cols <- if (total_cols > max_cols) {
    seq_len(max_cols)
  } else {
    seq_len(total_cols)
  }

  preview <- x[shown_rows, shown_cols, drop = FALSE]

  display_caption <- paste0(
    caption,
    ". Displaying ", nrow(preview), " of ", total_rows, " rows and ",
    ncol(preview), " of ", total_cols, " columns; the complete object is retained."
  )

  smart31_kable(
    preview,
    format = if (knitr::is_html_output()) "html" else "pipe",
    digits = digits,
    row.names = FALSE,
    caption = display_caption,
    escape = TRUE
  )
}

smart31_print_full_table <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "sf")) {
    x <- sf::st_drop_geometry(x)
  }

  diagnostic_table <- tibble::as_tibble(x)
  print(diagnostic_table, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  invisible(diagnostic_table)
}
```

## Execution timing

```{r step1-04-chunk-4}

chunk_timing <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

chunk_timing$starts <- list()

chunk_timing$results <- data.frame(
  chunk = character(),
  elapsed_seconds = numeric(),
  user_seconds = numeric(),
  system_seconds = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::knit_hooks$set(
  time_it = function(before, options, envir) {

    chunk_label <- options$label

    if (before) {

      chunk_timing$starts[[chunk_label]] <- proc.time()

    } else {

      start_time <- chunk_timing$starts[[chunk_label]]
      end_time <- proc.time()

      if (!is.null(start_time)) {

        elapsed_time <- end_time - start_time

        chunk_timing$results <- rbind(
          chunk_timing$results,
          data.frame(
            chunk = chunk_label,
            elapsed_seconds = unname(elapsed_time[["elapsed"]]),
            user_seconds = unname(elapsed_time[["user.self"]]),
            system_seconds = unname(elapsed_time[["sys.self"]]),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
      }
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  time_it = TRUE
)
```

```{r step1-06-load-reference-data, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
reference_loader <- project_path(
  "R",
  "load_reference_data.R"
)

reference_data_dir <- .smart31_case$paths$reference_directory

if (!file.exists(reference_loader)) {
  stop(
    "Reference-data loader not found: ",
    reference_loader,
    ". Run this workflow from the SMART3.1 project root."
  )
}

if (!dir.exists(reference_data_dir)) {
  stop(
    "Reference-data directory not found: ",
    reference_data_dir,
    ". Update or clone the complete SMART3.1 repository."
  )
}

sys.source(
  reference_loader,
  envir = knitr::knit_global()
)

if (!exists("load_reference_data", mode = "function")) {
  stop(
    "The file ",
    reference_loader,
    " did not create load_reference_data()."
  )
}

reference_data <- load_reference_data(
  data_dir = reference_data_dir,
  strict = TRUE
)

required_reference_objects <- c(
  "species_prices",
  "species_price_monthly_mean",
  "fao_species",
  "fleet_register",
  "species_depth_ranges",
  "lpue_thresholds",
  "fuel_consumption_parameters",
  "economic_reference",
  "nisea_reference",
  "harbours"
)

missing_reference_objects <- setdiff(
  required_reference_objects,
  names(reference_data)
)

if (length(missing_reference_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing reference datasets: ",
    paste(missing_reference_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

prices <- reference_data$species_prices
agg_price <- reference_data$species_price_monthly_mean
fao3 <- reference_data$fao_species
ranges <- reference_data$species_depth_ranges
Species_LPUE_thrs <- reference_data$lpue_thresholds
sala_params <- reference_data$fuel_consumption_parameters
EcoRef <- reference_data$economic_reference
mNISEA <- reference_data$nisea_reference

fleet_register <- reference_data$fleet_register %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    loa = as.numeric(.data$loa)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$CFR),
    nzchar(.data$CFR)
  )

Harbs <- reference_data$harbours %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    PORT = toupper(trimws(as.character(harbour_name))),
    LON = as.numeric(longitude),
    LAT = as.numeric(latitude)
  )

if (anyDuplicated(fleet_register$CFR)) {
  stop("The fleet register contains duplicated CFR values.")
}

if (
  anyNA(fleet_register$loa) ||
  any(!is.finite(fleet_register$loa)) ||
  any(fleet_register$loa <= 0)
) {
  stop("The fleet register contains missing or invalid LOA values.")
}

if (
  anyNA(Harbs$PORT) ||
  anyNA(Harbs$LON) ||
  anyNA(Harbs$LAT)
) {
  stop("The harbour reference contains missing names or coordinates.")
}

cat(
  "SMART3.1 reference data loaded successfully:\n",
  "  vessels: ", format(nrow(fleet_register), big.mark = ","), "\n",
  "  harbours: ", format(nrow(Harbs), big.mark = ","), "\n",
  "  species price records: ",
  format(nrow(agg_price), big.mark = ","), "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Checkpoint utilities

```{r step1-10-checkpoint-utilities, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

object_hash <- function(x) {
  temporary_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
  on.exit(unlink(temporary_file), add = TRUE)

  saveRDS(
    x,
    temporary_file,
    version = 3,
    compress = FALSE
  )

  unname(tools::md5sum(temporary_file))
}

file_fingerprint <- function(paths) {
  paths <- sort(unique(normalizePath(
    paths,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )))

  file_information <- file.info(paths)

  data.frame(
    path = paths,
    size_bytes = as.numeric(file_information$size),
    modified_utc = format(
      file_information$mtime,
      tz = "UTC",
      usetz = TRUE
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_configuration <- list(
  case_fingerprint=smart31_case_fingerprint(.smart31_case),
  workflow_fingerprint=smart31_code_fingerprint(),
  checkpoint_schema_version = checkpoint_schema_version,
  years = sort(as.integer(years_to_submit)),
  species = sort(as.character(species_to_submit)),
  gears = sort(as.character(gears_to_submit)),
  gsas = sort(as.character(CS_gsas)),
  spatial_resolution_km = as.numeric(spatial_resolution_km),
  case_study_crs = as.integer(CS_crs),
  maximum_depth_m = as.numeric(thr_depth),
  annual_effort_quantile = as.numeric(quantile_Effort),
  fleet_effort_quantile = as.numeric(quantile_effort_fleet),
  run_age_module = isTRUE(run_age_module)
)

run_configuration_hash <- object_hash(run_configuration)
run_id <- substr(run_configuration_hash, 1L, 12L)

checkpoint_dir <- file.path(
  checkpoint_root,
  paste0("step1_", run_id)
)

dir.create(
  checkpoint_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

checkpoint_path <- function(stage) {
  file.path(
    checkpoint_dir,
    paste0(stage, ".rds")
  )
}

save_checkpoint <- function(stage, objects, context = NULL, compress = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(names(objects)) || any(!nzchar(names(objects)))) {
    stop("Checkpoint objects must be supplied as a fully named list.")
  }

  checkpoint <- list(
    metadata = list(
      stage = stage,
      created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      run_configuration = run_configuration,
      run_configuration_hash = run_configuration_hash,
      context_hash = object_hash(context),
      object_names = names(objects),
      r_version = R.version.string
    ),
    objects = objects
  )

  output_file <- checkpoint_path(stage)
  temporary_file <- paste0(output_file, ".tmp")

  saveRDS(
    checkpoint,
    temporary_file,
    version = 3,
    compress = compress
  )

  if (!file.rename(temporary_file, output_file)) {
    unlink(temporary_file)
    stop("Unable to finalize checkpoint: ", output_file)
  }

  message("Checkpoint saved: ", output_file)
  invisible(output_file)
}

load_checkpoint <- function(stage, required_objects, context = NULL) {
  if (!isTRUE(reuse_checkpoints)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  input_file <- checkpoint_path(stage)

  if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  checkpoint <- tryCatch(
    readRDS(input_file),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  valid_checkpoint <-
    is.list(checkpoint) &&
    is.list(checkpoint$metadata) &&
    is.list(checkpoint$objects) &&
    identical(
      checkpoint$metadata$run_configuration_hash,
      run_configuration_hash
    ) &&
    identical(
      checkpoint$metadata$context_hash,
      object_hash(context)
    ) &&
    all(required_objects %in% names(checkpoint$objects))

  if (!valid_checkpoint) {
    warning(
      "Checkpoint ", stage,
      " is incompatible with the current inputs and will be rebuilt."
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  message("Checkpoint reused: ", input_file)
  checkpoint$objects
}

restore_checkpoint <- function(objects, envir = knitr::knit_global()) {
  list2env(objects, envir = envir)
  invisible(names(objects))
}

cat(
  "Checkpoint directory: ",
  normalizePath(checkpoint_dir),
  "\nRun identifier: ",
  run_id,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Generate the spatial grid

```{r step1-12-gen-the-grid, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

gsa_source_files <- list.files(
  dirname(.smart31_case$paths$gsa_file),
  pattern = "^gfcm_gsa\\.",
  full.names = TRUE
)

spatial_context <- list(
  gsa_files = file_fingerprint(gsa_source_files),
  bathymetry_file = file_fingerprint(
    .smart31_case$paths$bathymetry_file
  ),
  grid_function = file_fingerprint(
    file.path("R", "genGrid.R")
  )
)

spatial_checkpoint <- load_checkpoint(
  stage = "01_spatial_setup",
  required_objects = c(
    "CS",
    "CS_buffer",
    "grid_sf",
    "map_xlim",
    "map_ylim"
  ),
  context = spatial_context
)

if (!is.null(spatial_checkpoint)) {
  restore_checkpoint(spatial_checkpoint)
  rm(spatial_checkpoint)
} else {
  CS <- GSA[GSA$SECT_COD %in% CS_gsas, ]
  CS <- sf::st_make_valid(CS)

  CS_buffer <- CS |>
    sf::st_transform(3035) |>
    sf::st_union() |>
    sf::st_buffer(dist = 1000) |>
    sf::st_as_sf() |>
    sf::st_transform(4326)

  grid_sf <- genGrid(
    cellsizekm = spatial_resolution_km,
    CS_buffer = CS_buffer,
    crs = 4326,
    bathy = bathy,
    thr_depth = thr_depth,
    grid_crs = 3035,
    bathy_crs = 4326
  )

  map_xlim <- sf::st_bbox(grid_sf$grid_sf)[c("xmin", "xmax")]
  map_ylim <- sf::st_bbox(grid_sf$grid_sf)[c("ymin", "ymax")]

  save_checkpoint(
    stage = "01_spatial_setup",
    objects = list(
      CS = CS,
      CS_buffer = CS_buffer,
      grid_sf = grid_sf,
      map_xlim = map_xlim,
      map_ylim = map_ylim
    ),
    context = spatial_context,
    compress = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r step1-16-effort-processing, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height= 8, fig.width=10}
    "Missing annual effort files: ",
    paste(missing_effort_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

effort_source_fingerprint <- file_fingerprint(effort_input_files)

utc_fishing_day_parser_version <- "2026-09-05.3"

fleet_checkpoint_context <- list(
  effort_sources = effort_source_fingerprint,
  spatial_context_hash = object_hash(spatial_context),

  fleet_register = file_fingerprint(
    file.path("data", "reference", "fleet_register.rds")
  ),
  harbour_reference = file_fingerprint(
    file.path("data", "reference", "harbours.gpkg")
  ),
  prepare_effort_function = file_fingerprint(
    file.path("R", "prepareEffort.R")
  )
)

fleet_checkpoint_cached <- load_checkpoint(
  stage = "03_fleet_selection",
  required_objects = c(
    "effort_clean",
    "annual_trips",
    "final_fleet",
    "observed_fishing_days",
    "historical_harbour_reference",
    "harbs_df",
    "harbs_df_sf",
    "cfr_by_h",
    "fishing_capacity",
    "selected_cfr"
  ),
  context = fleet_checkpoint_context
)

if (is.null(fleet_checkpoint_cached)) {
analysis_grid <- if (inherits(grid_sf, "sf")) {
  grid_sf
} else {
  grid_sf$grid_sf
}

stopifnot(
  inherits(analysis_grid, "sf"),
  !is.na(sf::st_crs(analysis_grid))
)

effort_sf_list <- vector("list", length(years_to_submit))
harbour_list <- vector("list", length(years_to_submit))
observed_fishing_day_list <- vector("list", length(years_to_submit))

parse_utc_fishing_date <- function(x, label) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) {
    parsed_date <- x
    parser_source <- "R Date"
  } else if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
    parsed_date <- as.Date(x, tz = "UTC")
    parser_source <- "R POSIXt converted in UTC"
  } else if (is.numeric(x)) {
    numeric_time <- as.numeric(x)

    if (any(!is.finite(numeric_time))) {
      stop(
        sum(!is.finite(numeric_time)), " ", label,
        " values are not finite.", call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    median_time <- stats::median(abs(numeric_time))

    if (median_time < 1e6) {
      parsed_date <- as.Date(numeric_time, origin = "1970-01-01")
      parser_source <- "VMSbase decimal days since 1970-01-01"
    } else if (median_time < 1e11) {
      parsed_date <- as.Date(
        as.POSIXct(numeric_time, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        tz = "UTC"
      )
      parser_source <- "Unix seconds since 1970-01-01"
    } else {
      parsed_date <- as.Date(
        as.POSIXct(numeric_time / 1000, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
        tz = "UTC"
      )
      parser_source <- "Unix milliseconds since 1970-01-01"
    }
  } else {
    text_value <- trimws(as.character(x))
    parsed_time <- suppressWarnings(as.POSIXct(
      text_value,
      tz = "UTC",
      tryFormats = c(
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%OS",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS", "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%OS",
        "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d/%m/%Y"
      )
    ))
    parsed_date <- as.Date(parsed_time, tz = "UTC")
    parser_source <- "formatted character timestamp"
  }

  parsed_day_number <- as.numeric(parsed_date)
  near_midnight <- is.finite(parsed_day_number) &
    abs(parsed_day_number - round(parsed_day_number)) <= 1e-7
  parsed_day_number[near_midnight] <- round(parsed_day_number[near_midnight])
  parsed_date <- as.Date(floor(parsed_day_number), origin = "1970-01-01")

  invalid <- is.na(parsed_date) | !is.finite(as.numeric(parsed_date))
  if (any(invalid)) {
    examples <- unique(as.character(x[invalid]))
    stop(
      sum(invalid), " ", label,
      " values cannot be converted to UTC dates. Examples: ",
      paste(utils::head(examples, 10L), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  attr(parsed_date, "SMART31_UTC_parser_source") <- parser_source
  parsed_date
}

effort_stats <- data.frame(
  year = years_to_submit,
  npoints = numeric(length(years_to_submit))
)

required_effort_columns <- c(
  "Metier", "MONTH", "YEAR", "CFR", "GSA",
  "LON", "LAT", "TRACK", "HARBOUR", "UTC", "fishing_time"
)

for (y in seq_along(years_to_submit)) {

  current_year <- years_to_submit[y]

  effort_file <- sprintf(.smart31_case$paths$effort_pattern, current_year)

  annual_context <- list(
    effort_source = file_fingerprint(effort_file),
    spatial_context_hash = object_hash(spatial_context),
    utc_fishing_day_parser_version = utc_fishing_day_parser_version,
    prepare_effort_function = file_fingerprint(
      file.path("R", "prepareEffort.R")
    )
  )

  annual_checkpoint <- load_checkpoint(
    stage = sprintf("02_effort_prepared_%d", current_year),
    required_objects = c(
      "effort_sf",
      "harbour_year",
      "observed_fishing_days_year",
      "npoints"
    ),
    context = annual_context
  )

  if (!is.null(annual_checkpoint)) {
    effort_sf_list[[y]] <- annual_checkpoint$effort_sf
    harbour_list[[y]] <- annual_checkpoint$harbour_year
    observed_fishing_day_list[[y]] <-
      annual_checkpoint$observed_fishing_days_year
    effort_stats$npoints[y] <- annual_checkpoint$npoints

    cat(
      "\nReused prepared effort for ", current_year, ": ",
      format(annual_checkpoint$npoints, big.mark = ","),
      " records\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    rm(annual_checkpoint)
    next
  }

  cat(
    "\nProcessing", current_year,
    "-", round(file.info(effort_file)$size / 1024^2, 1), "MB\n"
  )

  effort <- readRDS(effort_file)
  data.table::setDT(effort)

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_effort_columns,
    names(effort)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in ", current_year, ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  effort[, Gear := sub(
    "_.*$",
    "",
    substr(as.character(Metier), 1L, 3L)
  )]

  keep_gear <- !is.na(effort$Gear) &
    effort$Gear %in% gears_to_submit

  keep_gsa <- !is.na(effort$GSA) &
    effort$GSA %in% CS_gsas

  harbour_year <- unique(
    effort[
      keep_gear &
        keep_gsa &
        !is.na(HARBOUR) &
        nzchar(trimws(as.character(HARBOUR))),
      .(
        CFR = as.character(CFR),
        HARBOUR = toupper(trimws(as.character(HARBOUR)))
      )
    ]
  )

  harbour_list[[y]] <- harbour_year

  effort_input <- effort[
    keep_gear &
      keep_gsa &
      !is.na(CFR) &
      !is.na(fishing_time) &
      fishing_time > 0,
    .(
      Metier,
      MONTH,
      YEAR,
      CFR,
      GSA,
      LON,
      LAT,
      TRACK,
      UTC,
      fishing_time
    )
  ]

  parsed_effort_dates <- parse_utc_fishing_date(
    effort_input$UTC,
    paste0(current_year, " effort$UTC")
  )

  cat(
    "  UTC interpretation: ",
    attr(parsed_effort_dates, "SMART31_UTC_parser_source"),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  effort_date_map <- unique(data.table::data.table(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(effort_input$CFR)),
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(effort_input$YEAR))),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(effort_input$MONTH),
    TRACK = trimws(as.character(effort_input$TRACK)),
    fishing_date = parsed_effort_dates
  ))

  date_year <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(format(
    effort_date_map$fishing_date, "%Y"
  )))
  date_month <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(format(
    effort_date_map$fishing_date, "%m"
  )))
  inconsistent_calendar <-
    is.na(effort_date_map$YEAR) |
    is.na(effort_date_map$MONTH) |
    effort_date_map$YEAR != date_year |
    effort_date_map$MONTH != date_month

  if (any(inconsistent_calendar)) {
    stop(
      sum(inconsistent_calendar),
      " unique fishing track-date records in ", current_year,
      " have YEAR or MONTH inconsistent with UTC. Values were not ",
      "reassigned.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  effort_input[, UTC := NULL]

  rm(effort, keep_gear, keep_gsa)
  invisible(gc())

  cat(
    "  retained fishing records:",
    format(nrow(effort_input), big.mark = ","), "\n"
  )

  effort_sf <- prepareEffort(
    effort = effort_input,
    grid_sf = analysis_grid,
    CS_gsas = CS_gsas,
    gears_to_submit = gears_to_submit
  )

  rm(effort_input)
  invisible(gc())

  effort_by_cfr <- tapply(
    effort_sf$fishing_time,
    effort_sf$CFR,
    sum,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  effort_threshold <- quantile(
    effort_by_cfr,
    probs = quantile_Effort,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  retained_cfr <- names(effort_by_cfr)[
    effort_by_cfr >= effort_threshold
  ]

  effort_sf <- effort_sf[
    effort_sf$CFR %in% retained_cfr,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  retained_track_keys <- unique(data.table::data.table(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(effort_sf$CFR)),
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(effort_sf$YEAR))),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(effort_sf$MONTH),
    TRACK = trimws(as.character(effort_sf$TRACK))
  ))

  retained_date_map <- merge(
    effort_date_map,
    retained_track_keys,
    by = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "TRACK"),
    all = FALSE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  missing_retained_track_dates <- retained_track_keys[
    !effort_date_map,
    on = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "TRACK")
  ]

  if (nrow(missing_retained_track_dates) > 0L) {
    stop(
      nrow(missing_retained_track_dates),
      " retained fishing tracks in ", current_year,
      " have no UTC-date mapping. Days were not inferred from trips.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  observed_fishing_days_year <- unique(retained_date_map[
    ,
    .(CFR, YEAR, MONTH, fishing_date)
  ])[
    ,
    .(observed_fishing_days = .N),
    by = .(CFR, YEAR, MONTH)
  ]

  if (nrow(observed_fishing_days_year) == 0L ||
      any(observed_fishing_days_year$observed_fishing_days <= 0L)) {
    stop(
      "No positive UTC-derived fishing-day count was produced for ",
      current_year, ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  effort_sf <- effort_sf %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
      YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR))),
      MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
      Gear = as.character(.data$Gear),
      Metier = as.character(.data$Metier),
      TRACK = trimws(as.character(.data$TRACK)),
      fishing_time = as.numeric(.data$fishing_time)
    )

  invalid_prepared_calendar <-
    is.na(effort_sf$YEAR) |
    !effort_sf$YEAR %in% years_to_submit |
    is.na(effort_sf$MONTH) |
    !effort_sf$MONTH %in% 1:12

  if (any(invalid_prepared_calendar)) {
    stop(
      sum(invalid_prepared_calendar),
      " prepared effort records contain invalid YEAR or MONTH after ",
      "factor-safe normalisation.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  effort_sf <- effort_sf[
    ,
    c(
      "CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear",
      "Metier", "TRACK", "fishing_time"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  effort_sf_list[[y]] <- effort_sf
  observed_fishing_day_list[[y]] <- observed_fishing_days_year
  effort_stats$npoints[y] <- nrow(effort_sf)

  save_checkpoint(
    stage = sprintf("02_effort_prepared_%d", current_year),
    objects = list(
      effort_sf = effort_sf,
      harbour_year = harbour_year,
      observed_fishing_days_year = observed_fishing_days_year,
      npoints = nrow(effort_sf)
    ),
    context = annual_context,
    compress = FALSE
  )

  cat(
    "  final records:",
    format(nrow(effort_sf), big.mark = ","),
    "- object size:",
    format(object.size(effort_sf), units = "auto"),
    "\n"
  )

  rm(
    effort_sf,
    effort_by_cfr,
    retained_cfr,
    harbour_year,
    observed_fishing_days_year,
    parsed_effort_dates,
    effort_date_map,
    retained_track_keys,
    retained_date_map,
    missing_retained_track_dates,
    date_year,
    date_month,
    inconsistent_calendar,
    invalid_prepared_calendar
  )
  invisible(gc())
}

cfr_harbs_df <- as.data.frame(
```

```{r step1-17-define-the-fleet, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
  )

cfr_by_h <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::distinct(CFR, HARBOUR) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    HARBOUR,
    name = "nvessel"
  )

valid_harbours_vessels <- cfr_by_h %>%
  dplyr::filter(nvessel >= 3L) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HARBOUR)

excluded_harbours_vessels <- cfr_by_h %>%
  dplyr::filter(nvessel < 3L)

if (nrow(excluded_harbours_vessels) > 0L) {
  cat(
    "Harbours excluded because they have fewer than three vessels:",
    paste(excluded_harbours_vessels$HARBOUR, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )
}

final_fleet <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    HARBOUR %in% valid_harbours_vessels
  )

if (nrow(final_fleet) == 0L) {
  stop("The harbour filters removed all vessels.")
}

cfr_by_h <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::distinct(CFR, HARBOUR) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    HARBOUR,
    name = "nvessel"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(nvessel)

harbour_levels <- cfr_by_h$HARBOUR

cfr_by_h <- cfr_by_h %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HARBOUR = factor(
      HARBOUR,
      levels = harbour_levels
    )
  )

selected_cfr <- unique(final_fleet$CFR)

effort_clean <- effort_clean[
  as.character(effort_clean$CFR) %in% selected_cfr,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

effort_dt <- effort_dt[
  CFR %in% selected_cfr
]

cat(
  "Final selected fleet:",
  length(selected_cfr),
  "vessels\n"
)

cat(
  "Retained effort records:",
  format(nrow(effort_clean), big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)

if (!all(c("CFR", "loa") %in% names(fleet_register))) {
  stop("fleet_register must contain the columns CFR and loa.")
}

fleet_register_join <- fleet_register %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = as.character(CFR),
    loa = as.numeric(loa)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(CFR),
    nzchar(CFR)
  )

conflicting_loa <- fleet_register_join %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(loa)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(CFR, loa) %>%
  dplyr::count(CFR, name = "n_loa") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_loa > 1L)

if (nrow(conflicting_loa) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "fleet_register contains multiple LOA values for ",
    nrow(conflicting_loa),
    " CFR."
  )
}

fleet_register_join <- fleet_register_join %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CFR) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    loa = {
      available_loa <- loa[!is.na(loa)]

      if (length(available_loa) == 0L) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        available_loa[1L]
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

final_fleet <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CFR = as.character(CFR)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fleet_register_join,
    by = "CFR"
  )

missing_loa_cfr <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(loa)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(CFR)

if (nrow(missing_loa_cfr) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing LOA for ",
    nrow(missing_loa_cfr),
    " selected vessels. Examples: ",
    paste(
      utils::head(missing_loa_cfr$CFR, 10L),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

harbs_df <- harbs_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    HARBOUR %in% final_fleet$HARBOUR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    HARBOUR,
    Lon,
    Lat
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cfr_by_h %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        HARBOUR = as.character(HARBOUR)
      ),
    by = "HARBOUR"
  )

if (anyDuplicated(harbs_df$HARBOUR)) {
  warning(
    "Some harbours are associated with multiple coordinate pairs."
  )
}

harbs_df_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
  harbs_df,
  coords = c("Lon", "Lat"),
  crs = CS_crs,
  remove = FALSE
)

fs_levels <- c(
  "VL0006",
  "VL0612",
  "VL1215",
  "VL1518",
  "VL1824",
  "VL2440",
  "VL40XX"
)

final_fleet_detail <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FS = cut(
      loa,
      breaks = c(
        0, 6, 12, 15, 18, 24, 40, Inf
      ),
      labels = fs_levels,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    FS = factor(
      FS,
      levels = fs_levels
    )
  )

if (anyNA(final_fleet_detail$FS)) {
  invalid_fs <- final_fleet_detail %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(FS)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(CFR, loa)

  stop(
    "Some vessels could not be assigned to a length class. CFR: ",
    paste(
      utils::head(invalid_fs$CFR, 10L),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

fishing_capacity <- final_fleet_detail %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    CFR,
    HARBOUR,
    GEAR,
    FS
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    HARBOUR,
    GEAR,
    FS,
    name = "n"
  )

final_fleet <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    HARBOUR,
    CFR,
    GEAR,
    MONTH
  )

annual_trips <- annual_trips %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CFR %in% final_fleet$CFR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    CFR,
    YEAR,
    MONTH,
    Gear
  )

canonical_harbour_lookup <- final_fleet %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    HARBOUR = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$HARBOUR)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

if (anyDuplicated(canonical_harbour_lookup$CFR)) {
  stop(
    "The canonical fleet contains more than one harbour for a CFR.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

historical_harbour_reference <- annual_trips %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR))),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    canonical_harbour_lookup,
    by = "CFR",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    harbour_reference_source = "canonical_vessel_harbour"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH)

if (anyNA(historical_harbour_reference$HARBOUR) ||
    anyDuplicated(
      historical_harbour_reference[c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH")]
    )) {
  stop(
    "The canonical historical-harbour lookup is incomplete or duplicated.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

observed_fishing_days <- observed_fishing_days %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR))),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
    observed_fishing_days = as.numeric(.data$observed_fishing_days)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% final_fleet$CFR) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH)

days_in_calendar_month <- function(year, month) {
  first_day <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month))
  next_year <- ifelse(month == 12L, year + 1L, year)
  next_month <- ifelse(month == 12L, 1L, month + 1L)
  first_next_month <- as.Date(sprintf(
    "%04d-%02d-01", next_year, next_month
  ))
  as.integer(first_next_month - first_day)
}

observed_fishing_days <- observed_fishing_days %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    calendar_days_in_month = days_in_calendar_month(
      .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH
    )
  )

invalid_observed_fishing_days <- observed_fishing_days %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.finite(.data$observed_fishing_days) |
      .data$observed_fishing_days <= 0 |
      .data$observed_fishing_days > .data$calendar_days_in_month
  )

if (nrow(invalid_observed_fishing_days) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(invalid_observed_fishing_days),
    " vessel-year-month UTC fishing-day counts are outside the calendar ",
    "range. Inspect 'invalid_observed_fishing_days'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

missing_observed_fishing_days <- annual_trips %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR))),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    observed_fishing_days,
    by = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH")
  )

if (nrow(missing_observed_fishing_days) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(missing_observed_fishing_days),
    " vessel-year-month trip strata lack a UTC-derived fishing-day count. ",
    "Days were not inferred from trip counts.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

cat(
  "\nFinal objects:\n",
  "  annual_trips:", format(nrow(annual_trips), big.mark = ","), "rows\n",
  "  final_fleet:", format(nrow(final_fleet), big.mark = ","), "rows\n",
  "  selected vessels:", dplyr::n_distinct(final_fleet$CFR), "\n",
  "  selected harbours:", dplyr::n_distinct(final_fleet$HARBOUR), "\n",
  "  effort_clean:", format(nrow(effort_clean), big.mark = ","), "rows\n",
  "  fishing_capacity:", format(nrow(fishing_capacity), big.mark = ","), "rows\n",
  sep = ""
)

stopifnot(
  !inherits(annual_trips, "sf"),
  !anyNA(final_fleet$loa),
  all(final_fleet$ntrip >= 1L),
  all(final_fleet$CFR %in% annual_trips$CFR),
  all(final_fleet$HARBOUR %in% harbs_df$HARBOUR)
)

save_checkpoint(
  stage = "03_fleet_selection",
  objects = list(
    effort_clean = effort_clean,
    annual_trips = annual_trips,
    final_fleet = final_fleet,
    observed_fishing_days = observed_fishing_days,
    historical_harbour_reference = historical_harbour_reference,
    harbs_df = harbs_df,
    harbs_df_sf = harbs_df_sf,
    cfr_by_h = cfr_by_h,
    fishing_capacity = fishing_capacity,
    selected_cfr = selected_cfr
  ),
  context = fleet_checkpoint_context,
  compress = FALSE
)

}

invisible(gc())
```

## Effort gridding

```{r step1-20-effort-gridding, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

chunk_size <- 50000L

gridding_root <- file.path(
  checkpoint_dir,
  "04_effort_gridded_chunks"
)

stopifnot(
  inherits(effort_clean, "sf"),
  is.list(grid_sf),
  "grid_sf" %in% names(grid_sf),
  inherits(grid_sf$grid_sf, "sf"),
  nrow(effort_clean) > 0L,
  nrow(grid_sf$grid_sf) > 0L
)

if (!exists("griddingEffort", mode = "function")) {
  stop("griddingEffort() is not available.")
}

geometry_column <- attr(
  effort_clean,
  "sf_column"
)

if (
  is.null(geometry_column) ||
  !geometry_column %in% names(effort_clean)
) {
  stop("The active sf geometry column could not be identified.")
}

required_effort_columns <- c(
  "CFR",
  "YEAR",
  "MONTH",
  "Gear",
  "Metier",
  "TRACK",
  "fishing_time",
  geometry_column
)

missing_effort_columns <- setdiff(
  required_effort_columns,
  names(effort_clean)
)

if (length(missing_effort_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in effort_clean: ",
    paste(missing_effort_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!"CFR" %in% names(final_fleet)) {
  stop("final_fleet does not contain CFR.")
}

grid_polygons <- grid_sf$grid_sf

if (!"id_grid" %in% names(grid_polygons)) {
  stop("grid_sf$grid_sf does not contain id_grid.")
}

if (is.na(sf::st_crs(effort_clean))) {
  stop("effort_clean has no defined CRS.")
}

if (is.na(sf::st_crs(grid_polygons))) {
  stop("grid_sf$grid_sf has no defined CRS.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(as.character(grid_polygons$id_grid))) {
  stop("grid_sf$grid_sf contains duplicated id_grid values.")
}

if (any(sf::st_is_empty(grid_polygons))) {
  stop("The grid contains empty geometries.")
}

years_to_submit <- sort(
  unique(
    suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(as.character(years_to_submit))
    )
  )
)

if (length(years_to_submit) == 0L || anyNA(years_to_submit)) {
  stop("years_to_submit contains invalid values.")
}

selected_cfr <- unique(
  trimws(as.character(final_fleet$CFR))
)

selected_cfr <- selected_cfr[
  !is.na(selected_cfr) &
    nzchar(selected_cfr)
]

if (length(selected_cfr) == 0L) {
  stop("final_fleet does not contain valid CFR values.")
}

gridding_context <- list(
  fleet_context_hash = object_hash(fleet_checkpoint_context),
  spatial_context_hash = object_hash(spatial_context),
  gridding_function = file_fingerprint(
    file.path("R", "griddingEffort.R")
  ),
  selected_cfr = sort(selected_cfr),
  chunk_size = chunk_size
)

gridding_run_id <- substr(
  object_hash(gridding_context),
  1L,
  12L
)

output_dir <- file.path(
  gridding_root,
  gridding_run_id
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

gridding_manifest_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "gridding_manifest.rds"
)

if (file.exists(gridding_manifest_file)) {
  gridding_manifest <- readRDS(gridding_manifest_file)

  if (!identical(
    gridding_manifest$context_hash,
    object_hash(gridding_context)
  )) {
    stop(
      "The gridding output directory contains an incompatible manifest: ",
      output_dir
    )
  }
} else {
  gridding_manifest <- list(
    created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
    run_configuration_hash = run_configuration_hash,
    context_hash = object_hash(gridding_context),
    context = gridding_context
  )

  temporary_manifest <- paste0(gridding_manifest_file, ".tmp")
  saveRDS(gridding_manifest, temporary_manifest, version = 3)

  if (!file.rename(temporary_manifest, gridding_manifest_file)) {
    unlink(temporary_manifest)
    stop("Unable to finalize the gridding manifest.")
  }
}

message("Gridding output directory: ", normalizePath(output_dir))

effort_year <- suppressWarnings(
  as.integer(as.character(effort_clean$YEAR))
)

effort_cfr <- trimws(
  as.character(effort_clean$CFR)
)

selected_records <- (
  !is.na(effort_cfr) &
    effort_cfr %in% selected_cfr &
    !is.na(effort_year) &
    effort_year %in% years_to_submit
)

if (!any(selected_records)) {
  stop("No effort records correspond to the selected fleet and years.")
}

annual_effort_coverage <- data.frame(
  YEAR = years_to_submit,
  n_records = vapply(
    years_to_submit,
    function(current_year) {
      sum(
        selected_records &
          effort_year == current_year
      )
    },
    integer(1)
  )
)

smart31_preview_table(annual_effort_coverage, "Annual coverage of selected fishing-effort records")

if (any(annual_effort_coverage$n_records == 0L)) {
  stop(
    "No records are available for: ",
    paste(
      annual_effort_coverage$YEAR[
        annual_effort_coverage$n_records == 0L
      ],
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

reference_count <- stats::median(
  annual_effort_coverage$n_records
)

unusually_low_years <- annual_effort_coverage$YEAR[
  annual_effort_coverage$n_records <
    0.10 * reference_count
]

if (length(unusually_low_years) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "Unusually low effort coverage for: ",
    paste(unusually_low_years, collapse = ", "),
    ". Check data completeness before using the results."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nGrid cells: ",
  format(nrow(grid_polygons), big.mark = ","),
  "\nSelected vessels: ",
  format(length(selected_cfr), big.mark = ","),
  "\nChunk size: ",
  format(chunk_size, big.mark = ","),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (sf::st_crs(effort_clean) != sf::st_crs(grid_polygons)) {
  message(
    "CRS differ: each chunk will be transformed separately. ",
    "The complete effort_clean object will not be transformed."
  )
}

processing_summary <- data.frame(
  YEAR = integer(),
  chunk = integer(),
  input_points = integer(),
  assigned_points = integer(),
  grid_cells_used = integer(),
  output_file = character(),
  status = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (current_year in years_to_submit) {

  year_indices <- which(
    selected_records &
      effort_year == current_year
  )

  n_year_records <- length(year_indices)

  n_chunks <- ceiling(
    n_year_records / chunk_size
  )

  message(
    "\nStarting ",
    current_year,
    ": ",
    format(n_year_records, big.mark = ","),
    " points in ",
    n_chunks,
    " chunks."
  )

  year_dir <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    as.character(current_year)
  )

  dir.create(
    year_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  for (chunk_number in seq_len(n_chunks)) {

    first_position <- (
      (chunk_number - 1L) * chunk_size
    ) + 1L

    last_position <- min(
      chunk_number * chunk_size,
      n_year_records
    )

    chunk_indices <- year_indices[
      first_position:last_position
    ]

    output_file <- file.path(
      year_dir,
      sprintf(
        "effort_gridded_%d_chunk_%04d.rds",
        current_year,
        chunk_number
      )
    )

    if (file.exists(output_file)) {

      message(
        "[",
        current_year,
        " | ",
        chunk_number,
        "/",
        n_chunks,
        "] already completed; skipping."
      )

      processing_summary <- rbind(
        processing_summary,
        data.frame(
          YEAR = current_year,
          chunk = chunk_number,
          input_points = length(chunk_indices),
          assigned_points = NA_integer_,
          grid_cells_used = NA_integer_,
          output_file = output_file,
          status = "existing",
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )

      next
    }

    message(
      "[",
      current_year,
      " | ",
      chunk_number,
      "/",
      n_chunks,
      "] points ",
      format(first_position, big.mark = ","),
      "–",
      format(last_position, big.mark = ",")
    )

    effort_chunk <- effort_clean[
      chunk_indices,
      required_effort_columns,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (sf::st_crs(effort_chunk) != sf::st_crs(grid_polygons)) {
      effort_chunk <- sf::st_transform(
        effort_chunk,
        sf::st_crs(grid_polygons)
      )
    }

    gridded_chunk <- tryCatch(
      griddingEffort(
        effort_chunk,
        grid_polygons
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        stop(
          "Gridding failed for ",
          current_year,
          ", chunk ",
          chunk_number,
          ": ",
          conditionMessage(e),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    )

    assigned_points <- nrow(gridded_chunk)

    grid_cells_used <- if (assigned_points > 0L) {
      length(unique(gridded_chunk$id_grid))
    } else {
      0L
    }

    temporary_file <- paste0(
      output_file,
      ".tmp"
    )

    saveRDS(
      gridded_chunk,
      temporary_file,
      compress = "gzip"
    )

    renamed <- file.rename(
      temporary_file,
      output_file
    )

    if (!renamed) {
      stop(
        "Unable to finalize output file: ",
        output_file
      )
    }

    processing_summary <- rbind(
      processing_summary,
      data.frame(
        YEAR = current_year,
        chunk = chunk_number,
        input_points = nrow(effort_chunk),
        assigned_points = assigned_points,
        grid_cells_used = grid_cells_used,
        output_file = output_file,
        status = "completed",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )

    message(
      "  Assigned points: ",
      format(assigned_points, big.mark = ","),
      "; occupied cells: ",
      format(grid_cells_used, big.mark = ",")
    )

    rm(
      effort_chunk,
      gridded_chunk,
      chunk_indices
    )

    invisible(gc())
  }

  rm(year_indices)
  invisible(gc())
}

summary_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "gridding_processing_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  processing_summary,
  summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

checkpoint_files <- list.files(
  checkpoint_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

checkpoint_information <- file.info(checkpoint_files)

checkpoint_inventory <- data.frame(
  file = substring(
    normalizePath(checkpoint_files, winslash = "/"),
    nchar(normalizePath(checkpoint_dir, winslash = "/")) + 2L
  ),
  size_mb = round(checkpoint_information$size / 1024^2, 2),
  modified_utc = format(
    checkpoint_information$mtime,
    tz = "UTC",
    usetz = TRUE
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

checkpoint_inventory_file <- file.path(
  checkpoint_dir,
  "checkpoint_inventory.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  checkpoint_inventory,
  checkpoint_inventory_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nChunked gridding completed.\n",
  "Output directory: ",
  normalizePath(output_dir),
  "\nSummary: ",
  normalizePath(summary_file),
  "\nCheckpoint inventory: ",
  normalizePath(checkpoint_inventory_file),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Aggregate effort using vessel LOA

```{r step1-21-add-loa-by-vessel-and-aggregate-the-effort, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

if (!exists("output_dir") || !dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  stop(
    "The gridding output directory is unavailable. ",
    "Run the 'effort gridding' chunk first."
  )
}

if (!all(c("CFR", "loa") %in% names(final_fleet))) {
  stop("final_fleet must contain CFR and loa.")
}

if (
  !is.numeric(quantile_Effort) ||
  length(quantile_Effort) != 1L ||
  is.na(quantile_Effort) ||
  quantile_Effort < 0 ||
  quantile_Effort >= 1
) {
  stop("quantile_Effort must be a single value between 0 and 1.")
}

fleet_lookup_raw <- data.frame(
  CFR = trimws(as.character(final_fleet$CFR)),
  loa = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(final_fleet$loa)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fleet_lookup_raw <- fleet_lookup_raw[
  !is.na(fleet_lookup_raw$CFR) &
    nzchar(fleet_lookup_raw$CFR),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (
  anyNA(fleet_lookup_raw$loa) ||
  any(!is.finite(fleet_lookup_raw$loa)) ||
  any(fleet_lookup_raw$loa <= 0)
) {
  stop("final_fleet contains missing or invalid LOA values.")
}

fleet_lookup_check <- fleet_lookup_raw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_records = dplyr::n(),
    n_distinct_loa = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$loa),
    loa_values = paste(
      sort(unique(.data$loa)),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conflicting_loa <- fleet_lookup_check %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$n_distinct_loa > 1L)

if (nrow(conflicting_loa) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Conflicting LOA values were found for ",
    nrow(conflicting_loa),
    " CFR value(s). Examples: ",
    paste(
      paste0(
        head(conflicting_loa$CFR, 10L),
        " [",
        head(conflicting_loa$loa_values, 10L),
        "]"
      ),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  )
}

fleet_lookup <- fleet_lookup_raw %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$CFR, .data$loa) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$CFR) %>%
  as.data.frame()

duplicated_consistent_cfr <- sum(
  fleet_lookup_check$n_records > 1L
)

message(
  "Fleet lookup prepared: ",
  format(nrow(fleet_lookup), big.mark = ","),
  " unique vessels; ",
  format(duplicated_consistent_cfr, big.mark = ","),
  " duplicated CFR values collapsed because their LOA was consistent."
)

rm(
  fleet_lookup_raw,
  fleet_lookup_check,
  conflicting_loa,
  duplicated_consistent_cfr
)

aggregation_context <- list(
  gridding_context_hash = object_hash(gridding_context),
  fleet_lookup_hash = object_hash(fleet_lookup),
  quantile_Effort = quantile_Effort
)

aggregation_run_id <- substr(
  object_hash(aggregation_context),
  1L,
  12L
)

aggregation_checkpoint_dir <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  paste0("aggregation_", aggregation_run_id)
)

dir.create(
  aggregation_checkpoint_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

effort_sf_gridded_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(years_to_submit)
)

effort_gridded_agg_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(years_to_submit)
)

names(effort_sf_gridded_list) <- as.character(years_to_submit)
names(effort_gridded_agg_list) <- as.character(years_to_submit)

for (y in seq_along(years_to_submit)) {

  current_year <- years_to_submit[y]

  annual_checkpoint_file <- file.path(
    aggregation_checkpoint_dir,
    sprintf(
      "effort_gridded_aggregated_%d.rds",
      current_year
    )
  )

  if (file.exists(annual_checkpoint_file)) {

    annual_result <- readRDS(
      annual_checkpoint_file
    )

    required_checkpoint_objects <- c(
      "effort_sf",
      "effort_agg_grid"
    )

    if (
      !is.list(annual_result) ||
      !all(
        required_checkpoint_objects %in%
          names(annual_result)
      ) ||
      !inherits(annual_result$effort_sf, "sf")
    ) {
      stop(
        "Invalid annual effort checkpoint: ",
        annual_checkpoint_file
      )
    }

    effort_sf_gridded_list[[y]] <-
      annual_result$effort_sf

    effort_gridded_agg_list[[y]] <-
      annual_result$effort_agg_grid

    message(
      "Loaded aggregated effort checkpoint for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )

    next
  }

  year_dir <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    as.character(current_year)
  )

  chunk_files <- list.files(
    year_dir,
    pattern = paste0(
      "^effort_gridded_",
      current_year,
      "_chunk_[0-9]{4}\\.rds$"
    ),
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  chunk_files <- sort(chunk_files)

  if (length(chunk_files) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No gridded effort chunks found for ",
      current_year,
      " in ",
      year_dir,
      ". Run the 'effort gridding' chunk first."
    )
  }

  annual_chunks <- lapply(
    chunk_files,
    readRDS
  )

  valid_sf_chunks <- vapply(
    annual_chunks,
    inherits,
    logical(1),
    what = "sf"
  )

  if (!all(valid_sf_chunks)) {
    stop(
      "One or more invalid gridding chunks were found for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  temp_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    annual_chunks
  )

  rm(annual_chunks)
  invisible(gc())

  cfr_index <- match(
    trimws(as.character(temp_df$CFR)),
    fleet_lookup$CFR
  )

  if (anyNA(cfr_index)) {

    missing_cfr <- unique(
      as.character(temp_df$CFR[is.na(cfr_index)])
    )

    stop(
      "Missing LOA for ",
      length(missing_cfr),
      " CFR value(s) in ",
      current_year,
      ": ",
      paste(head(missing_cfr, 10L), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  temp_df$loa <- fleet_lookup$loa[cfr_index]

  fishing_time <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(temp_df$fishing_time)
  )

  if (
    anyNA(fishing_time) ||
    any(!is.finite(fishing_time)) ||
    any(fishing_time < 0)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing or invalid fishing_time values in ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  temp_df$effort <- temp_df$loa * fishing_time

  effort_agg <- sf::st_drop_geometry(temp_df)[
    ,
    c(
      "CFR",
      "MONTH",
      "Gear",
      "id_grid",
      "effort"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  effort_agg <- stats::aggregate(
    effort ~ CFR + MONTH + Gear + id_grid,
    data = effort_agg,
    FUN = sum,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  effort_agg_grid <- stats::aggregate(
    effort ~ MONTH + Gear + id_grid,
    data = effort_agg,
    FUN = sum,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  effort_threshold <- stats::quantile(
    effort_agg_grid$effort,
    probs = quantile_Effort,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  effort_agg_grid <- effort_agg_grid[
    effort_agg_grid$effort > effort_threshold,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  effort_agg_grid$YEAR <- current_year

  effort_sf_gridded_list[[y]] <- temp_df
  effort_gridded_agg_list[[y]] <- effort_agg_grid

  annual_result <- list(
    metadata = list(
      YEAR = current_year,
      created_utc = format(
        Sys.time(),
        tz = "UTC",
        usetz = TRUE
      ),
      quantile_Effort = quantile_Effort,
      effort_threshold = effort_threshold,
      source_chunks = basename(chunk_files),
      n_gridded_records = nrow(temp_df),
      n_aggregated_records = nrow(effort_agg_grid)
    ),
    effort_sf = temp_df,
    effort_agg_grid = effort_agg_grid
  )

  temporary_checkpoint_file <- paste0(
    annual_checkpoint_file,
    ".tmp"
  )

  saveRDS(
    annual_result,
    temporary_checkpoint_file,
    compress = "gzip",
    version = 3
  )

  if (!file.rename(
    temporary_checkpoint_file,
    annual_checkpoint_file
  )) {
    unlink(temporary_checkpoint_file)

    stop(
      "Unable to finalize annual checkpoint: ",
      annual_checkpoint_file
    )
  }

  message(
    "Processed ",
    current_year,
    ": ",
    format(nrow(temp_df), big.mark = ","),
    " gridded records; ",
    format(nrow(effort_agg_grid), big.mark = ","),
    " aggregated records retained."
  )

  rm(
    annual_result,
    effort_agg,
    effort_agg_grid,
    temp_df,
    cfr_index,
    fishing_time
  )

  invisible(gc())
}

effort_gridded_all <- data.table::rbindlist(
  effort_gridded_agg_list,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

if (nrow(effort_gridded_all) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No gridded effort records remain after applying quantile_Effort = ",
    quantile_Effort,
    "."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nGridded effort reconstructed successfully:\n",
  "  years: ", length(years_to_submit), "\n",
  "  annual sf records: ",
  format(
    sum(vapply(
      effort_sf_gridded_list,
      nrow,
      integer(1)
    )),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n  aggregated records: ",
  format(nrow(effort_gridded_all), big.mark = ","),
  "\n  checkpoint directory: ",
  normalizePath(aggregation_checkpoint_dir),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Mean annual effort maps

```{r step1-22-mean-annual-effort-maps, fig.width=6, fig.height=8, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
required_effort_columns <- c(

}

if (nrow(effort_gridded_all) == 0L) {

}

if (
  !exists("years_to_submit") ||

) {

}

if (
  !exists("quantile_Effort") ||

  is.na(quantile_Effort) ||
  quantile_Effort < 0 ||
  quantile_Effort >= 1
) {
  stop("quantile_Effort must be a single value between 0 and 1.")
}

grid_geometry <- if (inherits(grid_sf, "sf")) {

  grid_sf

} else if (
  is.list(grid_sf) &&
  "grid_sf" %in% names(grid_sf) &&

) {

  grid_sf$grid_sf

} else {

  stop(

}

if (!"id_grid" %in% names(grid_geometry)) {

if (anyNA(grid_geometry$id_grid)) {

effort_data_checked <- effort_gridded_all %>%

}

if (

) {

if (

years_to_submit_checked <- sort(

effort_gridded_annual <- effort_data_checked %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$Gear,

  dplyr::summarise(

observed_grid_gears <- effort_gridded_annual %>%
  dplyr::distinct(

effort_gridded_annual_complete <- tidyr::crossing(

  dplyr::left_join(

      "YEAR",

  dplyr::mutate(
    effort = tidyr::replace_na(.data$effort, 0)
  )

effort_gridded_mean <- effort_gridded_annual_complete %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$id_grid,
    .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    effort = mean(.data$effort),
    years_with_effort = sum(.data$effort > 0),
    years_considered = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

map_quantile <- min(
  max(2 * quantile_Effort, 0),
  0.99
)

effort_gridded_mean_plot <- effort_gridded_mean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Gear) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plotting_threshold = {
      positive_effort <- .data$effort[
        is.finite(.data$effort) &
          .data$effort > 0
      ]

      if (length(positive_effort) == 0L) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        stats::quantile(
          positive_effort,
          probs = map_quantile,
          na.rm = TRUE,
          names = FALSE,
          type = 7
        )
      }
    },
    effort_to_plot = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(.data$plotting_threshold) &
        .data$effort > 0 &
        .data$effort >= .data$plotting_threshold,
      .data$effort,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

effort_sf_gridded_mean <- grid_geometry %>%

if (nrow(effort_sf_gridded_mean) == 0L) {

if (!exists("mp") || !is.data.frame(mp)) {

required_land_columns <- c(

if (!all(required_land_columns %in% names(mp))) {

if (

for (g in seq_along(gear_values)) {

    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

    theme(

        size = 14,

      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9.5,

        margin = margin(b = 8)
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 8,

      ),

      ),
      axis.text = element_text(

      panel.grid.major = element_line(

        linewidth = 0.25
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#F7FBFD",
        colour = NA
      ),
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = NA
      ),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = "grey45",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 8
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 10,
        r = 12,
        b = 8,
        l = 10
      )
    )

  print(map_eff)

  map_list[[current_gear]] <- map_eff
}

cat(
  "\nMean annual effort maps created successfully:\n",
  "  years considered: ",
  paste(years_to_submit_checked, collapse = ", "),
  "\n  gears mapped: ",
  length(gear_values),
  "\n  grid–gear combinations: ",
  format(nrow(effort_gridded_mean), big.mark = ","),
  "\n  plotting quantile: ",
  scales::percent(map_quantile, accuracy = 0.1),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Annual effort wide format

```{r step1-23-annual-effort-wide-format, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

if (
  !exists("effort_sf_gridded_list") ||
  !is.list(effort_sf_gridded_list)
) {
  stop("effort_sf_gridded_list is unavailable or is not a list.")
}

years_to_submit_checked <- sort(
  unique(as.integer(years_to_submit))
)

if (
  length(effort_sf_gridded_list) !=
    length(years_to_submit_checked)
) {
  stop(
    "The length of effort_sf_gridded_list does not match ",
    "the number of years in years_to_submit."
  )
}

if (
  !exists("quantile_Effort") ||
  !is.numeric(quantile_Effort) ||
  length(quantile_Effort) != 1L ||
  is.na(quantile_Effort) ||
  !is.finite(quantile_Effort) ||
  quantile_Effort < 0 ||
  quantile_Effort >= 1
) {
  stop("quantile_Effort must be a single value between 0 and 1.")
}

effort_gridded_list_wide <- stats::setNames(
  vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(years_to_submit_checked)
  ),
  as.character(years_to_submit_checked)
)

wide_format_summary <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(years_to_submit_checked)
)

for (y in seq_along(years_to_submit_checked)) {

  current_year <- years_to_submit_checked[y]
  current_effort_sf <- effort_sf_gridded_list[[y]]

  if (!inherits(current_effort_sf, "sf")) {
    stop(
      "effort_sf_gridded_list[[",
      y,
      "]] for ",
      current_year,
      " is not an sf object."
    )
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "CFR",
    "YEAR",
    "MONTH",
    "Gear",
    "id_grid",
    "effort"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(current_effort_sf)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The gridded effort object for ",
      current_year,
      " is missing the following columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  ey <- sf::st_drop_geometry(
    current_effort_sf
  )

  ey <- data.table::as.data.table(
    ey[
      ,
      required_columns,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )

  ey[
    ,
    `:=`(
      CFR = trimws(as.character(CFR)),
      YEAR = suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(as.character(YEAR))
      ),
      MONTH = trimws(as.character(MONTH)),
      Gear = trimws(as.character(Gear)),
      id_grid = trimws(as.character(id_grid)),
      effort = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(effort))
      )
    )
  ]

  if (
    anyNA(ey$CFR) ||
    any(!nzchar(ey$CFR))
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing or empty CFR values were found for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(ey$YEAR) ||
    any(ey$YEAR != current_year)
  ) {
    unexpected_year_values <- sort(
      unique(ey$YEAR[
        is.na(ey$YEAR) |
          ey$YEAR != current_year
      ])
    )

    stop(
      "The annual effort object assigned to ",
      current_year,
      " contains invalid or unexpected YEAR values: ",
      paste(unexpected_year_values, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(ey$MONTH) ||
    any(!nzchar(ey$MONTH))
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing or empty MONTH values were found for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(ey$Gear) ||
    any(!nzchar(ey$Gear))
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing or empty Gear values were found for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(ey$id_grid) ||
    any(!nzchar(ey$id_grid))
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing or empty id_grid values were found for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(ey$effort) ||
    any(!is.finite(ey$effort)) ||
    any(ey$effort < 0)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing, non-finite or negative effort values were found for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  ey <- ey[
    ,
    .(
      effort = sum(effort)
    ),
    by = .(
      CFR,
      YEAR,
      MONTH,
      Gear,
      id_grid
    )
  ]

  eyc_sum <- ey[
    ,
    .(
      total_cell_effort = sum(effort)
    ),
    by = id_grid
  ]

  cell_effort_threshold <- stats::quantile(
    eyc_sum$total_cell_effort,
    probs = quantile_Effort,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE,
    type = 7
  )

  retained_grid_ids <- eyc_sum[
    total_cell_effort > cell_effort_threshold,
    id_grid
  ]

  ey <- ey[
    id_grid %in% retained_grid_ids
  ]

  if (nrow(ey) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No effort records remain for ",
      current_year,
      " after applying quantile_Effort = ",
      quantile_Effort,
      "."
    )
  }

  eyw <- data.table::dcast(
    data = ey,
    formula = CFR + YEAR + MONTH + Gear ~ id_grid,
    value.var = "effort",
    fun.aggregate = sum,
    fill = 0,
    drop = FALSE
  )

  data.table::setorder(
    eyw,
    CFR,
    YEAR,
    MONTH,
    Gear
  )

  data.table::setDF(eyw)

  effort_gridded_list_wide[[y]] <- eyw

  wide_format_summary[[y]] <- data.frame(
    YEAR = current_year,
    cell_effort_threshold = cell_effort_threshold,
    observed_grid_cells = nrow(eyc_sum),
    retained_grid_cells = length(retained_grid_ids),
    retained_effort_records = nrow(ey),
    wide_rows = nrow(eyw),
    wide_grid_columns = ncol(eyw) - 4L,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  message(
    "Processed ",
    current_year,
    ": ",
    format(nrow(eyw), big.mark = ","),
    " rows × ",
    format(ncol(eyw) - 4L, big.mark = ","),
    " grid-cell columns; ",
    format(length(retained_grid_ids), big.mark = ","),
    " of ",
    format(nrow(eyc_sum), big.mark = ","),
    " observed cells retained."
  )

  rm(
    current_effort_sf,
    ey,
    eyc_sum,
    eyw,
    retained_grid_ids,
    cell_effort_threshold
  )

  invisible(gc())
}

wide_format_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(
  wide_format_summary,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

data.table::setDF(wide_format_summary)

cat(
  "\nAnnual wide-format effort tables created successfully:\n",
  "  years: ",
  paste(years_to_submit_checked, collapse = ", "),
  "\n  annual tables: ",
  length(effort_gridded_list_wide),
  "\n  total wide rows: ",
  format(
    sum(vapply(
      effort_gridded_list_wide,
      nrow,
      integer(1)
    )),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

smart31_preview_table(wide_format_summary, "Annual dimensions of the LPUE effort design matrices")
```

## Get distances from harbours

```{r step1-24-get-distances-from-harbours, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

if (
  !is.list(grid_sf) ||
  !all(c("grid_sf", "grid_CS") %in% names(grid_sf))
) {
  stop(
    "grid_sf must be the list returned by genGrid() and must contain ",
    "both 'grid_sf' and 'grid_CS'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

grid_polygons <- grid_sf$grid_sf
grid_before_depth_filter <- grid_sf$grid_CS

if (!inherits(grid_polygons, "sf")) {
  stop("grid_sf$grid_sf is not a valid sf object.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (!inherits(grid_before_depth_filter, "sf")) {
  stop("grid_sf$grid_CS is not a valid sf object.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (!inherits(harbs_df_sf, "sf")) {
  stop("harbs_df_sf is not a valid sf object.", call. = FALSE)
}

required_grid_columns <- c("id_grid", "depth")
missing_navigation_columns <- setdiff(
  required_grid_columns,
  names(grid_before_depth_filter)
)

if (length(missing_navigation_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "grid_sf$grid_CS is missing: ",
    paste(missing_navigation_columns, collapse = ", "),
    ".",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!"id_grid" %in% names(grid_polygons)) {
  stop(
    "grid_sf$grid_sf does not contain id_grid.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!"HARBOUR" %in% names(harbs_df_sf)) {
  stop(
    "harbs_df_sf does not contain HARBOUR.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

navigation_grid_polygons <- grid_before_depth_filter |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$depth),
    .data$depth >= 0
  ) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

if (nrow(navigation_grid_polygons) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No marine cells are available for the navigation grid.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (
  anyNA(navigation_grid_polygons$id_grid) ||
  anyDuplicated(navigation_grid_polygons$id_grid)
) {
  stop(
    "Navigation-grid identifiers must be complete and unique.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

analysis_grid_ids <- as.character(grid_polygons$id_grid)
navigation_grid_ids <- as.character(
  navigation_grid_polygons$id_grid
)

analytical_cells_missing_from_navigation <- setdiff(
  analysis_grid_ids,
  navigation_grid_ids
)

if (length(analytical_cells_missing_from_navigation) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Some analytical grid cells are absent from the navigation grid: ",
    paste(
      head(analytical_cells_missing_from_navigation, 20L),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

navigation_grid_centroids <- navigation_grid_polygons |>
  sf::st_transform(3035) |>
  sf::st_centroid() |>
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(navigation_grid_polygons))

distance_start_time <- Sys.time()

initial_corner_component_limit <- 3L
maximum_automatic_corner_component_area_km2 <- 100
maximum_automatic_corner_component_size <- max(
  initial_corner_component_limit,
  min(
    25L,
    as.integer(floor(
      maximum_automatic_corner_component_area_km2 /
        as.numeric(spatial_resolution_km)^2
    ))
  )
)
distance_corner_component_limit_used <- initial_corner_component_limit
distance_automatic_corner_repair <- FALSE

Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf <- gridDistance(
  grid_centroid = navigation_grid_centroids,
  grid_sf = navigation_grid_polygons,
  harbs_df_sf = harbs_df_sf,
  harbour_col = "HARBOUR",
  connect_small_corner_components = TRUE,
  maximum_corner_component_size = initial_corner_component_limit
)

distance_rook_component_summary <- attr(
  Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf,
  "rook_component_summary"
)

initial_analysis_distances <- Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(.data$id_grid) %in% analysis_grid_ids
  )

distance_initial_unreachable_records <- sum(
  !is.finite(initial_analysis_distances$layer)
)

if (distance_initial_unreachable_records > 0L) {
  if (
    is.null(distance_rook_component_summary) ||
      !all(
        c("component", "grid_cells") %in%
          names(distance_rook_component_summary)
      ) ||
      nrow(distance_rook_component_summary) < 2L
  ) {
    stop(
      "Unreachable analytical routes were found, but the navigation ",
      "component diagnostic is unavailable.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  dominant_component_row <- which.max(
    distance_rook_component_summary$grid_cells
  )

  secondary_component_sizes <-
    distance_rook_component_summary$grid_cells[
      -dominant_component_row
    ]

  candidate_corner_component_limits <- sort(unique(as.integer(
    secondary_component_sizes[
      is.finite(secondary_component_sizes) &
        secondary_component_sizes > initial_corner_component_limit &
        secondary_component_sizes <=
          maximum_automatic_corner_component_size
    ]
  )))

  for (candidate_limit in candidate_corner_component_limits) {
    distance_corner_component_limit_used <- candidate_limit
    distance_automatic_corner_repair <- TRUE

    Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf <- gridDistance(
      grid_centroid = navigation_grid_centroids,
      grid_sf = navigation_grid_polygons,
      harbs_df_sf = harbs_df_sf,
      harbour_col = "HARBOUR",
      connect_small_corner_components = TRUE,
      maximum_corner_component_size =
        distance_corner_component_limit_used
    )

    candidate_analysis_distances <- Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf |>
      sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(.data$id_grid) %in% analysis_grid_ids
      )

    if (all(is.finite(candidate_analysis_distances$layer))) {
      break
    }
  }
}

distance_elapsed_minutes <- as.numeric(
  difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    distance_start_time,
    units = "mins"
  )
)

distance_rook_component_summary <- attr(
  Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf,
  "rook_component_summary"
)

distance_corner_bridge_diagnostics <- attr(
  Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf,
  "corner_bridge_diagnostics"
)

distance_post_corner_unreachable_records <-
  Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(.data$id_grid) %in% analysis_grid_ids
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.finite(.data$layer))
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull("n")

maximum_short_gap_bridge_distance_km <-
  2.5 * as.numeric(spatial_resolution_km)

short_gap_bathymetry_sample_spacing_km <- max(
  0.25,
  as.numeric(spatial_resolution_km) / 10
)

distance_short_gap_bridge_diagnostics <- tibble::tibble(
  target_id_grid = character(),
  anchor_id_grid = character(),
  bridge_distance_km = numeric(),
  bathymetry_samples = integer(),
  shallowest_sampled_depth_m = numeric(),
  deepest_sampled_depth_m = numeric(),
  all_samples_in_domain = logical(),
  all_samples_marine = logical()
)

distance_short_gap_candidate_diagnostics <- tibble::tibble(
  target_id_grid = character(),
  anchor_id_grid = character(),
  bridge_distance_km = numeric(),
  bathymetry_samples = integer(),
  shallowest_sampled_depth_m = numeric(),
  deepest_sampled_depth_m = numeric(),
  all_samples_in_domain = logical(),
  all_samples_marine = logical(),
  accepted = logical(),
  rejection_reason = character()
)

distance_short_gap_repair_used <- FALSE

navigation_centroids_projected <-
  navigation_grid_centroids |>
  sf::st_transform(3035)

navigation_centroid_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(
  navigation_centroids_projected
)[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

navigation_centroid_ids <- as.character(
  navigation_centroids_projected$id_grid
)

navigation_centroids_geographic <- sf::st_transform(
  navigation_grid_centroids,
  4326
)

navigation_centroid_geographic_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(
  navigation_centroids_geographic
)

navigation_centroid_coordinate_lookup <-
  navigation_centroids_geographic |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    longitude = navigation_centroid_geographic_xy[, "X"],
    latitude = navigation_centroid_geographic_xy[, "Y"]
  ) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
    .data$longitude,
    .data$latitude
  )

distance_support_by_grid <-
  Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    reachable_from_every_harbour = all(is.finite(.data$layer)),
    .by = id_grid
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid))

unresolved_short_gap_ids <- distance_support_by_grid |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !.data$reachable_from_every_harbour,
    .data$id_grid %in% analysis_grid_ids
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(.data$id_grid)

reachable_short_gap_ids <- distance_support_by_grid |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$reachable_from_every_harbour) |>
  dplyr::pull(.data$id_grid)

validate_short_gap_connector <- function(
    target_id,
    anchor_id,
    maximum_distance_km = maximum_short_gap_bridge_distance_km) {

  target_index <- match(target_id, navigation_centroid_ids)
  anchor_index <- match(anchor_id, navigation_centroid_ids)

  if (is.na(target_index) || is.na(anchor_index)) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      reason = "grid_identifier_not_found",
      bridge_distance_km = NA_real_,
      bathymetry_samples = 0L,
      shallowest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      deepest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      all_samples_in_domain = FALSE,
      all_samples_marine = FALSE
    ))
  }

  target_xy <- navigation_centroid_xy[target_index, ]
  anchor_xy <- navigation_centroid_xy[anchor_index, ]
  bridge_distance_km <- sqrt(sum((target_xy - anchor_xy)^2)) / 1000

  if (
    !is.finite(bridge_distance_km) ||
      bridge_distance_km <= 0 ||
      bridge_distance_km > maximum_distance_km
  ) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      reason = "connector_exceeds_distance_limit",
      bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km,
      bathymetry_samples = 0L,
      shallowest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      deepest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      all_samples_in_domain = FALSE,
      all_samples_marine = FALSE
    ))
  }

  n_samples <- max(
    3L,
    as.integer(ceiling(
      bridge_distance_km /
        short_gap_bathymetry_sample_spacing_km
    )) + 1L
  )

  interpolation_fraction <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_samples)

  sampled_xy <- data.frame(
    sample_x = target_xy[["X"]] +
      interpolation_fraction * (anchor_xy[["X"]] - target_xy[["X"]]),
    sample_y = target_xy[["Y"]] +
      interpolation_fraction * (anchor_xy[["Y"]] - target_xy[["Y"]])
  )

  sampled_points_projected <- sf::st_as_sf(
    sampled_xy,
    coords = c("sample_x", "sample_y"),
    crs = 3035,
    remove = TRUE
  )

  domain_projected <- sf::st_transform(
    sf::st_make_valid(CS_buffer),
    3035
  )

  samples_in_domain <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(
    sampled_points_projected,
    domain_projected
  )) > 0L

  sampled_points_geographic <- sf::st_transform(
    sampled_points_projected,
    4326
  )

  sampled_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(
    sampled_points_geographic
  )[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

  sampled_bathymetry <- tryCatch(
    marmap::get.depth(
      mat = bathy,
      x = sampled_coordinates,
      locator = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (
    inherits(sampled_bathymetry, "error") ||
      !is.data.frame(sampled_bathymetry) ||
      !"depth" %in% names(sampled_bathymetry) ||
      nrow(sampled_bathymetry) != n_samples
  ) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      reason = "bathymetry_sampling_failed",
      bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km,
      bathymetry_samples = n_samples,
      shallowest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      deepest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      all_samples_in_domain = all(samples_in_domain),
      all_samples_marine = FALSE
    ))
  }

  sampled_depth_m <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
    sampled_bathymetry$depth
  ))

  samples_marine <- is.finite(sampled_depth_m) &
    sampled_depth_m <= 0

  all_samples_in_domain <- all(samples_in_domain)
  all_samples_marine <- all(samples_marine)

  rejection_reason <- dplyr::case_when(
    !all_samples_in_domain ~ "connector_leaves_study_domain",
    !all_samples_marine ~ "connector_crosses_land_or_missing_bathymetry",
    TRUE ~ "accepted"
  )

  list(
    valid = all_samples_in_domain && all_samples_marine,
    reason = rejection_reason,
    bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km,
    bathymetry_samples = n_samples,
    shallowest_sampled_depth_m = if (any(is.finite(sampled_depth_m))) {
      max(sampled_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    deepest_sampled_depth_m = if (any(is.finite(sampled_depth_m))) {
      min(sampled_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    all_samples_in_domain = all_samples_in_domain,
    all_samples_marine = all_samples_marine
  )
}

build_short_gap_candidates <- function(target_id, reachable_ids) {
  target_index <- match(target_id, navigation_centroid_ids)
  reachable_indices <- match(reachable_ids, navigation_centroid_ids)
  valid_reachable <- !is.na(reachable_indices)
  reachable_indices <- reachable_indices[valid_reachable]
  reachable_ids <- reachable_ids[valid_reachable]

  if (is.na(target_index) || length(reachable_indices) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      target_id_grid = character(),
      anchor_id_grid = character(),
      bridge_distance_km = numeric()
    ))
  }

  coordinate_difference <- sweep(
    navigation_centroid_xy[reachable_indices, , drop = FALSE],
    2,
    navigation_centroid_xy[target_index, ],
    FUN = "-"
  )

  bridge_distance_km <- sqrt(rowSums(
    coordinate_difference^2
  )) / 1000

  tibble::tibble(
    target_id_grid = target_id,
    anchor_id_grid = reachable_ids,
    bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$bridge_distance_km),
      .data$bridge_distance_km > 0,
      .data$bridge_distance_km <=
        maximum_short_gap_bridge_distance_km
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$bridge_distance_km, .data$anchor_id_grid)
}

if (
  length(unresolved_short_gap_ids) > 0L &&
    length(unresolved_short_gap_ids) <=
      maximum_automatic_corner_component_size
) {
  maximum_short_gap_iterations <- length(unresolved_short_gap_ids)

  for (short_gap_iteration in seq_len(maximum_short_gap_iterations)) {
    short_gap_candidates <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
      unresolved_short_gap_ids,
      build_short_gap_candidates,
      reachable_ids = reachable_short_gap_ids
    )) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$bridge_distance_km,
        .data$target_id_grid,
        .data$anchor_id_grid
      )

    if (nrow(short_gap_candidates) == 0L) {
      break
    }

    accepted_candidate <- NULL
    accepted_validation <- NULL

    for (candidate_row in seq_len(nrow(short_gap_candidates))) {
      candidate <- short_gap_candidates[candidate_row, , drop = FALSE]

      connector_validation <- validate_short_gap_connector(
        target_id = candidate$target_id_grid[[1L]],
        anchor_id = candidate$anchor_id_grid[[1L]]
      )

      candidate_diagnostic <- tibble::tibble(
        target_id_grid = candidate$target_id_grid[[1L]],
        anchor_id_grid = candidate$anchor_id_grid[[1L]],
        bridge_distance_km =
          connector_validation$bridge_distance_km,
        bathymetry_samples =
          connector_validation$bathymetry_samples,
        shallowest_sampled_depth_m =
          connector_validation$shallowest_sampled_depth_m,
        deepest_sampled_depth_m =
          connector_validation$deepest_sampled_depth_m,
        all_samples_in_domain =
          connector_validation$all_samples_in_domain,
        all_samples_marine =
          connector_validation$all_samples_marine,
        accepted = connector_validation$valid,
        rejection_reason = connector_validation$reason
      )

      distance_short_gap_candidate_diagnostics <-
        dplyr::bind_rows(
          distance_short_gap_candidate_diagnostics,
          candidate_diagnostic
        )

      if (isTRUE(connector_validation$valid)) {
        accepted_candidate <- candidate
        accepted_validation <- connector_validation
        break
      }
    }

    if (is.null(accepted_candidate)) {
      break
    }

    target_id <- accepted_candidate$target_id_grid[[1L]]
    anchor_id <- accepted_candidate$anchor_id_grid[[1L]]

    distance_values <- sf::st_drop_geometry(
      Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf
    )

    target_rows <- which(
      as.character(distance_values$id_grid) == target_id
    )
    anchor_rows <- which(
      as.character(distance_values$id_grid) == anchor_id
    )

    anchor_match <- match(
      as.character(distance_values$harb[target_rows]),
      as.character(distance_values$harb[anchor_rows])
    )

    anchor_distances <- distance_values$layer[
      anchor_rows[anchor_match]
    ]

    if (
      length(target_rows) == 0L ||
        anyNA(anchor_match) ||
        any(!is.finite(anchor_distances))
    ) {
      stop(
        "Internal short-gap repair error: the accepted anchor is not ",
        "reachable from every harbour.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf$layer[target_rows] <-
      anchor_distances + accepted_validation$bridge_distance_km

    distance_short_gap_bridge_diagnostics <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        distance_short_gap_bridge_diagnostics,
        tibble::tibble(
          target_id_grid = target_id,
          anchor_id_grid = anchor_id,
          bridge_distance_km =
            accepted_validation$bridge_distance_km,
          bathymetry_samples =
            accepted_validation$bathymetry_samples,
          shallowest_sampled_depth_m =
            accepted_validation$shallowest_sampled_depth_m,
          deepest_sampled_depth_m =
            accepted_validation$deepest_sampled_depth_m,
          all_samples_in_domain =
            accepted_validation$all_samples_in_domain,
          all_samples_marine =
            accepted_validation$all_samples_marine
        )
      )

    distance_short_gap_repair_used <- TRUE
    unresolved_short_gap_ids <- setdiff(
      unresolved_short_gap_ids,
      target_id
    )
    reachable_short_gap_ids <- unique(c(
      reachable_short_gap_ids,
      target_id
    ))

    if (length(unresolved_short_gap_ids) == 0L) {
      break
    }
  }
}

cell_access_point_spacing_km <- max(
  0.25,
  as.numeric(spatial_resolution_km) / 10
)

maximum_cell_access_candidates_per_cell <- 100L

)

distance_cell_access_repair_used <- FALSE
```
