```{r step1-24-get-distances-from-harbours, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
navigation_domain_projected <- sf::st_transform(
  sf::st_make_valid(CS_buffer),
  3035
)

sample_marine_access_points <- function(target_id) {
  target_polygon_projected <- grid_polygons |>
    dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$id_grid) == target_id) |>
    sf::st_transform(3035)

  if (nrow(target_polygon_projected) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  regular_access_geometry <- sf::st_make_grid(
    target_polygon_projected,
    cellsize = cell_access_point_spacing_km * 1000,
    what = "centers"
  )

  regular_access_points <- sf::st_as_sf(
    regular_access_geometry
  )

  if (nrow(regular_access_points) > 0L) {
    point_inside_target <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(
      regular_access_points,
      target_polygon_projected
    )) > 0L

    regular_access_points <- regular_access_points[
      point_inside_target,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  representative_access_point <- sf::st_as_sf(
    sf::st_point_on_surface(
      sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(target_polygon_projected))
    )
  )

  access_points_projected <- rbind(
    regular_access_points,
    representative_access_point
  )

  if (nrow(access_points_projected) == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  access_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(
    access_points_projected
  )[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

  access_points_projected <- access_points_projected[
    !duplicated(data.frame(
      X = round(access_xy[, "X"], 6),
      Y = round(access_xy[, "Y"], 6)
    )),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  access_points_geographic <- sf::st_transform(
    access_points_projected,
    4326
  )

  access_coordinates_geographic <- sf::st_coordinates(
    access_points_geographic
  )[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

  access_in_domain <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(
    access_points_projected,
    navigation_domain_projected
  )) > 0L

  access_bathymetry <- tryCatch(
    marmap::get.depth(
      mat = bathy,
      x = access_coordinates_geographic,
      locator = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (
    inherits(access_bathymetry, "error") ||
      !is.data.frame(access_bathymetry) ||
      !"depth" %in% names(access_bathymetry) ||
      nrow(access_bathymetry) != nrow(access_points_projected)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  access_depth_m <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
    access_bathymetry$depth
  ))

  valid_access <- access_in_domain &
    is.finite(access_depth_m) &
    access_depth_m <= 0

  if (!any(valid_access)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  access_points_projected <- access_points_projected[
    valid_access,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  access_points_geographic <- access_points_geographic[
    valid_access,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  access_geographic_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(
    access_points_geographic
  )[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

  access_points_projected$access_point_index <-
    seq_len(nrow(access_points_projected))
  access_points_projected$access_longitude <-
    access_geographic_xy[, "X"]
  access_points_projected$access_latitude <-
    access_geographic_xy[, "Y"]
  access_points_projected$access_depth_m <-
    access_depth_m[valid_access]

  access_points_projected
}

empty_cell_access_candidates <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    target_id_grid = character(),
    access_point_index = integer(),
    anchor_id_grid = character(),
    access_longitude = numeric(),
    access_latitude = numeric(),
    access_depth_m = numeric(),
    bridge_distance_km = numeric()
  )
}

build_cell_access_candidates <- function(
    target_id,
    access_points_projected,
    reachable_ids) {

  if (
    is.null(access_points_projected) ||
      nrow(access_points_projected) == 0L ||
      length(reachable_ids) == 0L
  ) {
    return(empty_cell_access_candidates())
  }

  reachable_indices <- match(
    reachable_ids,
    navigation_centroid_ids
  )
  valid_reachable <- !is.na(reachable_indices)
  reachable_indices <- reachable_indices[valid_reachable]
  reachable_ids <- reachable_ids[valid_reachable]

  if (length(reachable_indices) == 0L) {
    return(empty_cell_access_candidates())
  }

  access_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(
    access_points_projected
  )[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

  candidate_list <- vector(
    "list",
    nrow(access_points_projected)
  )

  for (access_index in seq_len(nrow(access_points_projected))) {
    coordinate_difference <- sweep(
      navigation_centroid_xy[
        reachable_indices,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      2,
      access_xy[access_index, ],
      FUN = "-"
    )

    bridge_distance_km <- sqrt(rowSums(
      coordinate_difference^2
    )) / 1000

    within_limit <- which(
      is.finite(bridge_distance_km) &
        bridge_distance_km > 0 &
        bridge_distance_km <=
          maximum_cell_access_bridge_distance_km
    )

    if (length(within_limit) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    candidate_list[[access_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
      target_id_grid = target_id,
      access_point_index = access_points_projected$access_point_index[
        access_index
      ],
      anchor_id_grid = reachable_ids[within_limit],
      access_longitude =
        access_points_projected$access_longitude[access_index],
      access_latitude =
        access_points_projected$access_latitude[access_index],
      access_depth_m =
        access_points_projected$access_depth_m[access_index],
      bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km[within_limit]
    )
  }

  candidates <- dplyr::bind_rows(candidate_list)

  if (nrow(candidates) == 0L) {
    return(empty_cell_access_candidates())
  }

  candidates |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$bridge_distance_km,
      .data$anchor_id_grid,
      .data$access_point_index
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n = maximum_cell_access_candidates_per_cell
    )
}

validate_cell_access_connector <- function(
    access_point_projected,
    anchor_id) {

  anchor_index <- match(anchor_id, navigation_centroid_ids)

  if (is.na(anchor_index)) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      reason = "anchor_identifier_not_found",
      bridge_distance_km = NA_real_,
      bathymetry_samples = 0L,
      shallowest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      deepest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      all_samples_in_domain = FALSE,
      all_samples_marine = FALSE
    ))
  }

  access_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(
    access_point_projected
  )[1L, c("X", "Y")]
  anchor_xy <- navigation_centroid_xy[anchor_index, ]
  bridge_distance_km <- sqrt(sum((access_xy - anchor_xy)^2)) / 1000

  if (
    !is.finite(bridge_distance_km) ||
      bridge_distance_km <= 0 ||
      bridge_distance_km > maximum_cell_access_bridge_distance_km
  ) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      reason = "connector_exceeds_distance_limit",
      bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km,
      bathymetry_samples = 0L,
      shallowest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      deepest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      all_samples_in_domain = FALSE,
      all_samples_marine = FALSE
    ))
  }

  n_samples <- max(
    3L,
    as.integer(ceiling(
      bridge_distance_km /
        short_gap_bathymetry_sample_spacing_km
    )) + 1L
  )

  interpolation_fraction <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_samples)

  sampled_xy <- data.frame(
    sample_x = access_xy[["X"]] +
      interpolation_fraction * (anchor_xy[["X"]] - access_xy[["X"]]),
    sample_y = access_xy[["Y"]] +
      interpolation_fraction * (anchor_xy[["Y"]] - access_xy[["Y"]])
  )

  sampled_points_projected <- sf::st_as_sf(
    sampled_xy,
    coords = c("sample_x", "sample_y"),
    crs = 3035,
    remove = TRUE
  )

  samples_in_domain <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(
    sampled_points_projected,
    navigation_domain_projected
  )) > 0L

  sampled_points_geographic <- sf::st_transform(
    sampled_points_projected,
    4326
  )

  sampled_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(
    sampled_points_geographic
  )[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

  sampled_bathymetry <- tryCatch(
    marmap::get.depth(
      mat = bathy,
      x = sampled_coordinates,
      locator = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (
    inherits(sampled_bathymetry, "error") ||
      !is.data.frame(sampled_bathymetry) ||
      !"depth" %in% names(sampled_bathymetry) ||
      nrow(sampled_bathymetry) != n_samples
  ) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      reason = "bathymetry_sampling_failed",
      bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km,
      bathymetry_samples = n_samples,
      shallowest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      deepest_sampled_depth_m = NA_real_,
      all_samples_in_domain = all(samples_in_domain),
      all_samples_marine = FALSE
    ))
  }

  sampled_depth_m <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
    sampled_bathymetry$depth
  ))

  samples_marine <- is.finite(sampled_depth_m) &
    sampled_depth_m <= 0

  all_samples_in_domain <- all(samples_in_domain)
  all_samples_marine <- all(samples_marine)

  rejection_reason <- dplyr::case_when(
    !all_samples_in_domain ~ "connector_leaves_study_domain",
    !all_samples_marine ~
      "connector_crosses_land_or_missing_bathymetry",
    TRUE ~ "accepted"
  )

  list(
    valid = all_samples_in_domain && all_samples_marine,
    reason = rejection_reason,
    bridge_distance_km = bridge_distance_km,
    bathymetry_samples = n_samples,
    shallowest_sampled_depth_m = if (any(is.finite(sampled_depth_m))) {
      max(sampled_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    deepest_sampled_depth_m = if (any(is.finite(sampled_depth_m))) {
      min(sampled_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    all_samples_in_domain = all_samples_in_domain,
    all_samples_marine = all_samples_marine
  )
}

if (
  length(unresolved_cell_access_ids) > 0L &&
    length(unresolved_cell_access_ids) <=
      maximum_automatic_corner_component_size
) {
  for (target_id in unresolved_cell_access_ids) {
    target_access_points <- sample_marine_access_points(target_id)

    target_access_candidates <- build_cell_access_candidates(
      target_id = target_id,
      access_points_projected = target_access_points,
      reachable_ids = reachable_cell_access_ids
    )

    if (nrow(target_access_candidates) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    accepted_access_candidate <- NULL
    accepted_access_validation <- NULL

    for (candidate_index in seq_len(nrow(target_access_candidates))) {
      candidate <- target_access_candidates[
        candidate_index,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      access_row <- match(
        candidate$access_point_index,
        target_access_points$access_point_index
      )

      validation <- validate_cell_access_connector(
        access_point_projected = target_access_points[
          access_row,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ],
        anchor_id = candidate$anchor_id_grid
      )

      distance_cell_access_candidate_diagnostics <-
        dplyr::bind_rows(
          distance_cell_access_candidate_diagnostics,
          tibble::tibble(
            target_id_grid = target_id,
            anchor_id_grid = candidate$anchor_id_grid,
            access_longitude = candidate$access_longitude,
            access_latitude = candidate$access_latitude,
            access_depth_m = candidate$access_depth_m,
            bridge_distance_km = validation$bridge_distance_km,
            bathymetry_samples = validation$bathymetry_samples,
            shallowest_sampled_depth_m =
              validation$shallowest_sampled_depth_m,
            deepest_sampled_depth_m =
              validation$deepest_sampled_depth_m,
            all_samples_in_domain =
              validation$all_samples_in_domain,
            all_samples_marine = validation$all_samples_marine,
            accepted = isTRUE(validation$valid),
            rejection_reason = validation$reason
          )
        )

      if (isTRUE(validation$valid)) {
        accepted_access_candidate <- candidate
        accepted_access_validation <- validation
        break
      }
    }

    if (is.null(accepted_access_candidate)) {
      next
    }

    distance_values <- sf::st_drop_geometry(
      Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf
    )

    target_rows <- which(
      as.character(distance_values$id_grid) == target_id
    )
    anchor_rows <- which(
      as.character(distance_values$id_grid) ==
        accepted_access_candidate$anchor_id_grid
    )

    anchor_match <- match(
      as.character(distance_values$harb[target_rows]),
      as.character(distance_values$harb[anchor_rows])
    )
    anchor_distances <- distance_values$layer[
      anchor_rows[anchor_match]
    ]

    if (
      length(target_rows) == 0L ||
        anyNA(anchor_match) ||
        any(!is.finite(anchor_distances))
    ) {
      stop(
        "Internal cell-access repair error: the accepted anchor is not ",
        "reachable from every harbour.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    Dist2Harbs_navigation_sf$layer[target_rows] <-
      anchor_distances +
      accepted_access_validation$bridge_distance_km

    distance_cell_access_bridge_diagnostics <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        distance_cell_access_bridge_diagnostics,
        tibble::tibble(
          target_id_grid = target_id,
          anchor_id_grid =
            accepted_access_candidate$anchor_id_grid,
          access_longitude =
            accepted_access_candidate$access_longitude,
          access_latitude =
            accepted_access_candidate$access_latitude,
          access_depth_m =
            accepted_access_candidate$access_depth_m,
          bridge_distance_km =
            accepted_access_validation$bridge_distance_km,
          bathymetry_samples =
            accepted_access_validation$bathymetry_samples,
          shallowest_sampled_depth_m =
            accepted_access_validation$shallowest_sampled_depth_m,
          deepest_sampled_depth_m =
            accepted_access_validation$deepest_sampled_depth_m,
          all_samples_in_domain =
            accepted_access_validation$all_samples_in_domain,
          all_samples_marine =
            accepted_access_validation$all_samples_marine
        )
      )

    distance_cell_access_repair_used <- TRUE
    reachable_cell_access_ids <- unique(c(
      reachable_cell_access_ids,
      target_id
    ))
  }
}

if (length(unresolved_after_cell_access_ids) > 0L) {
  if (
    !exists("effort_sf_gridded_list", inherits = TRUE) ||
      !is.list(effort_sf_gridded_list) ||
      length(effort_sf_gridded_list) == 0L
  ) {
    stop(
      "Unresolved analytical navigation cells remain, but the complete ",
      "effort_sf_gridded_list is unavailable. No cell was excluded.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invalid_effort_objects <- which(!vapply(
    effort_sf_gridded_list,
    function(x) {
      inherits(x, "sf") &&
        all(c(
          "id_grid", "CFR", "YEAR", "fishing_time", "effort"
        ) %in% names(x))
    },
    logical(1)
  ))

  if (length(invalid_effort_objects) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The following effort_sf_gridded_list elements cannot be used to ",
      "verify isolated cells: ",
      paste(invalid_effort_objects, collapse = ", "),
      ". No cell was excluded.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  isolated_effort_parts <- lapply(
    effort_sf_gridded_list,
    function(x) {
      x_plain <- sf::st_drop_geometry(x)
      x_grid_id <- trimws(as.character(x_plain$id_grid))
      keep <- x_grid_id %in% unresolved_after_cell_access_ids

      if (!any(keep)) {
        return(isolated_navigation_cell_effort_records)
      }

      tibble::tibble(
        id_grid = x_grid_id[keep],
        CFR = trimws(as.character(x_plain$CFR[keep])),
        YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(
          as.character(x_plain$YEAR[keep])
        )),
        fishing_time_h = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
          as.character(x_plain$fishing_time[keep])
        )),
        effort_m_h = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
          as.character(x_plain$effort[keep])
        ))
      )
    }
  )

  isolated_navigation_cell_effort_records <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(isolated_effort_parts)

  observed_isolated_support <-
    isolated_navigation_cell_effort_records |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      effort_records = dplyr::n(),
      positive_activity_records = sum(
        (is.finite(.data$fishing_time_h) &
          .data$fishing_time_h > 0) |
          (is.finite(.data$effort_m_h) &
            .data$effort_m_h > 0)
      ),
      vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR, na.rm = TRUE),
      years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE),
      fishing_time_h = sum(
        .data$fishing_time_h[is.finite(.data$fishing_time_h)],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      effort_m_h = sum(
        .data$effort_m_h[is.finite(.data$effort_m_h)],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .by = id_grid
    )

  isolated_navigation_cell_effort_summary <-
    tibble::tibble(
      id_grid = unresolved_after_cell_access_ids
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      observed_isolated_support,
      by = "id_grid",
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        c(
          effort_records,
          positive_activity_records,
          vessels,
          years,
          fishing_time_h,
          effort_m_h
        ),
        ~ dplyr::coalesce(.x, 0)
      ),
      has_observed_activity =
        .data$positive_activity_records > 0L
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$id_grid)

  removable_isolated_ids <-
    isolated_navigation_cell_effort_summary |>
    dplyr::filter(!.data$has_observed_activity) |>
    dplyr::pull(.data$id_grid)

  if (length(removable_isolated_ids) > 0L) {
    isolated_navigation_cells_removed <-
      tibble::tibble(id_grid = removable_isolated_ids) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        navigation_centroid_coordinate_lookup,
        by = "id_grid",
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        isolated_navigation_cell_effort_summary |>
          dplyr::select(
            .data$id_grid,
            .data$effort_records,
            .data$positive_activity_records,
            .data$fishing_time_h,
            .data$effort_m_h
          ),
        by = "id_grid",
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        exclusion_reason = paste(
          "non_navigable_coastal_grid_artifact",
          "with_zero_observed_VMS_activity",
          sep = "_"
        )
      )

    diagnostic_directory <- file.path(
      project_root,
      "Diagnostics"
    )
    dir.create(
      diagnostic_directory,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )
    diagnostic_timestamp <- format(
      Sys.time(),
      "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"
    )
    isolated_navigation_cells_removed_file <- file.path(
      diagnostic_directory,
      paste0(
        "SMART31_excluded_zero_effort_isolated_navigation_cells_",
        diagnostic_timestamp,
        ".csv"
      )
    )

    utils::write.csv(
      isolated_navigation_cells_removed,
      isolated_navigation_cells_removed_file,
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )

    grid_sf$grid_sf <- grid_sf$grid_sf |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !as.character(.data$id_grid) %in%
          removable_isolated_ids
      )

    if (
      "grid_centroid" %in% names(grid_sf) &&
        inherits(grid_sf$grid_centroid, "sf") &&
        "id_grid" %in% names(grid_sf$grid_centroid)
    ) {
      grid_sf$grid_centroid <- grid_sf$grid_centroid |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !as.character(.data$id_grid) %in%
            removable_isolated_ids
        )
    }

    grid_polygons <- grid_sf$grid_sf
    analysis_grid_ids <- as.character(grid_polygons$id_grid)

    message(
      "Excluded ",
      length(removable_isolated_ids),
      " non-navigable analytical coastal cell(s) after verifying zero ",
      "positive observed VMS activity. Diagnostic: ",
      isolated_navigation_cells_removed_file
    )
  }
}
```

```{r step1-26-landings-preparation-and-coverage, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
normalise_gsa_code <- function(x) {

  x_original <- x

  x <- toupper(
    trimws(as.character(x))
  )

  x <- sub(
    pattern = "^GSA[[:space:]_-]*",
    replacement = "",
    x = x
  )

  x <- gsub(
    pattern = ",",
    replacement = ".",
    x = x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  x <- gsub(
    pattern = "[[:space:]_-]",
    replacement = "",
    x = x
  )

  output <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    length(x)
  )

  output[x %in% c("11.1", "111")] <- "111"
  output[x %in% c("11.2", "112")] <- "112"

  regular_gsa <- grepl(
    pattern = "^0*[0-9]+(?:\\.0+)?$",
    x = x
  )

  regular_gsa <- regular_gsa & is.na(output)

  output[regular_gsa] <- as.character(
    as.integer(
      as.numeric(x[regular_gsa])
    )
  )

  output[
    is.na(x_original) |
      !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x_original)))
  ] <- NA_character_

  output
}

normalise_month_number <- function(x) {

  x_original <- x

  x <- trimws(
    as.character(x)
  )

  output <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(x)
  )

  invalid_numeric <- is.na(output)

  if (any(invalid_numeric)) {

    month_lower <- tolower(x[invalid_numeric])

    full_month_match <- match(
      month_lower,
      tolower(month.name)
    )

    abbreviated_month_match <- match(
      month_lower,
      tolower(month.abb)
    )

    resolved_month <- full_month_match

    resolved_month[
      is.na(resolved_month)
    ] <- abbreviated_month_match[
      is.na(resolved_month)
    ]

    output[invalid_numeric] <- resolved_month
  }

  output[
    is.na(x_original) |
      !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x_original)))
  ] <- NA_integer_

  output[
    !output %in% 1:12
  ] <- NA_integer_

  output
}

      "The landings input file was not found: ",
      current_file
    )
  }

  landings <- readRDS(current_file)

  if (!is.data.frame(landings)) {
    stop(
      "The file ",
      current_file,
      " does not contain a data-frame-like object."
    )
  }

  required_landings_columns <- c(
    "Year",
    "Month",
    "CFR",
    "Species",
    "Gear",
    "GSA_LB",
    "Kg"
  )

  missing_landings_columns <- setdiff(
    required_landings_columns,
    names(landings)
  )

  if (length(missing_landings_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The landings file for ",
      current_year,
      " is missing the following columns: ",
      paste(missing_landings_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  landings <- landings %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Year = suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(as.character(.data$Year))
      ),
      Month = normalise_month_number(.data$Month),
      CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
      Species = trimws(as.character(.data$Species)),
      Gear = trimws(as.character(.data$Gear)),
      GSA_LB = normalise_gsa_code(.data$GSA_LB),
      Kg = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data$Kg))
      )
    )

  invalid_month_values <- landings %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$Month))

  if (nrow(invalid_month_values) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The landings file for ",
      current_year,
      " contains ",
      format(nrow(invalid_month_values), big.mark = ","),
      " records with invalid or missing Month values."
    )
  }

  if (anyNA(landings$Year)) {
    stop(
      "The landings file for ",
      current_year,
      " contains invalid or missing Year values."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(landings$Kg) ||
    any(!is.finite(landings$Kg)) ||
    any(landings$Kg < 0)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The landings file for ",
      current_year,
      " contains missing, non-finite or negative Kg values."
    )
  }

  landings_y <- landings %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Year == current_year,
      .data$CFR %in% fleet_cfr,
      .data$Species %in% species_to_submit_checked,
      .data$Gear %in% gears_to_submit_checked,
      .data$GSA_LB %in% selected_gsa_codes
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Mably = .data$Kg,
      year = .data$Year,
      gear_type = .data$Gear,
      species = .data$Species,
      sub_region = .data$GSA_LB
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sub_region = paste0(
        "GSA",
        .data$sub_region
      )
    )

  landings_list[[y]] <- landings_y
  landings_stats$npoints[y] <- nrow(landings_y)

  message(
    "Processed landings for ",
    current_year,
    ": ",
    format(nrow(landings_y), big.mark = ","),
    " records retained."
  )

  rm(
    landings,
    landings_y
  )

  invisible(gc())
}

landings_ally <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  landings_list
)

if (nrow(landings_ally) == 0L) {
```

```{r step1-27-compare-and-tune-landings, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
required_objects <- c(

}

if (!exists("normalise_gsa_code", mode = "function")) {

required_fdi_columns <- c(

missing_fdi_columns <- setdiff(

if (length(missing_fdi_columns) > 0L) {

}

required_logbook_columns <- c(

missing_logbook_columns <- setdiff(

if (length(missing_logbook_columns) > 0L) {

}

years_to_submit_checked <- unique(
  suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(as.character(years_to_submit))
  )
)

species_to_submit_checked <- unique(
  trimws(as.character(species_to_submit))
)

)

if (

) {

}

selected_sub_regions <- paste0(
  "GSA",

)

selected_vessel_lengths <- c(
  "VL1218",
  "VL1824",

df_prod_FDI <- fdiA %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    species = trimws(as.character(.data$species)),
    year = suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(as.character(.data$year))
    ),
    sub_region = paste0(
      "GSA",
      normalise_gsa_code(.data$sub_region)
    ),
    country_code = toupper(
      trimws(as.character(.data$country_code))
    ),
    gear_type = trimws(as.character(.data$gear_type)),
    vessel_length = toupper(
      trimws(as.character(.data$vessel_length))
    ),
    FDI = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(.data$totwghtlandg))
    ) * 1000
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$species %in% species_to_submit_checked,
    .data$year %in% years_to_submit_checked,
    .data$sub_region %in% selected_sub_regions,
    .data$country_code == .smart31_case$domain$country,
    .data$gear_type %in% gears_to_submit_checked,
    .data$vessel_length %in% selected_vessel_lengths
  )

if (
  anyNA(df_prod_FDI$FDI) ||
  any(!is.finite(df_prod_FDI$FDI)) ||
  any(df_prod_FDI$FDI < 0)
) {
  stop(
    "Missing, non-finite or negative FDI landings were found ",
    "after filtering fdiA."
  )
}

df_prod_FDI <- df_prod_FDI %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$year,
    .data$gear_type,
    .data$species,
    .data$sub_region
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    FDI = sum(.data$FDI),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

landings_ally_agg <- landings_ally %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    year = suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(as.character(.data$year))
    ),
    gear_type = trimws(as.character(.data$gear_type)),
    species = trimws(as.character(.data$species)),
    sub_region = trimws(as.character(.data$sub_region)),
    Mably = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(.data$Mably))
    )
  )

if (
  anyNA(landings_ally_agg$Mably) ||
  any(!is.finite(landings_ally_agg$Mably)) ||
  any(landings_ally_agg$Mably < 0)
) {
  stop(
    "landings_ally contains missing, non-finite or negative Mably values."
  )
}

landings_ally_agg <- landings_ally_agg %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$year,
    .data$gear_type,
    .data$species,
    .data$sub_region
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mably = sum(.data$Mably),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comparison_keys <- c(
  "year",
  "gear_type",
  "species",
  "sub_region"
)

df_compare <- dplyr::full_join(
  landings_ally_agg,
  df_prod_FDI,
  by = comparison_keys
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$Mably) & !is.na(.data$FDI) ~ "matched",
      !is.na(.data$Mably) &  is.na(.data$FDI) ~ "logbook_only",
       is.na(.data$Mably) & !is.na(.data$FDI) ~ "FDI_only",
      TRUE ~ "unclassified"
    ),

    calibration_factor = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$source_status == "matched" &
        .data$Mably > 0 ~ .data$FDI / .data$Mably,

      .data$source_status == "logbook_only" ~ 1,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    rate = .data$calibration_factor
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$species,
    .data$year,
    .data$gear_type,
    .data$sub_region
  )

comparison_status_summary <- df_compare %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data$source_status,
    name = "n_combinations"
  )

comparison_plot_data <- df_compare %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$source_status == "matched",
    is.finite(.data$Mably),
    is.finite(.data$FDI)
  )

if (nrow(comparison_plot_data) == 0L) {
  stop("No matched FDI–logbook combinations are available for plotting.")
}

png_coords <- comparison_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$species) %>%

    ),

      probs = 0.60,

      names = FALSE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    silhouette = file.path(
      "png",
      paste0(.data$species, ".png")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(file.exists(.data$silhouette))

gcomp <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = comparison_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$Mably,
    y = .data$FDI,
    fill = .data$gear_type,
    colour = .data$gear_type
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(
    slope = 1,

  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    shape = 21,

  ) +

  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Comparison between FDI and logbook landings",

    x = "Logbook landings (kg)",

  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_test(
    base_size = 11

  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

    ),

if (
  nrow(png_coords) > 0L &&
  requireNamespace("ggimage", quietly = TRUE)
) {
  gcomp <- gcomp +
    ggimage::geom_image(
      data = png_coords,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data$x,
        y = .data$y,

      ),

      size = 0.40
    )
}

print(gcomp)

df_rate <- df_compare %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$source_status == "matched",
    .data$Mably > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$gear_type,
    .data$year,
    .data$species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mably = sum(.data$Mably),
    FDI = sum(.data$FDI),
    rate = .data$FDI / .data$Mably,
    n_sub_regions = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

landings_adjustment <- 1

if (
  !is.numeric(landings_adjustment) ||
  length(landings_adjustment) != 1L ||
  is.na(landings_adjustment) ||
  !is.finite(landings_adjustment) ||
  landings_adjustment <= 0
) {
  stop("landings_adjustment must be a single positive numeric value.")
}

calibration_table <- df_compare %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$Mably)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(comparison_keys),
    rate = .data$calibration_factor,
    source_status = .data$source_status
  )

if (anyDuplicated(calibration_table[comparison_keys])) {
  stop("Duplicated calibration keys were found in calibration_table.")
}

for (y in seq_along(years_to_submit_checked)) {

  current_year <- years_to_submit_checked[y]
  landings_y <- landings_list[[y]]

  required_annual_columns <- c(
    "year",
    "Month",
    "CFR",
    "gear_type",
    "Metier",
    "species",
    "sub_region",
    "Mably"
  )

  missing_annual_columns <- setdiff(
    required_annual_columns,
    names(landings_y)
  )

  if (length(missing_annual_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "landings_list[[",
      y,
      "]] is missing the following columns: ",
      paste(missing_annual_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  rows_before_join <- nrow(landings_y)

  landings_y <- landings_y %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      calibration_table,
      by = comparison_keys
    )

  if (nrow(landings_y) != rows_before_join) {
    stop(
      "The calibration join changed the number of logbook records for ",
      current_year,
      ". Check for duplicated calibration keys."
    )
  }

  if (anyNA(landings_y$rate)) {
    stop(
      "Missing calibration factors remain for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  landings_y <- landings_y %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Kg = .data$Mably *
        landings_adjustment *
        .data$rate
    )

  if (
    anyNA(landings_y$Kg) ||
    any(!is.finite(landings_y$Kg)) ||
    any(landings_y$Kg < 0)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Invalid calibrated landings were produced for ",
      current_year,
      "."
    )
  }

  landings_y <- landings_y %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Year = .data$year,
      Month = .data$Month,
      CFR = .data$CFR,
      Gear = .data$gear_type,
      Metier = .data$Metier,
      Species = .data$species,
      GSA_LB = .data$sub_region,
      Kg = .data$Kg
    )

  landings_list[[y]] <- landings_y
}

landings_tuning_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  landings_list
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    year = .data$Year,
    gear_type = .data$Gear,
    species = .data$Species,
    sub_region = .data$GSA_LB
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    tuned_kg = sum(.data$Kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_compare %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(comparison_keys),
        .data$Mably,
        .data$FDI,
        .data$source_status,
        .data$calibration_factor
      ),
    by = comparison_keys
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    expected_kg = .data$Mably *
      landings_adjustment *
      .data$calibration_factor,
    difference_kg = .data$tuned_kg - .data$expected_kg
  )

maximum_tuning_difference <- max(
  abs(landings_tuning_check$difference_kg),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

tuning_tolerance <- max(
  1e-6,
  1e-10 * max(
    landings_tuning_check$expected_kg,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

if (maximum_tuning_difference > tuning_tolerance) {
  stop(
    "The calibrated landings failed the aggregation check. ",
    "Maximum difference: ",
    maximum_tuning_difference,
    " kg."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nFDI and logbook landings compared and calibrated successfully:\n",
  "  FDI combinations: ",
  format(nrow(df_prod_FDI), big.mark = ","),
  "\n  logbook combinations: ",
  format(nrow(landings_ally_agg), big.mark = ","),
  "\n  matched combinations: ",
  format(
    sum(df_compare$source_status == "matched"),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n  logbook-only combinations: ",
  format(
    sum(df_compare$source_status == "logbook_only"),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n  FDI-only combinations: ",
  format(
    sum(df_compare$source_status == "FDI_only"),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n  adjustment multiplier: ",
  landings_adjustment,
  "\n  maximum aggregation difference: ",
  format(maximum_tuning_difference, scientific = TRUE),
  " kg\n",
  sep = ""
)

smart31_preview_table(comparison_status_summary, "Coverage of the SMART–FDI landings comparison")
```

```{r step1-28-landings-summary-plot, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
if (

  )
}

species_lookup <- fao3 %>%

    ),
    scientific_name = trimws(
      as.character(.data$scientific_name)

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    )

  dplyr::distinct()

conflicting_species_names <- species_lookup %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$scientific_name)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data$Species,
    name = "n_names"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$n_names > 1L
  )

if (nrow(conflicting_species_names) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Multiple scientific names are associated with the following FAO codes: ",
    paste(
      conflicting_species_names$Species,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

species_lookup <- species_lookup %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    scientific_name = {
      valid_names <- stats::na.omit(.data$scientific_name)

      if (length(valid_names) == 0L) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        valid_names[[1L]]
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conflicting_species_names <- species_lookup %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$scientific_name)) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data$Species,
    name = "n_names"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$n_names > 1L)

if (nrow(conflicting_species_names) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Multiple scientific names are associated with the following FAO codes: ",
    paste(
      conflicting_species_names$Species,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

species_lookup <- species_lookup %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    scientific_name = dplyr::first(
      stats::na.omit(.data$scientific_name),
      default = NA_character_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summarized_list <- lapply(
  landings_list,
  function(x) {

    x %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Year = suppressWarnings(
          as.integer(as.character(.data$Year))
        ),
        Species = toupper(
          trimws(as.character(.data$Species))
        ),
        Gear = trimws(
          as.character(.data$Gear)
        ),
        Kg = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(as.character(.data$Kg))
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$Year,
        .data$Species,
        .data$Gear
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Kg = sum(.data$Kg, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
)

landings_agg <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarized_list
)

if (nrow(landings_agg) == 0L) {
  stop("No landings records are available for the summary plot.")
}

if (
  anyNA(landings_agg$Year) ||
  anyNA(landings_agg$Species) ||
  anyNA(landings_agg$Gear)
) {
  stop(
    "Missing Year, Species or Gear values were found in the ",
    "aggregated landings."
  )
}

if (
  anyNA(landings_agg$Kg) ||
  any(!is.finite(landings_agg$Kg)) ||
  any(landings_agg$Kg < 0)
) {
  stop(
    "Missing, non-finite or negative landings were found after aggregation."
  )
}

landings_agg <- landings_agg %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Year,
    .data$Species,
    .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Kg = sum(.data$Kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    name = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(.data$scientific_name),
      .data$Species,
      paste0(
        .data$scientific_name,
        " (",
        .data$Species,
        ")"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$Year,
    .data$Gear,
    dplyr::desc(.data$Kg)
  )

species_order <- landings_agg %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_Kg = sum(.data$Kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(.data$total_Kg),
    .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$Species)

species_axis_labels <- landings_agg %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$Species,
    .data$name
  ) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

landings_agg <- landings_agg %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(
      .data$Species,

      levels = rev(species_order),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

landings_plot_data <- landings_agg %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = factor(
      .data$Year,
      levels = sort(unique(.data$Year)),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    landings_t = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Kg > 0,
      .data$Kg / 1000,
      NA_real_
    ),
    tile_label = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Kg > 0,
      scales::label_number(
        accuracy = 0.1,
        big.mark = ",",
        trim = TRUE
      )(.data$Kg / 1000),
      "0"
    )
  )

zero_landings_groups <- sum(
  landings_agg$Kg == 0
)

if (!any(is.finite(landings_plot_data$landings_t))) {
  stop("All aggregated landings are zero; a log-scale plot cannot be produced.")
}

landing_log_values <- log10(
  landings_plot_data$landings_t[
    is.finite(landings_plot_data$landings_t)
  ]
)

dark_text_threshold <- stats::quantile(
  landing_log_values,
  probs = 0.70,
  names = FALSE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

landings_plot_data <- landings_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tile_text_colour = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.finite(.data$landings_t) ~ "#27343B",
      log10(.data$landings_t) >= dark_text_threshold ~ "#17202A",
      TRUE ~ "#FFFFFF"
    )
  )

glg <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = landings_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$Year,
    y = .data$Species,
    fill = .data$landings_t
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    width = 0.96,
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(
      label = .data$tile_label,
      colour = .data$tile_text_colour
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_identity() +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
    labels = species_axis_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    direction = 1,
    trans = "log10",
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),
    na.value = "#E7ECEF",
    name = "Landings\n(tonnes)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(
    rows = ggplot2::vars(Gear),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Temporal composition of calibrated landings",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Tile labels report tonnes; colour intensity follows a",
      "logarithmic scale"
    ),
    x = "Year",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Grey tiles denote observed zero-valued combinations;",
      "absent combinations are left blank."
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "italic"
    ),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(1.1, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
      colour = "grey35",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )

print(glg)

missing_scientific_names <- landings_agg %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$scientific_name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$Species)

cat(
  "\nLandings summary produced successfully:\n",
  "  years: ",
  dplyr::n_distinct(landings_agg$Year),
  "\n  gears: ",
  dplyr::n_distinct(landings_agg$Gear),
  "\n  species: ",
  dplyr::n_distinct(landings_agg$Species),
  "\n  aggregated combinations: ",
  format(nrow(landings_agg), big.mark = ","),
  "\n  zero-valued combinations shown as grey tiles: ",
  format(zero_landings_groups, big.mark = ","),
  "\n  species without a scientific-name match: ",
  if (length(missing_scientific_names) == 0L) {
    "none"
  } else {
    paste(missing_scientific_names, collapse = ", ")
  },
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Estimate LPUE using logit and NNLS models

```{r step1-29-logit-and-nnls-for-lpue-estimation, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=14}

SMART31_MASS_CONSERVING_LPUE_VERSION <- "2026-08-17.1"

message(
  "SMART3.1 GSA-specific mass-conserving LPUE version: ",
  SMART31_MASS_CONSERVING_LPUE_VERSION
)

required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "sf", "nnls")

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

`%>%` <- dplyr::`%>%`

required_objects <- c(
  "species_to_submit", "gears_to_submit", "years_to_submit", "CS_gsas",
  "landings_list", "effort_gridded_list_wide",
  "effort_gridded_agg_list", "grid_sf", "ranges",
  "Species_LPUE_thrs", "quantile_Logit", "getLPUE"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The mass-conserving LPUE workflow is missing: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!is.function(getLPUE)) {
  stop("'getLPUE' must be a function.", call. = FALSE)
}

required_getLPUE_arguments <- c(
  "xy", "column_quantile", "min_column_sum", "na_effort",
  "zero_effort", "check_duplicates"
)

missing_getLPUE_arguments <- setdiff(
  required_getLPUE_arguments,
  names(formals(getLPUE))
)

if (length(missing_getLPUE_arguments) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "An obsolete getLPUE() has been loaded from GitHub. Missing arguments: ",
    paste(missing_getLPUE_arguments, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!identical(attr(getLPUE, "smart31_version"), "2026-08-11")) {
  stop(
    "The LPUE chunk requires getLPUE() version 2026-08-11.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(landings_list) != length(years_to_submit) ||
    length(effort_gridded_list_wide) != length(years_to_submit) ||
    length(effort_gridded_agg_list) != length(years_to_submit)) {
  stop(
    "landings_list, effort_gridded_list_wide and ",
    "effort_gridded_agg_list must each contain one element per requested year.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!is.numeric(quantile_Logit) || length(quantile_Logit) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(quantile_Logit) || quantile_Logit < 0 ||
    quantile_Logit > 1) {
  stop("quantile_Logit must be one probability in [0, 1].", call. = FALSE)
}

run_logit_diagnostics <- FALSE

logit_training_percentage <- 90
logit_test_percentage <- 10
logit_method <- "rpart"
logit_minimum_cell_effort <- 100
logit_probability_cutoff <- 0.15
logit_seed <- 31L

lpue_cell_quantile <- 0.30
lpue_minimum_cell_effort <- 0
minimum_monthly_target_records <- 2L

apply_global_lpue_cap <- TRUE
global_lpue_cap_probability <- 0.95
minimum_lpue_for_capping <- 0.1

mass_balance_absolute_tolerance_kg <- 1e-6
mass_balance_relative_tolerance <- 1e-10

write_lpue_diagnostic_files <- TRUE

resume_from_allocation <- FALSE

message(
  "[1/7] Requirements checked; logit diagnostics: ",
  if (run_logit_diagnostics) "enabled" else "disabled"
)

if (!resume_from_allocation) {

message("[2/7] Preparing selections and spatial references...")

years_requested <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(
  as_year_integer(years_to_submit, "years_to_submit")
)))

species_requested <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(
  clean_code(species_to_submit)
)))

gears_requested <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(
  clean_code(gears_to_submit)
)))

gsas_requested <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(
  normalize_gsa(CS_gsas)
)))

if (any(lengths(list(
  years_requested, species_requested, gears_requested, gsas_requested
)) == 0L)) {
  stop("At least one normalised selection vector is empty.", call. = FALSE)
}

grid_container <- grid_sf
grid_geometry <- if (inherits(grid_container, c("sf", "data.frame"))) {
  grid_container
} else if (
  is.list(grid_container) && "grid_sf" %in% names(grid_container) &&
    inherits(grid_container$grid_sf, c("sf", "data.frame"))
) {
  grid_container$grid_sf
} else {
  stop(
    "grid_sf must be an sf/data.frame or contain grid_sf$grid_sf.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!exists("grid_gsa_lookup", inherits = TRUE)) {
  if (!exists("GSA", inherits = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Neither grid_gsa_lookup nor the GSA polygon object is available.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  gsa_source <- get("GSA", inherits = TRUE)

  if (!inherits(gsa_source, "sf")) {
    stop("'GSA' must be an sf polygon object.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  candidate_gsa_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      "SMU_CODE", "F_GSA", "F_GSA_LIB", "SECT_COD", "TSECT_COD",
      "SMU_NAME", "SMU_NAME_F", "F_DIVISION", "F_SUBAREA", "F_AREA"
    ),
    names(gsa_source)
  )

  if (length(candidate_gsa_columns) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No recognised GSA-code column was found in the GSA polygons. ",
      "Available columns: ", paste(names(gsa_source), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  gsa_column_score <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
    candidate_gsa_columns,
    function(column_name) {
      normalised_values <- normalize_gsa(
        gsa_source[[column_name]],
        strict = FALSE
      )
      matched <- intersect(gsas_requested, unique(normalised_values))

      tibble::tibble(
        column = column_name,
        n_selected_gsas_matched = length(matched),
        n_matching_features = sum(
          normalised_values %in% gsas_requested,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_non_missing_codes = sum(!is.na(normalised_values))
      )
    }
  )) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_selected_gsas_matched),
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_matching_features),
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_non_missing_codes)
    )

  if (nrow(gsa_column_score) == 0L ||
      gsa_column_score$n_selected_gsas_matched[1L] < length(gsas_requested)) {
    stop(
      "No single GSA polygon field represents every selected GSA: ",
      paste(gsas_requested, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  selected_gsa_column <- gsa_column_score$column[1L]

  gsa_polygons <- gsa_source %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      GSA_code = normalize_gsa(
        .data[[selected_gsa_column]],
        strict = FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$GSA_code) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(.groups = "drop")

  missing_gsa_polygons <- setdiff(
    gsas_requested,
    unique(gsa_polygons$GSA_code)
  )

  if (length(missing_gsa_polygons) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Selected GSA polygons are missing for: ",
      paste(missing_gsa_polygons, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!inherits(grid_geometry, "sf")) {
    stop(
      "An sf grid is required to derive grid_gsa_lookup from GSA polygons.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  grid_points_for_gsa <- grid_geometry %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid))) %>%
    sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(gsa_polygons)) %>%
    sf::st_point_on_surface()

  grid_gsa_lookup <- sf::st_join(
    grid_points_for_gsa,
    gsa_polygons,
    join = sf::st_within,
    left = TRUE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry()

  rm(
    gsa_source, candidate_gsa_columns, gsa_column_score,
    selected_gsa_column, gsa_polygons, missing_gsa_polygons,
    grid_points_for_gsa
  )
}

grid_gsa_plain <- drop_geometry(grid_gsa_lookup)

if (!all(c("id_grid", "GSA_code") %in% names(grid_gsa_plain))) {
  stop("grid_gsa_lookup must contain id_grid and GSA_code.", call. = FALSE)
}

grid_gsa_key <- grid_gsa_plain %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
    GSA_code = normalize_gsa(.data$GSA_code, strict = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$id_grid), nzchar(.data$id_grid),
    .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

conflicting_grid_gsa <- grid_gsa_key %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$id_grid) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_assignments = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$GSA_code),
    candidate_GSAs = paste(
      sort(unique(.data$GSA_code)),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$n_assignments > 1L)

grid_gsa_boundary_conflicts <- conflicting_grid_gsa

if (nrow(conflicting_grid_gsa) > 0L) {

  if (
    !inherits(grid_geometry, "sf") ||
      !exists("GSA", inherits = TRUE) ||
      !inherits(get("GSA", inherits = TRUE), "sf")
  ) {
    stop(
      nrow(conflicting_grid_gsa),
      " grid cells have more than one GSA assignment, but polygon geometry ",
      "is unavailable for deterministic largest-overlap resolution. Inspect ",
      "'conflicting_grid_gsa'.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  conflict_gsa_source <- get("GSA", inherits = TRUE)
  conflict_candidate_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      "SMU_CODE", "F_GSA", "F_GSA_LIB", "SECT_COD", "TSECT_COD",
      "SMU_NAME", "SMU_NAME_F", "F_DIVISION", "F_SUBAREA", "F_AREA"
    ),
    names(conflict_gsa_source)
  )

  if (length(conflict_candidate_columns) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No recognised GSA-code column is available to resolve ambiguous ",
      "grid cells. Inspect names(GSA).",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  conflict_column_score <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
    conflict_candidate_columns,
    function(column_name) {
      normalised_values <- normalize_gsa(
        conflict_gsa_source[[column_name]],
        strict = FALSE
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        column = column_name,
        n_selected_gsas_matched = length(intersect(
          gsas_requested,
          unique(normalised_values)
        )),
        n_matching_features = sum(
          normalised_values %in% gsas_requested,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_non_missing_codes = sum(!is.na(normalised_values))
      )
    }
  )) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_selected_gsas_matched),
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_matching_features),
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_non_missing_codes),
      .data$column
    )

  if (
    nrow(conflict_column_score) == 0L ||
      conflict_column_score$n_selected_gsas_matched[1L] <
        length(gsas_requested)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The GSA polygon field required to resolve ambiguous grid cells could ",
      "not be identified. Inspect 'conflict_column_score'.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  conflict_gsa_column <- conflict_column_score$column[1L]

  conflict_gsa_polygons <- conflict_gsa_source %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      GSA_code = normalize_gsa(
        .data[[conflict_gsa_column]],
        strict = FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$GSA_code) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(.groups = "drop")

  conflict_grid_geometry <- grid_geometry %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$id_grid %in% conflicting_grid_gsa$id_grid
    ) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(conflict_gsa_polygons))

  grid_gsa_overlap_candidates <- suppressWarnings(
    sf::st_intersection(
      conflict_grid_geometry,
      conflict_gsa_polygons
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      overlap_area = as.numeric(sf::st_area(.))
    ) %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      grid_gsa_key,
      by = c("id_grid", "GSA_code"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$overlap_area),
      .data$overlap_area > 0
    )

  grid_gsa_conflict_resolution <- grid_gsa_overlap_candidates %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$id_grid,
      dplyr::desc(.data$overlap_area),
      .data$GSA_code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      second_largest_overlap_area = dplyr::if_else(
        dplyr::n() > 1L,
        dplyr::nth(.data$overlap_area, 2L),
        0
      ),
      overlap_margin = .data$overlap_area -
        .data$second_largest_overlap_area
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$id_grid,
      selected_GSA_code = .data$GSA_code,
      selected_overlap_area = .data$overlap_area,
      .data$second_largest_overlap_area,
      .data$overlap_margin
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      conflicting_grid_gsa,
      by = "id_grid",
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    )

  unresolved_grid_gsa_conflicts <- conflicting_grid_gsa %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      grid_gsa_conflict_resolution,
      by = "id_grid"
    )

  if (nrow(unresolved_grid_gsa_conflicts) > 0L) {
    stop(
      nrow(unresolved_grid_gsa_conflicts),
      " ambiguous grid-cell GSA assignments could not be resolved by ",
      "polygon overlap. Inspect 'unresolved_grid_gsa_conflicts'.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  grid_gsa_key <- grid_gsa_key %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      conflicting_grid_gsa %>% dplyr::select(.data$id_grid),
      by = "id_grid"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      grid_gsa_conflict_resolution %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          id_grid = .data$id_grid,
          GSA_code = .data$selected_GSA_code
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$id_grid)

  message(
    "Resolved ",
    nrow(grid_gsa_conflict_resolution),
    " ambiguous grid-cell GSA assignments using largest polygon overlap."
  )
}

unassigned_grid_geometry <- grid_geometry %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !.data$id_grid %in% grid_gsa_key$id_grid
  ) %>%
  sf::st_make_valid()

if (nrow(unassigned_grid_geometry) > 0L) {
  if (
    !exists("GSA", inherits = TRUE) ||
      !inherits(get("GSA", inherits = TRUE), "sf")
  ) {
    stop(
      nrow(unassigned_grid_geometry),
      " grid cells have no point-based GSA assignment, but the official ",
      "GSA polygon geometry is unavailable for overlap repair.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  overlap_gsa_source <- get("GSA", inherits = TRUE)
  overlap_candidate_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      "SMU_CODE", "F_GSA", "F_GSA_LIB", "SECT_COD", "TSECT_COD",
      "SMU_NAME", "SMU_NAME_F", "F_DIVISION", "F_SUBAREA", "F_AREA"
    ),
    names(overlap_gsa_source)
  )

  if (length(overlap_candidate_columns) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No recognised GSA-code column is available for coastal overlap ",
      "repair. Inspect names(GSA).",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  overlap_column_score <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
    overlap_candidate_columns,
    function(column_name) {
      normalised_values <- normalize_gsa(
        overlap_gsa_source[[column_name]],
        strict = FALSE
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        column = column_name,
        n_selected_gsas_matched = length(intersect(
          gsas_requested,
          unique(normalised_values)
        )),
        n_matching_features = sum(
          normalised_values %in% gsas_requested,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_non_missing_codes = sum(!is.na(normalised_values))
      )
    }
  )) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_selected_gsas_matched),
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_matching_features),
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_non_missing_codes),
      .data$column
    )

  if (
    nrow(overlap_column_score) == 0L ||
      overlap_column_score$n_selected_gsas_matched[1L] <
        length(gsas_requested)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The official polygon field required for coastal grid-GSA overlap ",
      "repair could not be identified. Inspect 'overlap_column_score'.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  overlap_gsa_column <- overlap_column_score$column[1L]

  overlap_gsa_polygons <- overlap_gsa_source %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      GSA_code = normalize_gsa(
        .data[[overlap_gsa_column]],
        strict = FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$GSA_code) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
    sf::st_transform(3035)

  unassigned_grid_metric <- unassigned_grid_geometry %>%
    sf::st_transform(3035) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      grid_cell_area_m2 = as.numeric(sf::st_area(.))
    )

  grid_gsa_missing_overlap_candidates <- suppressWarnings(
    sf::st_intersection(
      unassigned_grid_metric,
      overlap_gsa_polygons
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      overlap_area_m2 = as.numeric(sf::st_area(.)),
      overlap_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(.data$grid_cell_area_m2) &
          .data$grid_cell_area_m2 > 0,
        .data$overlap_area_m2 / .data$grid_cell_area_m2,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$overlap_area_m2),
      .data$overlap_area_m2 > 0,
      is.finite(.data$overlap_fraction),
      .data$overlap_fraction > 0
    )

  grid_gsa_missing_overlap_resolution <-
    grid_gsa_missing_overlap_candidates %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$id_grid,
      dplyr::desc(.data$overlap_area_m2),
      .data$GSA_code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      second_largest_overlap_area_m2 = dplyr::if_else(
        dplyr::n() > 1L,
        dplyr::nth(.data$overlap_area_m2, 2L),
        0
      ),
      overlap_margin_m2 = .data$overlap_area_m2 -
        .data$second_largest_overlap_area_m2
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      id_grid = .data$id_grid,
      selected_GSA_code = .data$GSA_code,
      grid_cell_area_m2 = .data$grid_cell_area_m2,
      selected_overlap_area_m2 = .data$overlap_area_m2,
      selected_overlap_fraction = .data$overlap_fraction,
      second_largest_overlap_area_m2 =
        .data$second_largest_overlap_area_m2,
      overlap_margin_m2 = .data$overlap_margin_m2,
      assignment_method = "largest_positive_cell_polygon_overlap"
    )

  grid_gsa_missing_no_overlap <- unassigned_grid_geometry %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      grid_gsa_missing_overlap_resolution %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$id_grid),
      by = "id_grid"
    )

  grid_gsa_key <- grid_gsa_key %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      grid_gsa_missing_overlap_resolution %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          id_grid = .data$id_grid,
          GSA_code = .data$selected_GSA_code
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$id_grid)

  message(
    "Assigned ",
    nrow(grid_gsa_missing_overlap_resolution),
    " coastal grid cells using largest positive GSA overlap; ",
    nrow(grid_gsa_missing_no_overlap),
    " cells have no positive overlap with a selected GSA."
  )
} else {
  grid_gsa_missing_overlap_candidates <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = character(),
    GSA_code = character(),
    grid_cell_area_m2 = numeric(),
    overlap_area_m2 = numeric(),
    overlap_fraction = numeric()
  )

  grid_gsa_missing_overlap_resolution <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = character(),
    selected_GSA_code = character(),
    grid_cell_area_m2 = numeric(),
    selected_overlap_area_m2 = numeric(),
    selected_overlap_fraction = numeric(),
    second_largest_overlap_area_m2 = numeric(),
    overlap_margin_m2 = numeric(),
    assignment_method = character()
  )

  grid_gsa_missing_no_overlap <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = character()
  )
}

gsa_nearest_distance_limit_m <- 1000
gsa_nearest_tie_tolerance_m <- 1e-6

if (!exists("effort_sf_gridded_list", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !is.list(effort_sf_gridded_list)) {
  stop(
    "'effort_sf_gridded_list' is required to identify activity-supported ",
    "coastal cells for nearest-GSA repair.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

observed_activity_grid_ids <- unique(unlist(lapply(
  effort_sf_gridded_list,
  function(activity_table) {
    if (is.null(activity_table) ||
        !"id_grid" %in% names(activity_table)) {
      return(character())
    }

    trimws(as.character(activity_table$id_grid))
  }
)))

no_overlap_activity_grid_ids <- intersect(
  grid_gsa_missing_no_overlap$id_grid,
  observed_activity_grid_ids
)

if (length(no_overlap_activity_grid_ids) > 0L) {
  if (!exists("overlap_gsa_polygons", inherits = FALSE) ||
      !inherits(overlap_gsa_polygons, "sf")) {
    stop(
      length(no_overlap_activity_grid_ids),
      " activity-supported coastal cells require nearest-GSA repair, but ",
      "the official GSA polygons are unavailable.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  nearest_activity_grid <- grid_geometry %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$id_grid %in% no_overlap_activity_grid_ids
    ) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    sf::st_transform(3035) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$id_grid)

  if (nrow(nearest_activity_grid) !=
      length(no_overlap_activity_grid_ids)) {
    stop(
      "Not every activity-supported no-overlap cell was found in the ",
      "analytical grid geometry.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  nearest_distance_matrix <- as.matrix(sf::st_distance(
    nearest_activity_grid,
    overlap_gsa_polygons
  ))

  grid_gsa_nearest_distance_candidates <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = rep(
      nearest_activity_grid$id_grid,
      each = nrow(overlap_gsa_polygons)
    ),
    GSA_code = rep(
      overlap_gsa_polygons$GSA_code,
      times = nrow(nearest_activity_grid)
    ),
    distance_m = as.numeric(t(nearest_distance_matrix))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$distance_m))

  grid_gsa_nearest_assignment_audit <-
    grid_gsa_nearest_distance_candidates %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$id_grid,
      .data$distance_m,
      .data$GSA_code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_candidate_gsas = dplyr::n(),
      second_nearest_distance_m = dplyr::if_else(
        dplyr::n() > 1L,
        dplyr::nth(.data$distance_m, 2L),
        Inf
      ),
      nearest_distance_margin_m =
        .data$second_nearest_distance_m - .data$distance_m
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      distance_limit_m = gsa_nearest_distance_limit_m,
      tied_nearest_gsa = .data$n_candidate_gsas > 1L &
        abs(.data$nearest_distance_margin_m) <=
          gsa_nearest_tie_tolerance_m,
      accepted = .data$distance_m <=
        .data$distance_limit_m + gsa_nearest_tie_tolerance_m &
        !.data$tied_nearest_gsa,
      assignment_method = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$accepted,
        "nearest_official_gsa_within_1km_domain_buffer",
        "unresolved_no_overlap_or_nearest_gsa_tie"
      )
    )

  grid_gsa_nearest_resolution <-
    grid_gsa_nearest_assignment_audit %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$accepted) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      id_grid = .data$id_grid,
      GSA_code = .data$GSA_code
    )

  grid_gsa_nearest_unresolved <-
    grid_gsa_nearest_assignment_audit %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$accepted)

  grid_gsa_key <- grid_gsa_key %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(grid_gsa_nearest_resolution) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$id_grid)

  message(
    "Assigned ",
    nrow(grid_gsa_nearest_resolution),
    " activity-supported cells to the nearest official GSA within ",
    gsa_nearest_distance_limit_m,
    " m; ",
    nrow(grid_gsa_nearest_unresolved),
    " activity-supported cells remain unresolved."
  )
} else {
  grid_gsa_nearest_distance_candidates <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = character(),
    GSA_code = character(),
    distance_m = numeric()
  )

  grid_gsa_nearest_assignment_audit <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = character(),
    GSA_code = character(),
    distance_m = numeric(),
    n_candidate_gsas = integer(),
    second_nearest_distance_m = numeric(),
    nearest_distance_margin_m = numeric(),
    distance_limit_m = numeric(),
    tied_nearest_gsa = logical(),
    accepted = logical(),
    assignment_method = character()
  )

  grid_gsa_nearest_resolution <- tibble::tibble(
    id_grid = character(),
    GSA_code = character()
  )

  grid_gsa_nearest_unresolved <-
    grid_gsa_nearest_assignment_audit
}

if (anyDuplicated(grid_gsa_key$id_grid)) {
  stop(
    "The canonical grid-GSA key is not unique after conflict resolution.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

grid_gsa_lookup <- drop_geometry(grid_geometry) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    grid_gsa_key,
    by = "id_grid",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

grid_depth_plain <- drop_geometry(grid_geometry)

if (!all(c("id_grid", "depth") %in% names(grid_depth_plain))) {
  stop("The spatial grid must contain id_grid and depth.", call. = FALSE)
}

grid_depth_key <- grid_depth_plain %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
    depth_m = as_numeric_strict(.data$depth, "grid depth")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$id_grid), nzchar(.data$id_grid)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$id_grid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    grid_gsa_key,
    by = "id_grid",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

if (all(c("species_code", "min_depth_m", "max_depth_m") %in% names(ranges))) {
  depth_reference <- ranges %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Species = clean_code(.data$species_code),
      min_depth_m = as_numeric_strict(.data$min_depth_m, "ranges$min_depth_m"),
      max_depth_m = as_numeric_strict(.data$max_depth_m, "ranges$max_depth_m")
    )
} else if (all(c("Species", "minD", "maxD") %in% names(ranges))) {
  depth_reference <- ranges %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Species = clean_code(.data$Species),
      min_depth_m = as_numeric_strict(.data$minD, "ranges$minD"),
      max_depth_m = as_numeric_strict(.data$maxD, "ranges$maxD")
    )
} else {
  stop(
    "ranges lacks a recognised species/depth schema.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

depth_reference <- depth_reference %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$Species %in% species_requested,
    is.finite(.data$min_depth_m),
    is.finite(.data$max_depth_m),
    .data$min_depth_m >= 0,
    .data$max_depth_m >= .data$min_depth_m
  )

if (anyDuplicated(depth_reference$Species)) {
  stop("Depth ranges must be unique by species.", call. = FALSE)
}

missing_depth_species <- setdiff(species_requested, depth_reference$Species)
if (length(missing_depth_species) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Depth ranges are missing for: ",
    paste(missing_depth_species, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

potential_ground_map <- lapply(species_requested, function(species_code) {
  depth_row <- depth_reference[depth_reference$Species == species_code, ]

  grid_depth_key %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$depth_m),
      .data$depth_m >= depth_row$min_depth_m,
      .data$depth_m <= depth_row$max_depth_m
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Species = species_code,
      GSA_code = .data$GSA_code,
      id_grid = .data$id_grid
    )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

missing_ground_combinations <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  Species = species_requested,
  GSA_code = gsas_requested
) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    potential_ground_map %>%
      dplyr::distinct(.data$Species, .data$GSA_code),
    by = c("Species", "GSA_code")
  )

if (nrow(missing_ground_combinations) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "No depth-compatible cells for ",
    paste(
      paste0(
        missing_ground_combinations$Species,
        "/",
        missing_ground_combinations$GSA_code
      ),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!all(c(
  "species_code", "gear_code", "upper_quantile_probability"
) %in% names(Species_LPUE_thrs))) {
  stop(
    "Species_LPUE_thrs must contain species_code, gear_code and ",
    "upper_quantile_probability.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

lpue_cap_reference <- Species_LPUE_thrs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Species = clean_code(.data$species_code),
    Gear = clean_code(.data$gear_code),
    cap_probability = as.numeric(.data$upper_quantile_probability),
    is_configured = if ("is_configured" %in% names(Species_LPUE_thrs)) {
      as.logical(.data$is_configured)
    } else {
      !is.na(.data$upper_quantile_probability)
    }
  )

if (anyDuplicated(lpue_cap_reference[c("Species", "Gear")])) {
  stop("LPUE cap references are not unique by species and gear.", call. = FALSE)
}

invalid_cap <- lpue_cap_reference$is_configured %in% TRUE &
  (!is.finite(lpue_cap_reference$cap_probability) |
     lpue_cap_reference$cap_probability < 0 |
     lpue_cap_reference$cap_probability > 1)

if (any(invalid_cap, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("Configured LPUE cap probabilities are invalid.", call. = FALSE)
}

message("[3/7] Preparing calibrated landing targets...")

calibrated_landing_list <- vector("list", length(landings_list))

for (year_index in seq_along(landings_list)) {
  current_year <- as_year_integer(
    years_to_submit[year_index],
    "years_to_submit"
  )
  current_landings <- landings_list[[year_index]]

  message(
    "  landings year ", current_year, " (", year_index, "/",
    length(landings_list), ")"
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "CFR", "Year", "Month", "Species", "Gear", "GSA_LB", "Kg"
  )
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(current_landings))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "landings_list[[", year_index, "]] is missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  calibrated_landing_list[[year_index]] <- current_landings %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
      YEAR = as_year_integer(.data$Year, "landings Year"),
      MONTH = as_month_integer(.data$Month, "landings Month"),
      Species = clean_code(.data$Species),
      Gear = clean_code(.data$Gear),
      GSA_code = normalize_gsa(.data$GSA_LB, strict = FALSE),
      calibrated_kg = as_numeric_strict(.data$Kg, "landings Kg")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$YEAR == current_year,
      .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
      .data$Species %in% species_requested,
      .data$Gear %in% gears_requested,
      .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested,
      !is.na(.data$CFR), nzchar(.data$CFR),
      !is.na(.data$MONTH),
      is.finite(.data$calibrated_kg),
      .data$calibrated_kg >= 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH,
      .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      calibrated_kg = sum(.data$calibrated_kg),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

calibrated_landings_detail <- dplyr::bind_rows(calibrated_landing_list) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH,
    .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    calibrated_kg = sum(.data$calibrated_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rm(calibrated_landing_list)
invisible(gc())

calibrated_landings_targets <- calibrated_landings_detail %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    calibrated_target_kg = sum(.data$calibrated_kg),
    n_calibrated_vessel_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$calibrated_target_kg),
    .data$calibrated_target_kg > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
    .data$Gear, .data$MONTH
  )

if (nrow(calibrated_landings_targets) == 0L) {
  stop("No positive calibrated landing target is available.", call. = FALSE)
}

message("[4/7] Preparing GSA-specific analytical effort...")

effort_long_list <- vector("list", length(effort_gridded_agg_list))

for (year_index in seq_along(effort_gridded_agg_list)) {
  current_year <- as_year_integer(
    years_to_submit[year_index],
    "years_to_submit"
  )
  current_effort <- effort_gridded_agg_list[[year_index]]

  message(
    "  effort year ", current_year, " (", year_index, "/",
    length(effort_gridded_agg_list), ")"
  )

  if (is.null(current_effort)) next

  current_effort <- drop_geometry(current_effort)
  required_columns <- c("YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear", "id_grid", "effort")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(current_effort))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "effort_gridded_agg_list[[", year_index, "]] is missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  effort_long_list[[year_index]] <- current_effort %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR = as_year_integer(.data$YEAR, "aggregated effort YEAR"),
      MONTH = as_month_integer(.data$MONTH, "aggregated effort MONTH"),
      Gear = clean_code(.data$Gear),
      id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
      effort = as_numeric_strict(.data$effort, "aggregated effort")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$YEAR == current_year,
      .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
      .data$Gear %in% gears_requested,
      !is.na(.data$MONTH),
      !is.na(.data$id_grid), nzchar(.data$id_grid),
      is.finite(.data$effort), .data$effort >= 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      grid_gsa_key,
      by = "id_grid",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
      .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effort = sum(.data$effort),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

df_effort <- dplyr::bind_rows(effort_long_list) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    effort = sum(.data$effort),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
  )

rm(effort_long_list)
invisible(gc())

if (nrow(df_effort) == 0L || any(df_effort$effort < 0)) {
  stop("No valid non-negative analytical effort is available.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (anyDuplicated(df_effort[c(
  "YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"
)])) {
  stop("df_effort is not unique by its analytical key.", call. = FALSE)
}

message(
  "[5/7] Estimating GSA-specific monthly NNLS models ",
  if (run_logit_diagnostics) {
    "(optional logit diagnostics enabled)..."
  } else {
    "(logit diagnostics disabled)..."
  }
)

lpue_raw_results <- list()
lpue_check_results <- list()
lpue_performance_results <- list()
lpue_cell_diagnostic_results <- list()
lpue_observation_diagnostic_results <- list()
logit_performance_results <- list()
logit_classification_results <- list()
workflow_status_results <- list()
threshold_results <- list()

raw_index <- 0L
check_index <- 0L
performance_index <- 0L
cell_index <- 0L
observation_index <- 0L
logit_performance_index <- 0L
logit_classification_index <- 0L
status_index <- 0L
threshold_index <- 0L

for (year_index in seq_along(effort_gridded_list_wide)) {
  current_year <- as_year_integer(
    years_to_submit[year_index],
    "years_to_submit"
  )
  wide_effort <- effort_gridded_list_wide[[year_index]]

  if (is.null(wide_effort)) next

  nnls_year_started_at <- Sys.time()
  message(
    "  NNLS year ", current_year, " (", year_index, "/",
    length(effort_gridded_list_wide), ")"
  )

  required_identifier_columns <- c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_identifier_columns, names(wide_effort))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "effort_gridded_list_wide[[", year_index, "]] is missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  wide_identifiers <- data.frame(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(wide_effort$CFR)),
    YEAR = as_year_integer(wide_effort$YEAR, "wide effort YEAR"),
    MONTH = as_month_integer(wide_effort$MONTH, "wide effort MONTH"),
    Gear = clean_code(wide_effort$Gear),
    source_row = seq_len(nrow(wide_effort)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  relevant_identifier_rows <- wide_identifiers$YEAR == current_year &
    wide_identifiers$YEAR %in% years_requested &
    wide_identifiers$Gear %in% gears_requested &
    !is.na(wide_identifiers$CFR) & nzchar(wide_identifiers$CFR) &
    !is.na(wide_identifiers$MONTH)

  wide_identifiers <- wide_identifiers[relevant_identifier_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(wide_identifiers) == 0L) {
    rm(wide_effort, wide_identifiers, relevant_identifier_rows)
    invisible(gc())
    next
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(wide_identifiers[c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear")])) {
    stop(
      "Duplicated CFR-year-month-gear rows in wide effort for year ",
      current_year, ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  wide_identifiers$effort_key <- paste(
    wide_identifiers$CFR,
    wide_identifiers$YEAR,
    wide_identifiers$MONTH,
    wide_identifiers$Gear,
    sep = "\r"
  )

  for (current_gsa in gsas_requested) {
    message("    processing ", current_gsa)

    for (current_species in species_requested) {
      available_cells <- potential_ground_map %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$GSA_code == current_gsa,
          .data$Species == current_species
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(.data$id_grid) %>%
        intersect(names(wide_effort))

      for (current_gear in gears_requested) {
        combo_landings <- calibrated_landings_detail %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .data$YEAR == current_year,
            .data$GSA_code == current_gsa,
            .data$Species == current_species,
            .data$Gear == current_gear
          )

        if (nrow(combo_landings) == 0L) next

        positive_combo <- combo_landings$calibrated_kg[
          is.finite(combo_landings$calibrated_kg) &
            combo_landings$calibrated_kg > 0
        ]
        biomass_threshold <- threshold_from_positive(positive_combo)

        threshold_index <- threshold_index + 1L
        threshold_results[[threshold_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
          YEAR = current_year,
          GSA_code = current_gsa,
          Species = current_species,
          Gear = current_gear,
          biomass_threshold_kg = biomass_threshold,
          n_positive_landing_records = length(positive_combo),
          positive_landing_kg = sum(positive_combo),
          n_depth_compatible_cells = length(available_cells)
        )

        if (length(available_cells) == 0L) {
          status_index <- status_index + 1L
          workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
            current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
            stage = "potential grounds", status = "skipped",
            detail = "No depth-compatible wide-effort cells."
          )
          next
        }

        gear_identifiers <- wide_identifiers[
          wide_identifiers$Gear == current_gear,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
```
