```{r step1-29-logit-and-nnls-for-lpue-estimation, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
        if (nrow(gear_identifiers) == 0L) {
          status_index <- status_index + 1L
          workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
            current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
            stage = "effort", status = "skipped",
            detail = "No wide effort rows for the requested gear."
          )
          next
        }

        combo_landings <- combo_landings %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            effort_key = paste(
              .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
              sep = "\r"
            ),
            source_row = gear_identifiers$source_row[
              match(.data$effort_key, gear_identifiers$effort_key)
            ],
            has_wide_effort = !is.na(.data$source_row)
          )

        if (isTRUE(run_logit_diagnostics) &&
            length(positive_combo) >= 2L &&
            is.finite(biomass_threshold)) {
          diagnostic_effort <- wide_effort[
            gear_identifiers$source_row,
            available_cells,
            drop = FALSE
          ]
          diagnostic_effort[] <- lapply(diagnostic_effort, function(value) {
            numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(value)))
            numeric_value[!is.finite(numeric_value)] <- 0
            numeric_value
          })

          landing_match <- match(
            gear_identifiers$effort_key,
            combo_landings$effort_key
          )
          diagnostic_biomass <- combo_landings$calibrated_kg[landing_match]
          diagnostic_biomass[is.na(diagnostic_biomass)] <- 0

          logit_result <- tryCatch(
            getLogit(
              Lit = diagnostic_biomass,
              X = diagnostic_effort,
              thrB = biomass_threshold,
              ptrain = logit_training_percentage,
              ptest = logit_test_percentage,
              method = logit_method,
              lower_value = logit_minimum_cell_effort,
              probability_cutoff = logit_probability_cutoff,
              seed = logit_seed + year_index * 10000L +
                match(current_gsa, gsas_requested) * 1000L +
                match(current_species, species_requested) * 10L +
                match(current_gear, gears_requested)
            ),
            error = function(e) e
          )

          if (inherits(logit_result, "error")) {
            status_index <- status_index + 1L
            workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
              current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
              stage = "classification", status = "failed",
              detail = paste0(
                conditionMessage(logit_result),
                " LPUE estimation continues independently."
              )
            )
          } else {
            logit_performance_index <- logit_performance_index + 1L
            logit_performance_results[[logit_performance_index]] <-
              dplyr::bind_cols(
                tibble::tibble(
                  YEAR = current_year,
                  GSA_code = current_gsa,
                  Species = current_species,
                  Gear = current_gear,
                  biomass_threshold_kg = biomass_threshold
                ),
                logit_result$performance
              )

            logit_classification_index <- logit_classification_index + 1L
            logit_classification_results[[logit_classification_index]] <-
              dplyr::bind_cols(
                gear_identifiers %>%
                  dplyr::select(
                    .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear
                  ) %>%
                  dplyr::mutate(
                    GSA_code = current_gsa,
                    Species = current_species
                  ),
                logit_result$predictions
              )

            status_index <- status_index + 1L
            workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
              current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
              stage = "classification", status = "completed",
              detail = "Diagnostic classification completed; predictions unused."
            )
          }

          rm(
            diagnostic_effort, landing_match,
            diagnostic_biomass, logit_result
          )
        }

        for (current_month in sort(unique(combo_landings$MONTH))) {
          monthly_landing_records <- combo_landings %>%
            dplyr::filter(.data$MONTH == current_month)

          monthly_target_records <- monthly_landing_records %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              is.finite(.data$calibrated_kg),
              is.finite(biomass_threshold),
              .data$calibrated_kg > biomass_threshold
            )

          if (nrow(monthly_target_records) < minimum_monthly_target_records) {
            status_index <- status_index + 1L
            workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
              current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
              current_month,
              stage = "LPUE", status = "skipped",
              detail = paste0(
                "Only ", nrow(monthly_target_records),
                " GSA-specific record(s) exceed the biomass threshold."
              )
            )
            next
          }

          model_records <- monthly_target_records %>%
            dplyr::filter(.data$has_wide_effort)

          if (nrow(model_records) < minimum_monthly_target_records) {
            status_index <- status_index + 1L
            workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
              current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
              current_month,
              stage = "LPUE", status = "skipped",
              detail = paste0(
                "Only ", nrow(model_records),
                " threshold-selected record(s) have wide effort."
              )
            )
            next
          }

          model_effort <- wide_effort[
            model_records$source_row,
            available_cells,
            drop = FALSE
          ]
          model_effort[] <- lapply(model_effort, function(value) {
            numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(value)))
            numeric_value[!is.finite(numeric_value)] <- 0
            numeric_value
          })

          if (any(as.matrix(model_effort) < 0)) {
            stop(
              "Negative wide effort in ", current_year, "/", current_gsa,
              "/", current_species, "/", current_gear,
              "/month ", current_month, ".",
              call. = FALSE
            )
          }

          model_input <- data.frame(
            CFR = model_records$CFR,
            YEAR = model_records$YEAR,
            MONTH = factor(month.name[current_month], levels = month.name),
            Gear = model_records$Gear,
            Kg = model_records$calibrated_kg,
            model_effort,
            check.names = FALSE,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )

          lpue_result <- tryCatch(
            suppressWarnings(getLPUE(
              model_input,
              column_quantile = lpue_cell_quantile,
              min_column_sum = lpue_minimum_cell_effort,
              na_effort = "zero",
              zero_effort = "remove",
              check_duplicates = TRUE
            )),
            error = function(e) e
          )

          if (inherits(lpue_result, "error")) {
            status_index <- status_index + 1L
            workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
              current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
              current_month,
              stage = "LPUE", status = "failed",
              detail = conditionMessage(lpue_result)
            )
          } else {
            raw_index <- raw_index + 1L
            lpue_raw_results[[raw_index]] <- lpue_result$lpue %>%
              dplyr::transmute(
                YEAR = current_year,
                MONTH = current_month,
                GSA_code = current_gsa,
                Species = current_species,
                Gear = current_gear,
                id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
                lpue_raw = as.numeric(.data$lpue)
              )

            check_index <- check_index + 1L
            lpue_check_results[[check_index]] <- lpue_result$df_check %>%
              dplyr::transmute(
                YEAR = current_year,
                MONTH = current_month,
                GSA_code = current_gsa,
                Species = current_species,
                Gear = current_gear,
                obs = as.numeric(.data$obs),
                fitted = as.numeric(.data$fitted),
                residual = as.numeric(.data$residual)
              )

            performance_index <- performance_index + 1L
            lpue_performance_results[[performance_index]] <-
              dplyr::bind_cols(
                tibble::tibble(
                  YEAR = current_year,
                  MONTH = current_month,
                  GSA_code = current_gsa,
                  Species = current_species,
                  Gear = current_gear,
                  monthly_calibrated_input_kg = sum(
                    monthly_landing_records$calibrated_kg
                  ),
                  threshold_selected_input_kg = sum(
                    monthly_target_records$calibrated_kg
                  ),
                  model_input_kg = sum(model_records$calibrated_kg),
                  nnls_used_observed_kg = sum(lpue_result$df_check$obs),
                  nnls_fitted_kg = sum(lpue_result$df_check$fitted)
                ),
                lpue_result$performance
              )

            cell_index <- cell_index + 1L
            lpue_cell_diagnostic_results[[cell_index]] <-
              lpue_result$cell_diagnostics %>%
              dplyr::transmute(
                YEAR = current_year,
                MONTH = current_month,
                GSA_code = current_gsa,
                Species = current_species,
                Gear = current_gear,
                id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
                total_model_effort = as.numeric(.data$total_effort),
                eligible_before_quantile = as.logical(
                  .data$eligible_before_quantile
                ),
                quantile_threshold = as.numeric(.data$quantile_threshold),
                retained = as.logical(.data$retained),
                exclusion_reason = as.character(.data$exclusion_reason)
              )

            if (!is.null(lpue_result$observation_diagnostics)) {
              observation_index <- observation_index + 1L
              lpue_observation_diagnostic_results[[observation_index]] <-
                lpue_result$observation_diagnostics %>%
                dplyr::mutate(
                  model_input_row = as.integer(.data$input_row),
                  CFR = model_records$CFR[.data$model_input_row],
                  observed_kg = model_records$calibrated_kg[
                    .data$model_input_row
                  ]
                ) %>%
                dplyr::transmute(
                  YEAR = current_year,
                  MONTH = current_month,
                  GSA_code = current_gsa,
                  Species = current_species,
                  Gear = current_gear,
                  CFR = .data$CFR,
                  observed_kg = .data$observed_kg,
                  total_retained_effort = as.numeric(
                    .data$total_retained_effort
                  ),
                  used = as.logical(.data$used),
                  exclusion_reason = as.character(.data$exclusion_reason)
                )
            }

            status_index <- status_index + 1L
            workflow_status_results[[status_index]] <- empty_status(
              current_year, current_gsa, current_species, current_gear,
              current_month,
              stage = "LPUE", status = "completed",
              detail = paste0(
                nrow(lpue_result$lpue),
                " GSA-specific grid-cell coefficients estimated."
              )
            )
          }

          rm(model_effort, model_input, lpue_result)
        }

        rm(combo_landings, positive_combo, gear_identifiers)
      }
    }
  }

  rm(wide_effort, wide_identifiers, relevant_identifier_rows)
  invisible(gc(full = TRUE))

  message(
    "  completed NNLS year ", current_year, " in ",
    round(as.numeric(difftime(
      Sys.time(), nnls_year_started_at, units = "mins"
    )), 1),
    " min"
  )
}

df_lpue_model_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(lpue_raw_results)
df_lpue_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(lpue_check_results)
df_lpue_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(lpue_performance_results)
lpue_cell_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lpue_cell_diagnostic_results)
lpue_observation_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lpue_observation_diagnostic_results
)
df_logit_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(logit_performance_results)
df_logit_classification <- dplyr::bind_rows(logit_classification_results)
lpue_workflow_status <- dplyr::bind_rows(workflow_status_results)
lpue_threshold_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(threshold_results)

rm(
  lpue_raw_results, lpue_check_results, lpue_performance_results,
  lpue_cell_diagnostic_results, lpue_observation_diagnostic_results,
  logit_performance_results, logit_classification_results,
  workflow_status_results, threshold_results
)
invisible(gc())

if (nrow(df_lpue_model_raw) == 0L) {
  warning(
    "No monthly NNLS coefficient was produced. Allocation will use the ",
    "compatible-effort fallback for every stratum."
  )

  df_lpue_model_raw <- tibble::tibble(
    YEAR = integer(), MONTH = integer(), GSA_code = character(),
    Species = character(), Gear = character(), id_grid = character(),
    lpue_raw = numeric()
  )
}

message("[6/7] Applying LPUE caps and allocating calibrated landings...")

df_lpue_model <- df_lpue_model_raw %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    lpue_cap_reference %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Species, .data$Gear,
        .data$cap_probability, .data$is_configured
      ),
    by = c("Species", "Gear"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lpue_after_specific_cap = .data$lpue_raw,
    specific_cap_value = NA_real_
  )

cap_summary_results <- list()
cap_summary_index <- 0L

configured_cap_combinations <- df_lpue_model %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$is_configured %in% TRUE,
    is.finite(.data$cap_probability)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$cap_probability)

if (nrow(configured_cap_combinations) > 0L) {
  for (cap_index in seq_len(nrow(configured_cap_combinations))) {
    current_species <- configured_cap_combinations$Species[cap_index]
    current_gear <- configured_cap_combinations$Gear[cap_index]
    current_probability <- configured_cap_combinations$cap_probability[
      cap_index
    ]

    combination_rows <- df_lpue_model$Species == current_species &
      df_lpue_model$Gear == current_gear
    eligible_values <- df_lpue_model$lpue_raw[
      combination_rows &
        df_lpue_model$lpue_raw > minimum_lpue_for_capping
    ]

    if (length(eligible_values) == 0L) next

    cap_value <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(
      eligible_values,
      probs = current_probability,
      names = FALSE,
      type = 7
    ))
    capped_rows <- combination_rows & df_lpue_model$lpue_raw > cap_value

    df_lpue_model$specific_cap_value[combination_rows] <- cap_value
    df_lpue_model$lpue_after_specific_cap[capped_rows] <- cap_value

    cap_summary_index <- cap_summary_index + 1L
    cap_summary_results[[cap_summary_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
      cap_type = "species-gear",
      Species = current_species,
      Gear = current_gear,
      probability = current_probability,
      cap_value = cap_value,
      n_values_eligible = length(eligible_values),
      n_values_capped = sum(capped_rows)
    )
  }
}

df_lpue_model$lpue <- df_lpue_model$lpue_after_specific_cap

if (isTRUE(apply_global_lpue_cap)) {
  global_eligible <- df_lpue_model$lpue_after_specific_cap[
    df_lpue_model$lpue_after_specific_cap > minimum_lpue_for_capping
  ]

  if (length(global_eligible) > 0L) {
    global_cap_value <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(
      global_eligible,
      probs = global_lpue_cap_probability,
      names = FALSE,
      type = 7
    ))
    globally_capped <- df_lpue_model$lpue_after_specific_cap >
      global_cap_value
    df_lpue_model$lpue[globally_capped] <- global_cap_value

    cap_summary_index <- cap_summary_index + 1L
    cap_summary_results[[cap_summary_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
      cap_type = "global",
      Species = NA_character_,
      Gear = NA_character_,
      probability = global_lpue_cap_probability,
      cap_value = global_cap_value,
      n_values_eligible = length(global_eligible),
      n_values_capped = sum(globally_capped)
    )
  }
}

lpue_capping_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(cap_summary_results)
rm(cap_summary_results)

if (nrow(lpue_capping_summary) == 0L) {
  lpue_capping_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    cap_type = character(), Species = character(), Gear = character(),
    probability = numeric(), cap_value = numeric(),
    n_values_eligible = integer(), n_values_capped = integer()
  )
}

} else {
  resume_required_objects <- c(
    "calibrated_landings_targets", "potential_ground_map", "df_effort",
    "df_lpue_model", "lpue_capping_summary", "lpue_workflow_status",
    "lpue_threshold_diagnostics", "df_lpue_performance", "grid_geometry"
  )

  missing_resume_objects <- resume_required_objects[
    !vapply(
      resume_required_objects,
      exists,
      logical(1),
      envir = .GlobalEnv,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_resume_objects) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Cannot resume from allocation; missing objects: ",
      paste(missing_resume_objects, collapse = ", "),
      ". Run the chunk once from a clean execution.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  message(
    "[2-6/7] Reusing calibrated targets, analytical effort and capped NNLS ",
    "objects already in RAM."
  )
}

annual_lpue_surface <- df_lpue_model %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$lpue), .data$lpue > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
    .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    annual_capped_lpue = mean(.data$lpue),
    n_supporting_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

historical_lpue_surface <- df_lpue_model %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$lpue), .data$lpue > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
    .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    historical_capped_lpue = mean(.data$lpue),
    n_supporting_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    n_supporting_year_months = dplyr::n_distinct(
      paste(.data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, sep = "-")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

historical_effort_surface <- df_effort %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$effort), .data$effort > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    effort = sum(.data$effort),
    n_effort_months = dplyr::n_distinct(
      paste(.data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, sep = "-")
    ),
    n_supporting_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

allocation_results <- vector("list", nrow(calibrated_landings_targets))
unallocatable_results <- list()
unallocatable_index <- 0L

for (target_index in seq_len(nrow(calibrated_landings_targets))) {
  target_row <- calibrated_landings_targets[target_index, , drop = FALSE]

  compatible_cells <- potential_ground_map %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Species == target_row$Species,
      .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$id_grid)

  effort_stratum <- df_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$YEAR == target_row$YEAR,
      .data$MONTH == target_row$MONTH,
      .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
      .data$Gear == target_row$Gear,
      .data$id_grid %in% compatible_cells,
      is.finite(.data$effort),
      .data$effort > 0
    )

  annual_model <- annual_lpue_surface %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$YEAR == target_row$YEAR,
      .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
      .data$Species == target_row$Species,
      .data$Gear == target_row$Gear
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$id_grid,
      .data$annual_capped_lpue,
      .data$n_supporting_months
    )

  if (nrow(effort_stratum) > 0L) {
    monthly_model <- df_lpue_model %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$YEAR == target_row$YEAR,
        .data$MONTH == target_row$MONTH,
        .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
        .data$Species == target_row$Species,
        .data$Gear == target_row$Gear
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$id_grid,
        .data$lpue_raw,
        .data$lpue_after_specific_cap,
        lpue_model_capped = .data$lpue
      )

    allocation_candidate <- effort_stratum %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        monthly_model,
        by = "id_grid",
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        effort_basis = "observed_monthly",
        n_effort_months = 1L,
        lpue_weight_base = .data$lpue_model_capped,
        raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort * .data$lpue_weight_base
      )

    positive_weight <- is.finite(allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight) &
      allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight > 0

    if (any(positive_weight)) {
      allocation_source <- "monthly_nnls"
      allocation_candidate <- allocation_candidate[
        positive_weight,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    } else {
      allocation_candidate <- effort_stratum %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          annual_model,
          by = "id_grid",
          relationship = "one-to-one"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          effort_basis = "observed_monthly",
          n_effort_months = 1L,
          lpue_raw = NA_real_,
          lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
          lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
          lpue_weight_base = .data$annual_capped_lpue,
          raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort * .data$lpue_weight_base
        )

      positive_weight <- is.finite(allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight) &
        allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight > 0

      if (any(positive_weight)) {
        allocation_source <- "annual_gsa_lpue"
        allocation_candidate <- allocation_candidate[
          positive_weight,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
      } else {

        allocation_source <- "compatible_effort"
        allocation_candidate <- effort_stratum %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            effort_basis = "observed_monthly",
            n_effort_months = 1L,
            lpue_raw = NA_real_,
            lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
            lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
            lpue_weight_base = 1,
            raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort
          )
      }
    }
  } else {

    annual_effort_stratum <- df_effort %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$YEAR == target_row$YEAR,
        .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
        .data$Gear == target_row$Gear,
        .data$id_grid %in% compatible_cells,
        is.finite(.data$effort),
        .data$effort > 0
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$id_grid) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        effort = sum(.data$effort),
        n_effort_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    if (nrow(annual_effort_stratum) > 0L) {
      allocation_candidate <- annual_effort_stratum %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          annual_model,
          by = "id_grid",
          relationship = "one-to-one"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          effort_basis = "annual_same_year_proxy",
          lpue_raw = NA_real_,
          lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
          lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
          lpue_weight_base = .data$annual_capped_lpue,
          raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort * .data$lpue_weight_base
        )

      positive_weight <- is.finite(
        allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight
      ) & allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight > 0

      if (any(positive_weight)) {
        allocation_source <- "annual_gsa_lpue_proxy_effort"
        allocation_candidate <- allocation_candidate[
          positive_weight,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
      } else {
        allocation_source <- "annual_gsa_compatible_effort_proxy"
        allocation_candidate <- annual_effort_stratum %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            effort_basis = "annual_same_year_proxy",
            lpue_raw = NA_real_,
            lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
            lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
            lpue_weight_base = 1,
            raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort
          )
      }
    } else {

      target_depth_row <- depth_reference %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data$Species == target_row$Species) %>%
        dplyr::slice(1L)

      target_min_depth_m <- target_depth_row$min_depth_m[[1L]]
      target_max_depth_m <- target_depth_row$max_depth_m[[1L]]
      target_depth_scale_m <- max(
        25,
        target_max_depth_m - target_min_depth_m
      )

      relaxed_depth_effort_stratum <- df_effort %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$YEAR == target_row$YEAR,
          .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
          .data$Gear == target_row$Gear,
          is.finite(.data$effort),
          .data$effort > 0
        ) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(.data$id_grid) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          effort = sum(.data$effort),
          n_effort_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::inner_join(
          grid_depth_key %>%
            dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code) %>%
            dplyr::select(.data$id_grid, .data$depth_m),
          by = "id_grid",
          relationship = "one-to-one"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$depth_m)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          depth_distance_m = dplyr::case_when(
            .data$depth_m < target_min_depth_m ~
              target_min_depth_m - .data$depth_m,
            .data$depth_m > target_max_depth_m ~
              .data$depth_m - target_max_depth_m,
            TRUE ~ 0
          ),
          depth_proximity_weight = 1 /
            (1 + .data$depth_distance_m / target_depth_scale_m)
        )

      if (nrow(relaxed_depth_effort_stratum) > 0L) {
        allocation_source <-
          "annual_same_year_gsa_gear_relaxed_depth_proxy"
        allocation_candidate <- relaxed_depth_effort_stratum %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            effort_basis = "annual_same_year_relaxed_depth_proxy",
            lpue_raw = NA_real_,
            lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
            lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
            lpue_weight_base = .data$depth_proximity_weight,
            raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort * .data$lpue_weight_base
          )
      } else {

        historical_effort_stratum <- historical_effort_surface %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
            .data$Gear == target_row$Gear,
            .data$id_grid %in% compatible_cells
          )

        if (nrow(historical_effort_stratum) == 0L) {
          unallocatable_index <- unallocatable_index + 1L
          unallocatable_results[[unallocatable_index]] <- target_row %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
              reason = paste(
                "No positive target-year or historical effort exists in",
                "species-compatible cells for the same GSA and gear."
              )
            )
          next
        }

        historical_model <- historical_lpue_surface %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .data$GSA_code == target_row$GSA_code,
            .data$Species == target_row$Species,
            .data$Gear == target_row$Gear
          ) %>%
          dplyr::select(
            .data$id_grid,
            .data$historical_capped_lpue,
            historical_lpue_supporting_years = .data$n_supporting_years,
            .data$n_supporting_year_months
          )

        allocation_candidate <- historical_effort_stratum %>%
          dplyr::left_join(
            historical_model,
            by = "id_grid",
            relationship = "one-to-one"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            effort_basis = "historical_spatial_non_vms_proxy",
            lpue_raw = NA_real_,
            lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
            lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
            lpue_weight_base = .data$historical_capped_lpue,
            raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort * .data$lpue_weight_base
          )

        positive_weight <- is.finite(
          allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight
        ) & allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight > 0

        if (any(positive_weight)) {
          allocation_source <-
            "historical_same_gsa_gear_non_vms_lpue_proxy"
          allocation_candidate <- allocation_candidate[
            positive_weight,
            ,
            drop = FALSE
          ]
        } else {
          allocation_source <-
            "historical_same_gsa_gear_non_vms_effort_proxy"
          allocation_candidate <- historical_effort_stratum %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
              effort_basis = "historical_spatial_non_vms_proxy",
              lpue_raw = NA_real_,
              lpue_after_specific_cap = NA_real_,
              lpue_model_capped = NA_real_,
              lpue_weight_base = 1,
              raw_spatial_weight = .data$effort
            )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  total_raw_weight <- sum(allocation_candidate$raw_spatial_weight)

  if (!is.finite(total_raw_weight) || total_raw_weight <= 0) {
    unallocatable_index <- unallocatable_index + 1L
    unallocatable_results[[unallocatable_index]] <- target_row %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        reason = "All candidate spatial weights are zero or non-finite."
      )
    next
  }

  normalisation_multiplier <- target_row$calibrated_target_kg /
    total_raw_weight

  allocation_results[[target_index]] <- allocation_candidate %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR = target_row$YEAR,
      MONTH = target_row$MONTH,
      GSA_code = target_row$GSA_code,
      Species = target_row$Species,
      Gear = target_row$Gear,
      id_grid = .data$id_grid,
      effort = .data$effort,
      effort_basis = .data$effort_basis,
      n_effort_months = .data$n_effort_months,
      lpue_raw = .data$lpue_raw,
      lpue_after_specific_cap = .data$lpue_after_specific_cap,
      lpue_model_capped = .data$lpue_model_capped,
      lpue_weight_base = .data$lpue_weight_base,
      raw_spatial_weight = .data$raw_spatial_weight,
      total_raw_weight = total_raw_weight,
      allocation_share = .data$raw_spatial_weight / total_raw_weight,
      normalisation_multiplier = normalisation_multiplier,
      lpue = .data$lpue_weight_base * normalisation_multiplier,
      calibrated_target_kg = target_row$calibrated_target_kg,
      allocation_source = allocation_source
    )
}

unallocatable_strata <- dplyr::bind_rows(unallocatable_results)

if (nrow(unallocatable_strata) > 0L) {
  unallocatable_diagnostic_directory <- file.path(
    getwd(),
    "Diagnostics"
  )

  if (!dir.exists(unallocatable_diagnostic_directory)) {
    dir.create(
      unallocatable_diagnostic_directory,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )
  }

  unallocatable_diagnostic_file <- file.path(
    unallocatable_diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_unallocatable_LPUE_strata_",
      format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"),
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  diagnostic_written <- tryCatch(
    {
      utils::write.csv(
        unallocatable_strata,
        file = unallocatable_diagnostic_file,
        row.names = FALSE,
        na = ""
      )
      file.exists(unallocatable_diagnostic_file)
    },
    error = function(e) FALSE
  )

  print(unallocatable_strata)
  stop(
    nrow(unallocatable_strata),
    " positive calibrated landing stratum/strata cannot be allocated. ",
    "No target-year or historical spatial support was available for the ",
    "same GSA, species-compatible depth cells and declared gear.",
    if (isTRUE(diagnostic_written)) {
      paste0(" Diagnostic file: ", unallocatable_diagnostic_file)
    } else {
      " The diagnostic file could not be written."
    },
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

df_lpue_allocation <- dplyr::bind_rows(allocation_results) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
  )

rm(allocation_results, unallocatable_results)
invisible(gc())

allocation_key <- c(
  "YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear", "id_grid"
)

if (anyDuplicated(df_lpue_allocation[allocation_key])) {
  stop("df_lpue_allocation is not unique by its full key.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (any(!is.finite(df_lpue_allocation$lpue)) ||
    any(df_lpue_allocation$lpue < 0)) {
  stop("Final allocation LPUE contains invalid values.", call. = FALSE)
}

df_lpue_for_production <- df_lpue_allocation %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid,
    .data$effort, .data$effort_basis, .data$n_effort_months,
    .data$lpue_raw, .data$lpue_after_specific_cap,
    .data$lpue_model_capped, .data$lpue_weight_base,
    .data$raw_spatial_weight, .data$total_raw_weight,
    .data$allocation_share, .data$normalisation_multiplier,
    .data$calibrated_target_kg, .data$allocation_source,
    .data$lpue
  )

df_prod <- df_lpue_for_production %>%
  dplyr::mutate(landings = .data$effort * .data$lpue)

non_vms_spatial_allocation <- df_prod %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$effort_basis == "historical_spatial_non_vms_proxy"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vessel_economic_allocation = FALSE,
    simulation_treatment = "exogenous_biological_removal"
  )

non_vms_stratum_keys <- non_vms_spatial_allocation %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear
  )

non_vms_landings_ledger <- calibrated_landings_detail %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    non_vms_stratum_keys,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effort_support = "no_target_year_vms_effort",
    spatial_support = "historical_same_gsa_species_depth_gear",
    vessel_economic_allocation = FALSE,
    simulation_treatment = "exogenous_biological_removal"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$CFR
  )

non_vms_declared_kg <- sum(non_vms_landings_ledger$calibrated_kg)
non_vms_spatial_kg <- sum(non_vms_spatial_allocation$landings)
non_vms_ledger_tolerance_kg <- max(
  mass_balance_absolute_tolerance_kg,
  mass_balance_relative_tolerance * non_vms_declared_kg
)

if (abs(non_vms_spatial_kg - non_vms_declared_kg) >
    non_vms_ledger_tolerance_kg) {
  stop(
    "The non-VMS spatial allocation does not reproduce its declared ledger.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

attr(
  df_prod,
  "SMART31_mass_conserving_version"
) <- SMART31_MASS_CONSERVING_LPUE_VERSION

if (!all(c(
  "YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear", "id_grid",
  "effort", "effort_basis", "lpue", "landings", "allocation_source"
) %in% names(df_prod))) {
  stop("df_prod lacks one or more required final columns.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (any(!is.finite(df_prod$landings)) || any(df_prod$landings < 0)) {
  stop("df_prod contains invalid landings.", call. = FALSE)
}

allocated_landings_summary <- df_prod %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    allocated_kg = sum(.data$landings),
    n_allocated_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$id_grid),
    allocation_source = paste(
      sort(unique(.data$allocation_source)),
      collapse = "+"
    ),
    effort_basis = paste(
      sort(unique(.data$effort_basis)),
      collapse = "+"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lpue_mass_balance <- calibrated_landings_targets %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    allocated_landings_summary,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference_kg = .data$allocated_kg - .data$calibrated_target_kg,
    absolute_difference_kg = abs(.data$difference_kg),
    relative_difference = safe_ratio(
      .data$absolute_difference_kg,
      .data$calibrated_target_kg
    ),
    permitted_difference_kg = pmax(
      mass_balance_absolute_tolerance_kg,
      mass_balance_relative_tolerance * .data$calibrated_target_kg
    ),
    mass_balance_ok = is.finite(.data$absolute_difference_kg) &
      .data$absolute_difference_kg <= .data$permitted_difference_kg
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
    .data$Gear, .data$MONTH
  )

mass_balance_failure <- is.na(lpue_mass_balance$mass_balance_ok) |
  !lpue_mass_balance$mass_balance_ok

if (any(mass_balance_failure)) {
  failed_mass_balance <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$mass_balance_ok) | !.data$mass_balance_ok)
  print(failed_mass_balance)
  stop(
    nrow(failed_mass_balance),
    " landing strata fail the mass-balance tolerance.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

lpue_allocation_summary <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear,
    .data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    calibrated_target_kg = sum(.data$calibrated_target_kg),
    allocated_kg = sum(.data$allocated_kg),
    n_monthly_strata = dplyr::n(),
    n_allocated_cells = sum(.data$n_allocated_cells),
    maximum_absolute_difference_kg = max(.data$absolute_difference_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
    .data$Gear, .data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis
  )

df_lpue <- df_lpue_allocation %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid,
    .data$lpue_raw, .data$lpue_after_specific_cap,
    .data$lpue_model_capped, .data$lpue_weight_base,
    .data$normalisation_multiplier, .data$lpue,

  )

}

  dplyr::mutate(id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)))

if (anyDuplicated(grid_geometry_for_lpue$id_grid)) {
  stop("The sf grid contains duplicated id_grid values.", call. = FALSE)
}

  dplyr::anti_join(

      dplyr::select(.data$id_grid),

  dplyr::distinct(.data$id_grid)

    call. = FALSE
  )

message("[7/7] Verifying mass balance and writing compact outputs...")

lpue_status_summary <- if (nrow(lpue_workflow_status) > 0L) {
  lpue_workflow_status %>%
    dplyr::count(.data$stage, .data$status, name = "n_combinations") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$stage, .data$status)
} else {

    stage = character(), status = character(), n_combinations = integer()
  )
}

lpue_fallback_summary <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_strata = dplyr::n(),
    calibrated_kg = sum(.data$calibrated_target_kg),
    allocated_kg = sum(.data$allocated_kg),
    share_of_calibrated_landings = .data$calibrated_kg /
      sum(lpue_mass_balance$calibrated_target_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$calibrated_kg))

lpue_annual_proxy_strata <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$effort_basis == "annual_same_year_proxy") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$calibrated_target_kg,
    .data$allocated_kg, .data$n_allocated_cells,
    .data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis,
    .data$difference_kg, .data$mass_balance_ok
  )

lpue_relaxed_depth_proxy_strata <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$effort_basis == "annual_same_year_relaxed_depth_proxy"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(

    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$calibrated_target_kg,

  )

lpue_non_vms_proxy_strata <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$effort_basis == "historical_spatial_non_vms_proxy"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$calibrated_target_kg,
    .data$allocated_kg, .data$n_allocated_cells,
    .data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis,
    .data$difference_kg, .data$mass_balance_ok
  )

lpue_nnls_support_summary <- if (nrow(df_lpue_performance) > 0L) {
  df_lpue_performance %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_models = dplyr::n(),
      monthly_calibrated_input_kg = sum(.data$monthly_calibrated_input_kg),
      threshold_selected_input_kg = sum(.data$threshold_selected_input_kg),
      model_input_kg = sum(.data$model_input_kg),
      nnls_used_observed_kg = sum(.data$nnls_used_observed_kg),
      nnls_fitted_kg = sum(.data$nnls_fitted_kg),
      used_to_monthly_input = safe_ratio(
        .data$nnls_used_observed_kg,
        .data$monthly_calibrated_input_kg
      ),
      reproduction_rate = safe_ratio(
        .data$nnls_fitted_kg,
        .data$nnls_used_observed_kg
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    GSA_code = character(), Species = character(), Gear = character(),
    n_models = integer(), monthly_calibrated_input_kg = numeric(),
    threshold_selected_input_kg = numeric(), model_input_kg = numeric(),
    nnls_used_observed_kg = numeric(), nnls_fitted_kg = numeric(),
    used_to_monthly_input = numeric(), reproduction_rate = numeric()
  )
}

total_calibrated_kg <- sum(calibrated_landings_targets$calibrated_target_kg)
total_allocated_kg <- sum(df_prod$landings)
total_difference_kg <- total_allocated_kg - total_calibrated_kg

if (abs(total_difference_kg) > max(
  mass_balance_absolute_tolerance_kg,
  mass_balance_relative_tolerance * total_calibrated_kg
)) {
  stop("The final global landing balance failed.", call. = FALSE)
}

stopifnot(
  all(lpue_mass_balance$mass_balance_ok %in% TRUE),
  all(is.finite(df_lpue$lpue)),
  all(df_lpue$lpue >= 0),
  all(is.finite(df_prod$landings)),
  all(df_prod$landings >= 0),
  inherits(grid_sf_lpue, "sf")
)

lpue_diagnostic_output_directory <- NA_character_

if (isTRUE(write_lpue_diagnostic_files)) {

    )
  }

  write_diagnostic_csv <- function(x, filename) {

      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )
  }

  write_diagnostic_csv(lpue_mass_balance, "01_landings_mass_balance.csv")
  write_diagnostic_csv(lpue_fallback_summary, "02_allocation_fallback_summary.csv")
  write_diagnostic_csv(lpue_nnls_support_summary, "03_nnls_support_summary.csv")
  write_diagnostic_csv(lpue_status_summary, "04_workflow_status_summary.csv")

  write_diagnostic_csv(df_lpue_performance, "07_nnls_model_performance.csv")
  write_diagnostic_csv(lpue_annual_proxy_strata, "08_annual_proxy_strata.csv")
  write_diagnostic_csv(
    lpue_relaxed_depth_proxy_strata,

  )
  write_diagnostic_csv(
    lpue_non_vms_proxy_strata,
    "10_non_vms_proxy_strata.csv"
  )
  write_diagnostic_csv(
    non_vms_landings_ledger,
    "11_non_vms_landings_ledger.csv"
  )

  saveRDS(
    list(
      version = SMART31_MASS_CONSERVING_LPUE_VERSION,
      created_at = Sys.time(),
      mass_balance = lpue_mass_balance,
      fallback_summary = lpue_fallback_summary,
      nnls_support_summary = lpue_nnls_support_summary,
      status_summary = lpue_status_summary,
      capping_summary = lpue_capping_summary,
      threshold_diagnostics = lpue_threshold_diagnostics,
      model_performance = df_lpue_performance,
      annual_proxy_strata = lpue_annual_proxy_strata,
      relaxed_depth_proxy_strata = lpue_relaxed_depth_proxy_strata,
      non_vms_proxy_strata = lpue_non_vms_proxy_strata,

    ),

      lpue_diagnostic_output_directory,
      "SMART31_mass_conserving_LPUE_results.rds"
    ),
    compress = "xz"
  )
}
```

```{r step1-31-diagnostics-by-gsa, fig.align= "center", fig.height = 6, fig.width = 6, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
print_diagnostic_table <- function(x) {

safe_mean <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x)
}

safe_maximum <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  max(x)
}

safe_all_zero <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return(NA)
  }

  all(x == 0)
}

if (anyDuplicated(grid_geometry$id_grid) > 0L) {

if (is.na(sf::st_crs(GSA))) {

for (object_name in names(lpue_objects)) {

}

standardise_gsa_for_diagnostic <- function(x) {

  original_values <- toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )

  original_values <- gsub(
    ",",
    ".",
    original_values,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  output <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    length(original_values)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(original_values)) {

    value <- original_values[i]

    if (
      is.na(value) ||
        !nzchar(value)
    ) {
      next
    }

    value <- sub(
      "^GSA[[:space:]_-]*",
      "",
      value
    )

    subdivision_match <- regexec(
      "(?<![0-9])([0-9]{1,2})[._-]([0-9])(?![0-9])",
      value,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    subdivision_parts <- regmatches(
      value,
      subdivision_match
    )[[1]]

    if (length(subdivision_parts) == 3L) {

      main_number <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(subdivision_parts[2])
      )

      subdivision_number <- subdivision_parts[3]

      if (!is.na(main_number)) {

        output[i] <- paste0(
          "GSA",
          sprintf("%02d", main_number),
          subdivision_number
        )

        next
      }
    }

    compact_match <- regexec(
      "(?<![0-9])([0-9]{3})(?![0-9])",
      value,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    compact_parts <- regmatches(
      value,
      compact_match
    )[[1]]

    if (length(compact_parts) == 2L) {

      output[i] <- paste0(
        "GSA",
        compact_parts[2]
      )

      next
    }

    simple_match <- regexec(
      "(?<![0-9])([0-9]{1,2})(?![0-9])",
      value,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    simple_parts <- regmatches(
      value,
      simple_match
    )[[1]]

    if (length(simple_parts) == 2L) {

      main_number <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(simple_parts[2])
      )

      if (!is.na(main_number)) {

        output[i] <- paste0(
          "GSA",
          sprintf("%02d", main_number)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  output
}

selected_gsa_check <- tibble::tibble(

gsa_column_diagnostic <- dplyr::bind_rows(

          matched_gsas,
          collapse = ", "

      )
    }
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(

attach_gsa_code <- function(data) {

  if (!"id_grid" %in% names(data)) {
    stop(
      "The supplied object does not contain id_grid.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (inherits(data, "sf")) {
    data <- sf::st_drop_geometry(data)
  }

  data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of("GSA_code")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      id_grid = as.character(
        .data$id_grid
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      grid_gsa_lookup,
      by = "id_grid"
    )
}

df_lpue_with_gsa <- attach_gsa_code(
  df_lpue
)

df_lpue_month_with_gsa <- attach_gsa_code(
  df_lpue_month
)

df_lpue_mean_with_gsa <- attach_gsa_code(
  df_lpue_mean
)

if (exists("grid_sf_lpue", inherits = TRUE)) {

  grid_sf_lpue_with_gsa <- attach_gsa_code(
    grid_sf_lpue
  )

} else {

  grid_sf_lpue_with_gsa <- NULL

  message(
    "\nOptional object grid_sf_lpue was not found. ",
    "The diagnostic will stop at df_lpue_mean."
  )
}

message(

summarise_lpue_stage <- function(data, stage_name) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "Species",
    "Gear",
    "id_grid",
    "lpue",
    "GSA_code"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(data)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      stage_name,
      " is missing the following columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      GSA_code = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$GSA_code,
        "UNASSIGNED"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$GSA_code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      stage = stage_name,

      n_records = dplyr::n(),

      n_species = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$Species
      ),

      n_gears = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$Gear
      ),

      n_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$id_grid
      ),

      n_cells_with_finite_lpue = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$id_grid[
          is.finite(.data$lpue)
        ]
      ),

      n_positive_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$id_grid[
          is.finite(.data$lpue) &
            .data$lpue > 0
        ]
      ),

      n_zero_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$id_grid[
          is.finite(.data$lpue) &
            .data$lpue == 0
        ]
      ),

      n_missing_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$id_grid[
          !is.finite(.data$lpue)
        ]
      ),

      mean_lpue = safe_mean(
        .data$lpue
      ),

      maximum_lpue = safe_maximum(
        .data$lpue
      ),

      all_values_zero = safe_all_zero(
        .data$lpue
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$stage,
      dplyr::everything()
    )
}

stage_summaries <- list(

  summarise_lpue_stage(
    df_lpue_with_gsa,
    "df_lpue"
  ),

  summarise_lpue_stage(
    df_lpue_month_with_gsa,
    "df_lpue_month"
  ),

  summarise_lpue_stage(
    df_lpue_mean_with_gsa,
    "df_lpue_mean"
  )
)

if (!is.null(grid_sf_lpue_with_gsa)) {

  stage_summaries <- c(
    stage_summaries,
    list(
      summarise_lpue_stage(
        grid_sf_lpue_with_gsa,
        "grid_sf_lpue"
      )
    )
  )
}

if (gsa09_original_grid_cells == 0L) {

  message(
    "RESULT: no original grid cell was assigned to GSA09. ",
    "The problem is spatial and precedes the LPUE estimates."
  )

} else if (gsa09_df_lpue_records == 0L) {

  message(
    "RESULT: GSA09 is represented in the spatial grid, but none of its ",
    "cells occurs in df_lpue. The loss happens before LPUE aggregation."
  )

} else if (gsa09_raw_positive_records == 0L) {

  message(
    "RESULT: GSA09 occurs in df_lpue, but the raw LPUE estimates are ",
    "all zero or non-finite. The problem originates in the model inputs ",
    "or in the NNLS estimates, not in the cap or in the map."
  )

} else if (
  gsa09_raw_positive_records > 0L &&
    gsa09_after_cap_positive_records == 0L
) {

  message(
    "RESULT: positive raw LPUE estimates exist in GSA09, but all are ",
    "removed or set to zero by the species- and gear-specific cap."
  )

} else if (
  gsa09_after_cap_positive_records > 0L &&
    gsa09_final_positive_records == 0L
) {

  message(
    "RESULT: positive LPUE values remain after the specific cap, but ",
    "they disappear in the subsequent construction of the final lpue variable."
  )

} else if (gsa09_mean_records == 0L) {

  message(
    "RESULT: positive final LPUE values exist in df_lpue, but GSA09 ",
    "disappears during monthly or temporal aggregation."
  )

} else if (gsa09_positive_map_cells == 0L) {

  message(
    "RESULT: GSA09 occurs in df_lpue_mean, but all values supplied to ",
    "the maps are zero or non-finite."
  )

} else {

  message(
    "RESULT: GSA09 contains positive LPUE values in df_lpue_mean. ",
    "Its apparent absence is therefore caused by the map construction, ",
    "the joins used for plotting, or the colour scale—not by the LPUE estimates."
  )
}

message("============================================================")
```

```{r step1-32-lpue-maps, fig.align= "center", fig.height = 6, fig.width = 6, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
normalized_fao_names <- tolower(
  gsub(
    "[^[:alnum:]]",
    "",
    names(fao3)
  )
)

find_fao_column <- function(candidate_names) {

  candidate_names <- tolower(
    gsub(
      "[^[:alnum:]]",
      "",
      candidate_names
    )
  )

  match_position <- match(
    candidate_names,
    normalized_fao_names,
    nomatch = 0L
  )

  match_position <- match_position[
    match_position > 0L
  ]

  if (length(match_position) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  names(fao3)[match_position[[1]]]
}

make_lpue_map <- function(species_code) {

  species_grid <- grid_sf_lpue_plot %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Species == species_code,
      .data$inside_map_extent
    )

  if (nrow(species_grid) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No LPUE cell for species ",
      species_code,
      " intersects the map extent.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  species_grid_zero <- species_grid %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$lpue_kg_h_m == 0
    )

  species_grid_positive <- species_grid %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$lpue_kg_h_m > 0
    )

  species_metadata <- png_coords %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Species == species_code
    )

  if (nrow(species_metadata) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Species metadata are missing or duplicated for ",
      species_code,
      ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  map_subtitle <- paste0(
    "White: no estimate; grey: LPUE = 0; coloured: LPUE > 0",
    " | positive cells: ",
    nrow(species_grid_positive)
  )

  map_object <- ggplot2::ggplot() +

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = grid_background,
      fill = "white",
      colour = "grey88",
      linewidth = 0.05
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = species_grid_zero,
      fill = "grey72",
      colour = "grey58",
      linewidth = 0.05
    )

  if (nrow(species_grid_positive) > 0L) {

    map_object <- map_object +

      ggplot2::geom_sf(
        data = species_grid_positive,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          fill = .data$lpue_kg_h_m
        ),
        colour = "grey20",
        linewidth = 0.06
      ) +

      ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(
        name = "LPUE (kg/h/m)",
        option = "plasma",
        begin = 0.15,
        end = 0.95,
        trans = "log10",
        oob = scales::squish,
        labels = scales::label_number(
          accuracy = 0.01,
          big.mark = ","
        ),
        guide = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          barwidth = grid::unit(7, "cm"),
          barheight = grid::unit(0.45, "cm")
        )
      )

  } else {

    map_subtitle <- paste0(
      map_subtitle,
      " — no positive LPUE estimates"
    )
  }

  map_object <- map_object +

    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = mp,
      mapping = ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data$long,
        y = .data$lat,
        group = .data$group
      ),
      fill = "grey82",
      colour = "grey50",
      linewidth = 0.15
    ) +

    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ggplot2::vars(Gear),
      drop = TRUE
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_sf(
      crs = sf::st_crs(4326),
      default_crs = sf::st_crs(4326),
      xlim = map_x_range,
      ylim = map_y_range,
      expand = FALSE,
      clip = "on"
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title = species_metadata$plot_title[[1]],
      subtitle = map_subtitle,
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude"
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_test(
      base_size = 10
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = NA
      ),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(
        colour = "grey90",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(
        1,
        "cm"
      ),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 8,
        colour = "grey30"
      ),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(
        0.5,
        "cm"
      )
    )

  if (
    isTRUE(
      species_metadata$silhouette_available[[1]]
    )
  ) {

    if (!requireNamespace("ggimage", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop(
        "Package 'ggimage' is required to add species silhouettes.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    image_data <- species_metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$x,
        .data$y,
        .data$silhouette
      )

    map_object <- map_object +

      ggimage::geom_image(
        data = image_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = .data$x,
          y = .data$y,
          image = .data$silhouette
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 0.18
      )
  }

  map_object
}
```

## FDI validation

```{r step1-33-fdi-check, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Packages 'dplyr' and 'sf' are required.", call. = FALSE)
}

`%>%` <- dplyr::`%>%`

required_objects <- c(
  "effort_gridded_agg_list",
  "df_prod",
  "fdiA",
  "species_to_submit",
  "years_to_submit",
  "CS_gsas",
  "grid_gsa_lookup"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required objects: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

clean_code <- function(x) {
  original <- x
  out <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out[is.na(original) | !nzchar(out)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

normalize_gsa <- function(x, strict = TRUE) {

  cleaned <- clean_code(x)

  token <- sub(
    "^GSA[[:space:]_-]*",
    "",
    cleaned
  )

  token <- gsub(",", ".", token, fixed = TRUE)
  token <- gsub("[[:space:]_-]+", "", token)

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(token))

  integer_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", token)

  if (any(integer_format)) {
    integer_value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(token[integer_format]))

    out[integer_format] <- ifelse(
      integer_value < 100L,
      sprintf("GSA%02d", integer_value),
      paste0("GSA", integer_value)
    )
  }

  decimal_format <- !is.na(token) &
    grepl("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", token)

  if (any(decimal_format)) {
    decimal_parts <- strsplit(token[decimal_format], "\\.")

    out[decimal_format] <- vapply(
      decimal_parts,
      function(parts) {
        paste0(
          "GSA",
          sprintf("%02d", as.integer(parts[1])),
          paste0(parts[-1], collapse = "")
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }

  invalid <- !is.na(cleaned) & is.na(out)

  if (strict && any(invalid)) {
    stop(
      "Unrecognised GSA values. Examples: ",
      paste(utils::head(unique(cleaned[invalid]), 10L), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  out
}

as_numeric_strict <- function(x, column_name) {
  original <- if (is.factor(x)) as.character(x) else x
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(original))
  invalid <- !is.na(original) &
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(original))) &
    is.na(out)
  if (any(invalid)) {
    stop(
      "Non-numeric values in '", column_name, "'. Examples: ",
      paste(utils::head(unique(original[invalid]), 10L), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  out
}

as_year_integer <- function(x, column_name) {
  out <- as_numeric_strict(x, column_name)
  if (any(!is.na(out) & out != floor(out))) {
    stop("Non-integer years in '", column_name, "'.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  as.integer(out)
}

as_month_integer <- function(x, column_name) {
  original <- if (is.factor(x)) as.character(x) else x
  character_value <- trimws(as.character(original))

  missing_value <- is.na(original) | !nzchar(character_value)
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(character_value))

  numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(character_value))
  numeric_month <- !missing_value &
    is.finite(numeric_value) &
    numeric_value == floor(numeric_value) &
    numeric_value >= 1 &
    numeric_value <= 12

  out[numeric_month] <- as.integer(numeric_value[numeric_month])

  month_lookup <- stats::setNames(
    rep(seq_len(12L), 2L),
    c(tolower(month.name), tolower(month.abb))
  )

  normalized_label <- tolower(character_value)
  normalized_label[normalized_label == "sept"] <- "sep"
  label_value <- unname(month_lookup[normalized_label])

  label_month <- !missing_value & is.na(out) & !is.na(label_value)
  out[label_month] <- as.integer(label_value[label_month])

  invalid <- !missing_value & is.na(out)

  if (any(invalid)) {
    stop(
      "Invalid month values in '", column_name, "'. ",
      "Expected 1-12 or English month names. Examples: ",
      paste(
        utils::head(unique(character_value[invalid]), 10L),
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  out
}

sum_available <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_ratio <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.finite(numerator) & is.finite(denominator) & denominator > 0,
    numerator / denominator,
    NA_real_
  )
}

safe_cv <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2L || mean(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  stats::sd(x) / mean(x)
}

}

production_without_selected_gsa <- df_prod_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$GSA_code) | !.data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested)

smart_landings_otb_gsa <- df_prod_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
    .data$Gear == "OTB",
    .data$Species %in% species_requested,
    .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    smart_landings_t = sum_available(.data$landings_kg) / 1000,
    smart_effort_h_m = sum_available(.data$effort),
    n_smart_records = dplyr::n(),
    n_months_smart = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
    n_cells_smart = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$id_grid),
    n_cells_positive_lpue = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$id_grid[is.finite(.data$lpue) & .data$lpue > 0]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

otb_effort_support <- df_effort_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
    .data$Gear == "OTB",
    .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_gridded_effort_h_m = sum_available(.data$effort),
    n_total_effort_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$id_grid),
    n_total_effort_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

required_fdi_columns <- c(
  "year", "gear_type", "species", "sub_region", "country_code", "totwghtlandg"
)
missing_fdi_columns <- setdiff(required_fdi_columns, names(fdiA))

if (length(missing_fdi_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in fdiA: ",
    paste(missing_fdi_columns, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

fdi_prepared <- fdiA %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as_year_integer(.data$year, "fdiA$year"),

    GSA_code = normalize_gsa(.data$sub_region, strict = FALSE),
    Gear = clean_code(.data$gear_type),
    Species = clean_code(.data$species),
    country_code = clean_code(.data$country_code),
    fdi_landings_t = as_numeric_strict(.data$totwghtlandg, "fdiA$totwghtlandg")
  )

if (any(!is.finite(fdi_prepared$fdi_landings_t[!is.na(fdi_prepared$fdi_landings_t)])) ||
    any(fdi_prepared$fdi_landings_t < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("FDI landings contain non-finite or negative values.", call. = FALSE)
}

fdi_landings_otb_gsa <- fdi_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
    .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested,
    .data$Gear == "OTB",
    .data$Species %in% species_requested,
    .data$country_code %in% countries_requested
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    fdi_landings_t = sum_available(.data$fdi_landings_t),
    n_fdi_records = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(fdi_landings_otb_gsa) == 0L) {
  stop("No FDI OTB records satisfy the requested filters.", call. = FALSE)
}

comparison_keys <- c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Gear", "Species")

otb_gsa_comparison <- smart_landings_otb_gsa %>%
  dplyr::mutate(smart_record_present = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    fdi_landings_otb_gsa %>% dplyr::mutate(fdi_record_present = TRUE),
    by = comparison_keys
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    smart_record_present = dplyr::coalesce(.data$smart_record_present, FALSE),
    fdi_record_present = dplyr::coalesce(.data$fdi_record_present, FALSE),
    comparison_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$smart_record_present & .data$fdi_record_present ~ "BOTH",
      .data$smart_record_present ~ "SMART_ONLY",
      .data$fdi_record_present ~ "FDI_ONLY",
      TRUE ~ "UNKNOWN"
    ),
    factor_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$comparison_status != "BOTH" ~ tolower(.data$comparison_status),
      is.na(.data$smart_landings_t) | is.na(.data$fdi_landings_t) ~ "missing_value",
      .data$smart_landings_t == 0 & .data$fdi_landings_t == 0 ~ "both_zero",
      .data$smart_landings_t == 0 & .data$fdi_landings_t > 0 ~ "zero_smart_denominator",
      .data$fdi_landings_t == 0 & .data$smart_landings_t > 0 ~ "zero_fdi",
      TRUE ~ "valid_candidate"
    ),
    smart_fdi_rate = safe_ratio(.data$smart_landings_t, .data$fdi_landings_t),
    calibration_factor = safe_ratio(.data$fdi_landings_t, .data$smart_landings_t)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    otb_effort_support,
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Gear")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effort_support_rate = safe_ratio(
      .data$smart_effort_h_m,
      .data$total_gridded_effort_h_m
    ),
    cell_support_rate = safe_ratio(
      .data$n_cells_smart,
      .data$n_total_effort_cells
    ),
    positive_cell_rate = safe_ratio(
      .data$n_cells_positive_lpue,
      .data$n_cells_smart
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$YEAR)

otb_gsa_annual_diagnostic <- otb_gsa_comparison %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(comparison_keys),
    .data$comparison_status,
    .data$factor_status,
    .data$smart_landings_t,
    .data$fdi_landings_t,
    .data$smart_fdi_rate,
    .data$calibration_factor,
    .data$n_months_smart,
    .data$n_cells_smart,
    .data$n_cells_positive_lpue,
    .data$positive_cell_rate,
    .data$effort_support_rate,
    .data$cell_support_rate
  )

otb_gsa_species_summary <- otb_gsa_comparison %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_years_available = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    n_years_matched = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$YEAR[.data$comparison_status == "BOTH"]
    ),
    n_valid_annual_factors = sum(.data$factor_status == "valid_candidate"),
    smart_total_matched_t = sum_available(
      .data$smart_landings_t[.data$comparison_status == "BOTH"]
    ),
    fdi_total_matched_t = sum_available(
      .data$fdi_landings_t[.data$comparison_status == "BOTH"]
    ),
    pooled_smart_fdi_rate = safe_ratio(
      .data$smart_total_matched_t,
      .data$fdi_total_matched_t
    ),
    pooled_calibration_factor = safe_ratio(
      .data$fdi_total_matched_t,
      .data$smart_total_matched_t
    ),
    median_annual_factor = {
      x <- .data$calibration_factor[.data$factor_status == "valid_candidate"]
      if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    min_annual_factor = {
      x <- .data$calibration_factor[.data$factor_status == "valid_candidate"]
      if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    max_annual_factor = {
      x <- .data$calibration_factor[.data$factor_status == "valid_candidate"]
      if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    annual_factor_cv = safe_cv(
      .data$calibration_factor[.data$factor_status == "valid_candidate"]
    ),
    mean_effort_support_rate = mean(
      .data$effort_support_rate[is.finite(.data$effort_support_rate)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_cell_support_rate = mean(
      .data$cell_support_rate[is.finite(.data$cell_support_rate)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_effort_support_rate = dplyr::if_else(
      is.nan(.data$mean_effort_support_rate), NA_real_, .data$mean_effort_support_rate
    ),
    mean_cell_support_rate = dplyr::if_else(
      is.nan(.data$mean_cell_support_rate), NA_real_, .data$mean_cell_support_rate
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species)

otb_gsa_coverage <- otb_gsa_comparison %>%
  dplyr::count(.data$comparison_status, name = "n_combinations") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$comparison_status)

otb_gsa_unmatched <- otb_gsa_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$comparison_status != "BOTH")

otb_gsa_invalid_factors <- otb_gsa_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$comparison_status == "BOTH",
    .data$factor_status != "valid_candidate"
  )

otb_gsa_totals <- otb_gsa_comparison %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    smart_total_all_t = sum_available(.data$smart_landings_t),
    fdi_total_all_t = sum_available(.data$fdi_landings_t),
    smart_total_matched_t = sum_available(
      .data$smart_landings_t[.data$comparison_status == "BOTH"]
    ),
    fdi_total_matched_t = sum_available(
      .data$fdi_landings_t[.data$comparison_status == "BOTH"]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    matched_smart_fdi_rate = safe_ratio(
      .data$smart_total_matched_t,
      .data$fdi_total_matched_t
    ),
    matched_calibration_factor = safe_ratio(
      .data$fdi_total_matched_t,
      .data$smart_total_matched_t
    )
  )

otb_gsa_reconciliation <- smart_landings_otb_gsa %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$YEAR, .data$Gear, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    smart_total_from_gsa_t = sum_available(.data$smart_landings_t),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("\nOTB comparison coverage by YEAR–GSA–Species:")
smart31_preview_table(otb_gsa_coverage, "OTB comparison coverage by year, GSA and species")

message("\nOTB comparison totals:")
smart31_preview_table(otb_gsa_totals, "Aggregate OTB SMART–FDI comparison")

message("\nAnnual OTB diagnostics by GSA and species:")
smart31_preview_table(
  otb_gsa_annual_diagnostic,
  "Representative annual OTB diagnostics by GSA and species",
  max_rows = 12L,
  max_cols = 10L
)

message("\nMulti-year OTB factor summary by GSA and species:")
smart31_preview_table(
  otb_gsa_species_summary,
  "Representative multi-year OTB summaries by GSA and species",
  max_rows = 12L,
  max_cols = 10L
)

message(
  "\nSMART production records outside or unassigned to the selected GSAs: ",
  format(nrow(production_without_selected_gsa), big.mark = ",")
)

if (nrow(otb_gsa_unmatched) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(otb_gsa_unmatched),
    " YEAR–GSA–Species combinations occur in one source only. ",
    "Inspect 'otb_gsa_unmatched'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (nrow(otb_gsa_invalid_factors) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(otb_gsa_invalid_factors),
    " matched combinations do not yield a finite candidate factor. ",
    "Inspect 'otb_gsa_invalid_factors'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

message(
  "\nOTB GSA-level SMART–FDI diagnostic completed.\n",
  "No calibration has been applied."
)
```

## SMART–FDI comparison

```{r step1-34-smart-fdi-comparison, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width= 12, fig.height= 10, fig.align= "center"}

gears_requested <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(
  clean_code(gears_to_submit)
)))

df_prod_agg <- df_prod_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
    .data$Gear %in% gears_requested,
    .data$Species %in% species_requested,
    .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    landings = sum_available(.data$landings_kg) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_prod_FDI <- fdi_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% years_requested,
    .data$Gear %in% gears_requested,
    .data$Species %in% species_requested,
    .data$GSA_code %in% gsas_requested,
    .data$country_code %in% countries_requested
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    landingsFDI = sum_available(.data$fdi_landings_t),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comparison_keys <- c(
  "YEAR",
  "Gear",
  "Species"
)

df_compare <- df_prod_agg %>%
  dplyr::mutate(smart_record_present = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    df_prod_FDI %>%
      dplyr::mutate(fdi_record_present = TRUE),
    by = comparison_keys
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    smart_record_present = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$smart_record_present,
      FALSE
    ),
    fdi_record_present = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$fdi_record_present,
      FALSE
    ),
    comparison_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$smart_record_present &
        .data$fdi_record_present ~ "BOTH",
      .data$smart_record_present ~ "SMART_ONLY",
      .data$fdi_record_present ~ "FDI_ONLY",
      TRUE ~ "UNKNOWN"
    ),
    rate_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$comparison_status != "BOTH" ~
        tolower(.data$comparison_status),
      is.na(.data$landings) |
        is.na(.data$landingsFDI) ~
        "missing_landing_value",
      .data$landingsFDI == 0 &
        .data$landings == 0 ~
        "both_zero",
      .data$landingsFDI == 0 ~
        "zero_fdi_denominator",
      TRUE ~ "valid"
    ),
    rate = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$rate_status == "valid",
      .data$landings / .data$landingsFDI,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species
  )

df_compare_long <- df_compare %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(comparison_keys),
    .data$landings,
    .data$landingsFDI
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c("landings", "landingsFDI"),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source = dplyr::recode(
      .data$variable,
      landings = "SMART",
      landingsFDI = "FDI"
    )
  )

message(
  "Created df_compare: ", nrow(df_compare), " rows; ",
  "df_compare_long: ", nrow(df_compare_long), " rows."
)

required_long_columns <- c(
  "YEAR",
  "Gear",
  "Species",
  "source",
  "value"
)

missing_long_columns <- setdiff(
  required_long_columns,
  names(df_compare_long)
)

if (length(missing_long_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in 'df_compare_long': ",
    paste(missing_long_columns, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

required_comparison_columns <- c(
  "YEAR",
  "Gear",
  "Species",
  "rate",
  "comparison_status",
  "rate_status"
)

missing_comparison_columns <- setdiff(
  required_comparison_columns,
  names(df_compare)
)

if (length(missing_comparison_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in 'df_compare': ",
    paste(missing_comparison_columns, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

landing_trend_data <- df_compare_long %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
    Gear = as.character(.data$Gear),
    Species = as.character(.data$Species),
    source = factor(
      as.character(.data$source),
      levels = c("FDI", "SMART")
    ),
    value = as.numeric(.data$value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$YEAR),
    !is.na(.data$Gear),
    nzchar(.data$Gear),
    !is.na(.data$Species),
    nzchar(.data$Species),
    !is.na(.data$source)
  )

if (
  any(
    landing_trend_data$value < 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Negative landing values were found in 'df_compare_long'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

landing_trend_data <- landing_trend_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$value),
      .data$value,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

comparison_years <- seq.int(
  min(landing_trend_data$YEAR),
  max(landing_trend_data$YEAR)
)

landing_trend_data <- landing_trend_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species,
    .data$source
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    YEAR = comparison_years
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species,
    .data$source,
    .data$YEAR
  )

gtrend <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = landing_trend_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$YEAR,
    y = .data$value,
    colour = .data$source,
    group = .data$source
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 1.3,
    alpha = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ggplot2::vars(
      Gear,
      Species
    ),
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = ggplot2::label_both
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = comparison_years
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.1,
      big.mark = ","
    ),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(
      mult = c(0.03, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Source",
    values = c(
      FDI = "#0072B2",
      SMART = "#D55E00"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Landings (tonnes)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_test(
    base_size = 10
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 8
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(
      0.5,
      "cm"
    )
  )

rate_plot_data <- df_compare %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$comparison_status == "BOTH",
    .data$rate_status == "valid",
    is.finite(.data$rate),
    .data$rate >= 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
    Gear = as.character(.data$Gear),
    Species = as.character(.data$Species)
  )

if (nrow(rate_plot_data) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No valid SMART/FDI ratios are available for the boxplots.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

rate_plot_diagnostic <- rate_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    minimum_rate = min(.data$rate),
    median_rate = stats::median(.data$rate),
    mean_rate = mean(.data$rate),
    maximum_rate = max(.data$rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$Species
  )

message("\nRatios included in the boxplots:")

smart31_preview_table(rate_plot_diagnostic, "SMART–FDI ratios represented in the comparison plots")

groups_with_one_year <- rate_plot_diagnostic %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$n_years < 2L
  )

if (nrow(groups_with_one_year) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(groups_with_one_year),
    " species–gear combinations contain fewer than two years. ",
    "Their boxplots do not describe temporal variability. ",
    "Inspect 'groups_with_one_year'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

gbox <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = rate_plot_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$Species,
    y = .data$rate
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    colour = "#D55E00",
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "grey85",
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_point(
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      colour = factor(.data$YEAR)
    ),
    position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      height = 0
    ),
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ggplot2::vars(Gear),
    nrow = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.01
    ),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(
      mult = c(0.03, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "SMART / FDI landing ratio",
    colour = "Year"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_test(
    base_size = 10
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

landing_comparison_figure <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  gbox,
  gtrend,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 2)
)

grid::grid.newpage()

grid::grid.draw(
  landing_comparison_figure
)
```
