## Save complete pre spatial checkpoint

```{r step1-35-save-complete-pre-spatial-checkpoint, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=TRUE}

local({

  required_diagnostic_objects <- c(
    "years_to_submit",
    "species_to_submit",
    "gears_to_submit",
    "CS_gsas",
    "quantile_Effort",
    "final_fleet",
    "effort_sf_gridded_list",
    "effort_gridded_agg_list",
    "effort_gridded_list_wide",
    "landings_list",
    "grid_gsa_lookup"
  )

  missing_diagnostic_objects <- required_diagnostic_objects[
    !vapply(
      required_diagnostic_objects,
      exists,
      logical(1),
      envir = .GlobalEnv,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_diagnostic_objects) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Checkpoint not created because required diagnostic objects are missing: ",
      paste(missing_diagnostic_objects, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  checkpoint_directory <- if (
    exists("project_path", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE) &&
      is.function(get("project_path", envir = .GlobalEnv))
  ) {
    get("project_path", envir = .GlobalEnv)("SetUps")
  } else {
    file.path(getwd(), "SetUps")
  }

  if (!dir.exists(checkpoint_directory)) {
    directory_created <- dir.create(
      checkpoint_directory,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )

    if (!isTRUE(directory_created) && !dir.exists(checkpoint_directory)) {
      stop(
        "Unable to create checkpoint directory: ",
        checkpoint_directory,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  checkpoint_directory <- normalizePath(
    checkpoint_directory,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )

  checkpoint_timestamp <- format(
    Sys.time(),
    "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"
  )

  checkpoint_stem <- paste0(
    "SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators_",
    checkpoint_timestamp
  )

  checkpoint_file <- file.path(
    checkpoint_directory,
    paste0(checkpoint_stem, ".RData")
  )

  state_file <- file.path(
    checkpoint_directory,
    paste0(checkpoint_stem, "_state.rds")
  )

  latest_pointer_file <- file.path(
    checkpoint_directory,
    "SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators_LATEST.txt"
  )

  restore_script_file <- file.path(
    checkpoint_directory,
    "restore_SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators.R"
  )

  global_object_names <- ls(
  envir = .GlobalEnv,
  all.names = TRUE
)

redundant_checkpoint_objects <- c(
  "calibrated_landing_list",
  "effort_long_list",
  "lpue_raw_results",
  "lpue_check_results",
  "lpue_performance_results",
  "lpue_cell_diagnostic_results",
  "lpue_observation_diagnostic_results",
  "logit_performance_results",
  "logit_classification_results",
  "workflow_status_results",
  "threshold_results",
  "cap_summary_results",
  "allocation_results",
  "unallocatable_results",
  "effort_tables",
  "model_input",
  "wide_effort",
  "effort_stratum",
  "annual_effort_stratum",
  "allocation_candidate",
  "monthly_model",
  "annual_model",
  "lpue_result",
  "logit_result",
  "current_effort",
  "current_landings",
  "model_effort",
  "grid_points_for_gsa"
)

excluded_checkpoint_objects <- intersect(
  redundant_checkpoint_objects,
  global_object_names
)

global_object_names <- setdiff(
  global_object_names,
  excluded_checkpoint_objects
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_diagnostic_objects %in% global_object_names)
)

message(
  "Redundant working objects excluded from checkpoint: ",
  length(excluded_checkpoint_objects)
)

  attached_packages <- sub(
    "^package:",
    "",
    grep(
      "^package:",
      search(),
      value = TRUE
    )
  )

  knitr_state <- if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    list(
      chunk_options = knitr::opts_chunk$get(),
      knit_options = knitr::opts_knit$get(),
      hooks = knitr::knit_hooks$get()
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  checkpoint_state <- list(
    checkpoint_format_version = "SMART31-complete-session-v1",
    created_at = Sys.time(),
    checkpoint_file = checkpoint_file,
    working_directory = getwd(),
    project_root = if (
      exists("project_root", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
    ) {
      get("project_root", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    } else {
      getwd()
    },
    r_version = R.version.string,
    platform = R.version$platform,
    lib_paths = .libPaths(),
    search_path = search(),
    attached_packages = attached_packages,
    loaded_namespaces = loadedNamespaces(),
    options = options(),
    timezone = Sys.getenv("TZ", unset = ""),
    locale = Sys.getlocale(),
    rng_kind = RNGkind(),
    object_names = global_object_names,
    object_count = length(global_object_names),
    required_diagnostic_objects = required_diagnostic_objects,
    knitr = knitr_state,
    session_info = utils::sessionInfo()
  )

  checkpoint_temporary_file <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(checkpoint_stem, "_"),
    tmpdir = checkpoint_directory,
    fileext = ".RData.tmp"
  )

  state_temporary_file <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(checkpoint_stem, "_"),
    tmpdir = checkpoint_directory,
    fileext = ".state.rds.tmp"
  )

  on.exit(
    unlink(
      c(checkpoint_temporary_file, state_temporary_file),
      force = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )

  message(
    "Saving complete SMART3.1 checkpoint (",
    format(length(global_object_names), big.mark = ","),
    " objects)..."
  )

    save(
    list = global_object_names,
    file = checkpoint_temporary_file,
    envir = .GlobalEnv,
    compress = "gzip",
    version = 3
  )

  saveRDS(
    checkpoint_state,
    file = state_temporary_file,
    compress = "gzip",
    version = 3
  )

  if (!file.rename(checkpoint_temporary_file, checkpoint_file)) {
    stop(
      "The complete checkpoint was serialized but could not be moved to: ",
      checkpoint_file,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!file.rename(state_temporary_file, state_file)) {
    stop(
      "The checkpoint was created, but its state file could not be moved to: ",
      state_file,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  writeLines(
    basename(checkpoint_file),
    con = latest_pointer_file,
    useBytes = TRUE
  )

  restore_script <- c(
    "# SMART3.1 — restore the complete session before Section 5",
    "# Run after restarting R with:",
    "# source(\"SetUps/restore_SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators.R\")",
    "",
    "local({",
    "  source_path <- tryCatch({",
    "    current_source <- sys.frame(1)$ofile",
    "    if (is.null(current_source) || !nzchar(current_source)) {",
    "      \"\"",
    "    } else {",
    "      normalizePath(current_source, winslash = \"/\", mustWork = TRUE)",
    "    }",
    "  }, error = function(e) \"\")",
    "",
    "  checkpoint_directory <- if (nzchar(source_path)) {",
    "    dirname(source_path)",
    "  } else {",
    "    file.path(getwd(), \"SetUps\")",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  latest_pointer_file <- file.path(",
    "    checkpoint_directory,",
    "    \"SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators_LATEST.txt\"",
    "  )",
    "",
    "  checkpoint_name <- if (file.exists(latest_pointer_file)) {",
    "    trimws(readLines(latest_pointer_file, n = 1L, warn = FALSE))",
    "  } else {",
    "    \"\"",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  checkpoint_file <- file.path(checkpoint_directory, checkpoint_name)",
    "",
    "  if (!nzchar(checkpoint_name) || !file.exists(checkpoint_file)) {",
    "    checkpoint_candidates <- list.files(",
    "      checkpoint_directory,",
    "      pattern = \"^SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}\\\\.RData$\",",
    "      full.names = TRUE",
    "    )",
    "",
    "    if (length(checkpoint_candidates) == 0L) {",
    "      stop(\"No complete SMART3.1 pre-spatial checkpoint was found.\")",
    "    }",
    "",
    "    checkpoint_file <- checkpoint_candidates[",
    "      which.max(file.info(checkpoint_candidates)$mtime)",
    "    ]",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  state_file <- sub(",
    "    \"\\\\.RData$\",",
    "    \"_state.rds\",",
    "    checkpoint_file",
    "  )",
    "",
    "  if (!file.exists(state_file)) {",
    "    stop(\"Session-state file not found: \", state_file)",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  checkpoint_state <- readRDS(state_file)",
    "",
    "  .libPaths(unique(c(checkpoint_state$lib_paths, .libPaths())))",
    "",
    "  startup_packages <- c(",
    "    \"base\", \"methods\", \"datasets\", \"utils\",",
    "    \"grDevices\", \"graphics\", \"stats\"",
    "  )",
    "",
    "  packages_to_attach <- setdiff(",
    "    rev(checkpoint_state$attached_packages),",
    "    startup_packages",
    "  )",
    "",
    "  for (package_name in packages_to_attach) {",
    "    if (!requireNamespace(package_name, quietly = TRUE)) {",
    "      stop(\"Required package is not installed: \", package_name)",
    "    }",
    "",
    "    suppressPackageStartupMessages(",
    "      library(package_name, character.only = TRUE)",
    "    )",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  if (!is.null(checkpoint_state$options)) {",
    "    do.call(options, checkpoint_state$options)",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  if (",
    "    length(checkpoint_state$timezone) == 1L &&",
    "      nzchar(checkpoint_state$timezone)",
    "  ) {",
    "    Sys.setenv(TZ = checkpoint_state$timezone)",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  loaded_objects <- load(checkpoint_file, envir = .GlobalEnv)",
    "",
    "  missing_saved_objects <- setdiff(",
    "    checkpoint_state$object_names,",
    "    loaded_objects",
    "  )",
    "",
    "  unexpected_loaded_objects <- setdiff(",
    "    loaded_objects,",
    "    checkpoint_state$object_names",
    "  )",
    "",
    "  if (",
    "    length(missing_saved_objects) > 0L ||",
    "      length(unexpected_loaded_objects) > 0L",
    "  ) {",
    "    stop(",
    "      \"Checkpoint object inventory mismatch. Missing: \",",
    "      paste(missing_saved_objects, collapse = \", \"),",
    "      \"; unexpected: \",",
    "      paste(unexpected_loaded_objects, collapse = \", \")",
    "    )",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  missing_diagnostic_objects <- checkpoint_state$required_diagnostic_objects[",
    "    !vapply(",
    "      checkpoint_state$required_diagnostic_objects,",
    "      exists,",
    "      logical(1),",
    "      envir = .GlobalEnv,",
    "      inherits = FALSE",
    "    )",
    "  ]",
    "",
    "  if (length(missing_diagnostic_objects) > 0L) {",
    "    stop(",
    "      \"Required diagnostic objects were not restored: \",",
    "      paste(missing_diagnostic_objects, collapse = \", \")",
    "    )",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  if (dir.exists(checkpoint_state$working_directory)) {",
    "    setwd(checkpoint_state$working_directory)",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  if (",
    "    !is.null(checkpoint_state$knitr) &&",
    "      requireNamespace(\"knitr\", quietly = TRUE)",
    "  ) {",
    "    do.call(knitr::opts_chunk$set, checkpoint_state$knitr$chunk_options)",
    "    do.call(knitr::opts_knit$set, checkpoint_state$knitr$knit_options)",
    "    do.call(knitr::knit_hooks$set, checkpoint_state$knitr$hooks)",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  invisible(gc())",
    "",
    "  message(",
    "    \"SMART3.1 session restored completely from:\\n  \",",
    "    normalizePath(checkpoint_file, winslash = \"/\"),",
    "    \"\\nObjects restored: \",",
    "    format(length(loaded_objects), big.mark = \",\")",
    "  )",
    "})"
  )

  writeLines(
    restore_script,
    con = restore_script_file,
    useBytes = TRUE
  )

  checkpoint_size_gb <- file.info(checkpoint_file)$size / 1024^3

  message(
    "COMPLETE CHECKPOINT CREATED\n",
    "  file: ", checkpoint_file, "\n",
    "  objects: ", format(length(global_object_names), big.mark = ","), "\n",
    "  size: ", format(round(checkpoint_size_gb, 2), nsmall = 2), " GB\n",
    "  restore with: source(\"SetUps/restore_SMART31_pre_spatial_indicators.R\")"
  )
})
```

## Build annual FDI prices

```{r step1-36-build-fdi-annual-prices, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

if (!exists("fdiA", inherits = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Object 'fdiA' is unavailable. Run the 'load FDI data' chunk first.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!is.data.frame(fdiA)) {
  stop("Object 'fdiA' must be a data frame.", call. = FALSE)
}

fdi_price_module <- local({

  normalize_fdi_gsa <- function(x) {
    z <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
    z <- gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", z)
    z <- sub("^GSA", "", z)
    z <- gsub("_", ".", z, fixed = TRUE)
    z <- gsub(",", ".", z, fixed = TRUE)

    out <- rep(NA_character_, length(z))

    already_smart <- z %in% c("111", "112")
    out[already_smart] <- paste0("GSA", z[already_smart])

    ordinary <- grepl("^[0-9]{1,2}(?:\\.[12])?$", z, perl = TRUE)

    if (any(ordinary)) {
      z_valid <- z[ordinary]
      major <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(sub("\\..*$", "", z_valid))
      )
      minor <- ifelse(
        grepl("\\.", z_valid),
        sub("^.*\\.", "", z_valid),
        ""
      )

      out[ordinary] <- paste0(
        sprintf("GSA%02d", major),
        minor
      )
    }

    out
  }

  as_fdi_numeric <- function(x, label) {
    x_character <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x_character[x_character == ""] <- NA_character_

    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_character))

    invalid <- !is.na(x_character) & is.na(out)
    if (any(invalid)) {
      bad_values <- unique(x_character[invalid])
      stop(
        label,
        " contains non-numeric values, for example: ",
        paste(utils::head(bad_values, 5L), collapse = ", "),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    out
  }

  clean_species_code <- function(x) {
    out <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
    out[is.na(out) | out == ""] <- NA_character_
    out
  }

  lower_names <- tolower(names(fdiA))

  if (anyDuplicated(lower_names)) {
    duplicated_names <- unique(lower_names[duplicated(lower_names)])
    stop(
      "fdiA has column names duplicated after case normalization: ",
      paste(duplicated_names, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  name_lookup <- stats::setNames(names(fdiA), lower_names)

  required_fields <- c(
    "year",
    "sub_region",
    "species",
    "totwghtlandg",
    "totvallandg"
  )

  missing_fields <- setdiff(required_fields, names(name_lookup))

  if (length(missing_fields) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "fdiA is missing the fields required to calculate annual prices: ",
      paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  raw <- fdiA %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      source_row = dplyr::row_number(),
      YEAR_raw = as_fdi_numeric(
        .data[[name_lookup[["year"]]]],
        "fdiA$year"
      ),
      GSA = normalize_fdi_gsa(
        .data[[name_lookup[["sub_region"]]]]
      ),
      Species = clean_species_code(
        .data[[name_lookup[["species"]]]]
      ),
      landing_weight_t = as_fdi_numeric(
        .data[[name_lookup[["totwghtlandg"]]]],
        "fdiA$totwghtlandg"
      ),
      landing_value_eur = as_fdi_numeric(
        .data[[name_lookup[["totvallandg"]]]],
        "fdiA$totvallandg"
      )
    )

  non_integer_year <- !is.na(raw$YEAR_raw) &
    abs(raw$YEAR_raw - round(raw$YEAR_raw)) > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)

  if (any(non_integer_year)) {
    stop("fdiA$year contains non-integer values.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  raw <- raw %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      YEAR = as.integer(round(.data$YEAR_raw)),
      exclusion_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(.data$GSA) ~ "unrecognized_or_missing_GSA",
        is.na(.data$YEAR) ~ "missing_year",
        is.na(.data$Species) ~ "missing_species",
        is.na(.data$landing_weight_t) ~ "missing_landing_weight",
        .data$landing_weight_t <= 0 ~ "non_positive_landing_weight",
        is.na(.data$landing_value_eur) ~ "missing_landing_value",
        .data$landing_value_eur < 0 ~ "negative_landing_value",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-YEAR_raw)

  rows_used <- raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$exclusion_reason)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.data$exclusion_reason)

  rows_excluded <- raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$exclusion_reason))

  if (nrow(rows_used) == 0L) {
    stop("No usable GSA records were found in fdiA.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  exact <- rows_used %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$Species,
      .data$GSA
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      landing_weight_t = sum(.data$landing_weight_t),
      landing_value_eur = sum(.data$landing_value_eur),
      n_source_rows = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Price = .data$landing_value_eur /
        (.data$landing_weight_t * 1000)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$Species,
      .data$GSA
    )

  if (anyDuplicated(exact[c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")])) {
    stop(
      "Internal error: FDI prices are not unique by YEAR-Species-GSA.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (
    any(!is.finite(exact$Price)) ||
    any(exact$Price < 0)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Invalid prices were produced after aggregating FDI Table A.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  fallback <- rows_used %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$Species
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      fallback_landing_weight_t = sum(.data$landing_weight_t),
      fallback_landing_value_eur = sum(.data$landing_value_eur),
      fallback_n_gsa = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$GSA),
      fallback_n_source_rows = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Price_fallback = .data$fallback_landing_value_eur /
        (.data$fallback_landing_weight_t * 1000)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$Species
    )

  if (anyDuplicated(fallback[c("YEAR", "Species")])) {
    stop(
      "Internal error: FDI fallback prices are not unique by YEAR-Species.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  target_years <- if (
    exists("years_to_submit", inherits = TRUE)
  ) {
    suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(as.character(get("years_to_submit", inherits = TRUE)))
    )
  } else {
    sort(unique(exact$YEAR))
  }

  target_species <- if (
    exists("species_to_submit", inherits = TRUE)
  ) {
    clean_species_code(get("species_to_submit", inherits = TRUE))
  } else {
    sort(unique(exact$Species))
  }

  target_gsas <- if (
    exists("CS_gsas", inherits = TRUE)
  ) {
    normalize_fdi_gsa(get("CS_gsas", inherits = TRUE))
  } else {
    sort(unique(exact$GSA))
  }

  target_years <- sort(unique(target_years[!is.na(target_years)]))
  target_species <- sort(unique(target_species[!is.na(target_species)]))
  target_gsas <- sort(unique(target_gsas[!is.na(target_gsas)]))

  if (
    length(target_years) == 0L ||
    length(target_species) == 0L ||
    length(target_gsas) == 0L
  ) {
    stop(
      "The price application domain is empty. Check years_to_submit, ",
      "species_to_submit and CS_gsas.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  target_grid <- expand.grid(
    YEAR = target_years,
    Species = target_species,
    GSA = target_gsas,
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$Species,
      .data$GSA
    )

  annual <- target_grid %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      exact %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          Price_exact = Price,
          exact_landing_weight_t = landing_weight_t,
          exact_landing_value_eur = landing_value_eur,
          exact_n_source_rows = n_source_rows
        ),
      by = c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      fallback,
      by = c("YEAR", "Species")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Price = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$Price_exact,
        .data$Price_fallback
      ),
      price_source = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(.data$Price_exact) ~ "FDI_GSA_species_year",
        is.na(.data$Price_exact) & !is.na(.data$Price_fallback) ~
          "FDI_species_year_fallback",
        TRUE ~ "missing"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      YEAR,
      Species,
      GSA,
      Price,
      price_source,
      Price_exact,
      Price_fallback,
      dplyr::everything()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$Species,
      .data$GSA
    )

  if (anyDuplicated(annual[c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")])) {
    stop(
      "Internal error: price_annual is not unique by YEAR-Species-GSA.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  missing <- annual %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$Price))

  qa <- data.frame(
    source_rows = nrow(fdiA),
    usable_rows = nrow(rows_used),
    excluded_rows = nrow(rows_excluded),
    exact_price_groups = nrow(exact),
    target_combinations = nrow(annual),
    exact_target_combinations = sum(
      annual$price_source == "FDI_GSA_species_year"
    ),
    fallback_target_combinations = sum(
      annual$price_source == "FDI_species_year_fallback"
    ),
    missing_target_combinations = nrow(missing),
    zero_price_target_combinations = sum(
      annual$Price == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(
    exact = exact,
    fallback = fallback,
    rows_excluded = rows_excluded,
    annual = annual,
    missing = missing,
    qa = qa
  )
})

fdi_price_exact <- fdi_price_module$exact
fdi_price_species_year_fallback <- fdi_price_module$fallback
fdi_price_rows_excluded <- fdi_price_module$rows_excluded
price_annual <- fdi_price_module$annual
price_annual_missing <- fdi_price_module$missing
fdi_price_qa <- fdi_price_module$qa
```

```{r step1-37-get-spatial-indicators, echo = F, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width= 9, fig.height= 5, fig.align= "center"}
drop_model_geometry <- function(x) {

  if (inherits(x, "sf")) {
    return(sf::st_drop_geometry(x))
  }

  as.data.frame(x)
}

clean_model_code <- function(x) {

  original_value <- x

  cleaned_value <- toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )

  cleaned_value[
    is.na(original_value) |
      !nzchar(cleaned_value)
  ] <- NA_character_

  cleaned_value
}

clean_grid_id <- function(x) {

  original_value <- x

  cleaned_value <- trimws(
    as.character(x)
  )

  cleaned_value[
    is.na(original_value) |
      !nzchar(cleaned_value)
  ] <- NA_character_

  cleaned_value
}

normalize_model_month <- function(x) {

  original_value <- x

  character_value <- toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )

  numeric_month <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(character_value)
  )

  missing_numeric_month <- is.na(numeric_month)

  abbreviation_match <- match(
    substr(character_value, 1L, 3L),
    toupper(month.abb)
  )

  numeric_month[missing_numeric_month] <-
    abbreviation_match[missing_numeric_month]

  invalid_month <- (
    !is.na(original_value) &
      (
        is.na(numeric_month) |
          numeric_month < 1L |
          numeric_month > 12L
      )
  )

  if (any(invalid_month)) {
    stop(
      "Invalid MONTH values found. Examples: ",
      paste(
        utils::head(
          unique(character_value[invalid_month]),
          10L
        ),
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  numeric_month
}

normalize_model_gsa <- function(x) {

  cleaned_value <- clean_model_code(x)

  value_without_prefix <- sub(
    "^GSA[[:space:]_-]*",
    "",
    cleaned_value
  )

  value_without_prefix <- gsub(
    "[, _-]",
    ".",
    value_without_prefix
  )

  value_without_prefix[value_without_prefix == "11.1"] <- "111"
  value_without_prefix[value_without_prefix == "11.2"] <- "112"

  numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(value_without_prefix)
  )

  is_numeric_gsa <- (
    !is.na(value_without_prefix) &
      grepl("^[0-9]+$", value_without_prefix) &
      !is.na(numeric_value)
  )

  output_value <- cleaned_value

  output_value[is_numeric_gsa] <- sprintf(
    "GSA%02d",
    numeric_value[is_numeric_gsa]
  )

  output_value
}

as_model_numeric <- function(x, column_name) {

  original_value <- x

  if (is.factor(original_value)) {
    original_value <- as.character(original_value)
  }

  numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(original_value)
  )

  invalid_conversion <- (
    !is.na(original_value) &
      nzchar(trimws(as.character(original_value))) &
      is.na(numeric_value)
  )

  if (any(invalid_conversion)) {
    stop(
      "Non-numeric values found in '",
      column_name,
      "'. Examples: ",
      paste(
        utils::head(
          unique(
            as.character(
              original_value[invalid_conversion]
            )
          ),
          10L
        ),
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  numeric_value
}

as_model_year <- function(x, column_name) {

  numeric_year <- as_model_numeric(
    x,
    column_name
  )

  invalid_year <- (
    !is.na(numeric_year) &
      (
        !is.finite(numeric_year) |
          numeric_year != floor(numeric_year)
      )
  )

  if (any(invalid_year)) {
    stop(
      "Invalid years found in '",
      column_name,
      "'.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  as.integer(numeric_year)
}

mean_preserve_all_missing <- function(x) {

  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

sum_preserve_all_missing <- function(x) {

  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sum(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

mean_require_complete <- function(x) {

  if (
    length(x) == 0L ||
      anyNA(x) ||
      any(!is.finite(x))
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x)
}

resolve_column_alias <- function(
    available_names,
    candidate_names,
    field_name
) {

  matched_indices <- match(
    tolower(candidate_names),
    tolower(available_names),
    nomatch = 0L
  )

  matched_indices <- matched_indices[
    matched_indices > 0L
  ]

  matched_names <- unique(
    available_names[matched_indices]
  )

  if (length(matched_names) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (length(matched_names) > 1L) {
    warning(
      "Several columns could represent '",
      field_name,
      "': ",
      paste(matched_names, collapse = ", "),
      ". The first one will be used: ",
      matched_names[[1L]],
      ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  matched_names[[1L]]
}

    YEAR = as_model_year(
      .data$YEAR,
      "df_effort$YEAR"
    ),

    Gear = clean_model_code(
      .data$Gear
    ),

    id_grid = clean_grid_id(
      .data$id_grid
    ),

    effort = as_model_numeric(
      .data$effort,
      "df_effort$effort"
    )
  )

if (
  any(
    effort_annual_grid$effort < 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Negative effort values were found in 'df_effort'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

effort_records_missing_keys <- effort_annual_grid %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(.data$YEAR) |
      is.na(.data$Gear) |
      is.na(.data$id_grid)
  )

if (nrow(effort_records_missing_keys) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(effort_records_missing_keys),
    " effort records contain incomplete identifying fields. ",
    "Inspect 'effort_records_missing_keys'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

effort_annual_grid <- effort_annual_grid %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid,
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    effort = sum_preserve_all_missing(
      .data$effort
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

production_annual_grid <- full_model %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid,
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    landings = sum_preserve_all_missing(
      .data$landings
    ),

    priced_landings = sum(
      .data$landings[
        .data$price_available &
          !is.na(.data$landings)
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    landings_without_price = sum(
      .data$landings[
        !.data$price_available &
          !is.na(.data$landings)
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    revenues_available = sum(
      .data$revenues,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    has_missing_landings = any(
      is.na(.data$landings)
    ),

    has_positive_unpriced_landings = any(
      !.data$price_available &
        !is.na(.data$landings) &
        .data$landings > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_coverage = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$landings) ~ NA_real_,

      .data$landings > 0 ~
        .data$priced_landings / .data$landings,

      TRUE ~ 1
    ),

    revenue_complete = (
      !.data$has_missing_landings &
        !.data$has_positive_unpriced_landings
    ),

    revenues = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$revenue_complete,
      .data$revenues_available,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

aggregation_keys <- c(
  "Gear",
  "id_grid",
  "YEAR"
)

production_without_effort <- production_annual_grid %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    effort_annual_grid %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(aggregation_keys)
      ),

    by = aggregation_keys
  )

if (nrow(production_without_effort) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(production_without_effort),
    " annual production records have no corresponding effort record. ",
    "Inspect 'production_without_effort'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

full_model_agg_complete <- effort_annual_grid %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    production_annual_grid,
    by = aggregation_keys,
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid,
    .data$YEAR
  )

full_model_agg <- full_model_agg_complete %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid,
    .data$effort,
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$landings,
    .data$revenues
  )

full_model_agg_mean <- full_model_agg %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    effort = mean_require_complete(
      .data$effort
    ),

    landings = mean_require_complete(
      .data$landings
    ),

    revenues = mean_require_complete(
      .data$revenues
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid
  )

revenue_coverage_annual <- full_model_agg_complete %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(aggregation_keys),
    .data$landings,
    .data$priced_landings,
    .data$landings_without_price,
    .data$price_coverage,
    .data$revenue_complete
  )

incomplete_revenue_groups <- revenue_coverage_annual %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(.data$revenue_complete) |
      !.data$revenue_complete
  )

effort_without_production <- full_model_agg_complete %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$effort),
    is.na(.data$landings)
  )

full_model_agg_mean_diagnostic <- full_model_agg_complete %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_years_with_effort = sum(
      !is.na(.data$effort)
    ),

    n_years_with_landings = sum(
      !is.na(.data$landings)
    ),

    n_years_with_complete_revenue = sum(
      .data$revenue_complete %in% TRUE
    ),

    minimum_price_coverage = if (
      all(is.na(.data$price_coverage))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      min(
        .data$price_coverage,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

price_coverage_summary <- revenue_coverage_annual %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_annual_records = dplyr::n(),

    n_complete_revenue = sum(
      .data$revenue_complete %in% TRUE
    ),

    n_incomplete_revenue = sum(
      !(.data$revenue_complete %in% TRUE)
    ),

    total_landings = sum(
      .data$landings,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    total_priced_landings = sum(
      .data$priced_landings,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    total_unpriced_landings = sum(
      .data$landings_without_price,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    overall_price_coverage = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$total_landings > 0,
      .data$total_priced_landings /
        .data$total_landings,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

message(
  "\nFull economic model completed:\n",
  "  annual price records: ",
  format(
    nrow(price_annual_prepared),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  grid cells with GSA: ",
  format(
    nrow(grid_gsa_lookup),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  detailed production records: ",
  format(
    nrow(full_model),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  annual gear-grid records: ",
  format(
    nrow(full_model_agg),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  mean gear-grid records: ",
  format(
    nrow(full_model_agg_mean),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  unmatched production grid cells: ",
  format(
    nrow(unmatched_production_grid_ids),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  missing price combinations: ",
  format(
    nrow(missing_price_combinations),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  effort records without production: ",
  format(
    nrow(effort_without_production),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  production records without effort: ",
  format(
    nrow(production_without_effort),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  annual records with incomplete revenue: ",
  format(
    nrow(incomplete_revenue_groups),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n",
  "  overall price coverage: ",

)
```

## Prepare other-species value from FDI

```{r step1-38-prepare-fdi-other-species-value, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

required_value_objects <- c(
  "fdiA",
  "species_to_submit",
  "gears_to_submit",
  "years_to_submit",
  "CS_gsas",
  "economic_country_code"
)

missing_value_objects <- required_value_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_value_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    envir = .GlobalEnv,
    inherits = FALSE
  )
]

if (length(missing_value_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing objects required for the FDI value reference: ",
    paste(missing_value_objects, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

resolve_fdi_column <- function(data, candidates, label) {
  lookup <- stats::setNames(names(data), tolower(names(data)))
  candidate <- candidates[candidates %in% names(lookup)][1]

  if (length(candidate) == 0L || is.na(candidate)) {
    stop(
      "Unable to identify ", label, " in FDI. Expected one of: ",
      paste(candidates, collapse = ", "),
      ". Available columns: ",
      paste(names(data), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  unname(lookup[[candidate]])
}

fdi_value_columns <- list(
  YEAR = resolve_fdi_column(fdiA, c("year"), "year"),
  GSA = resolve_fdi_column(
    fdiA,
    c("sub_region", "subregion", "gsa"),
    "sub-region"
  ),
  Gear = resolve_fdi_column(
    fdiA,
    c("gear_type", "fishing_tech", "fishing_technique"),
    "gear"
  ),
  Species = resolve_fdi_column(
    fdiA,
    c("species", "species_code"),
    "species"
  ),
  reference_VL = resolve_fdi_column(
    fdiA,
    c("vessel_length", "vessel_length_class", "vl"),
    "vessel-length class"
  ),
  country = resolve_fdi_column(
    fdiA,
    c("country_code", "country"),
    "country"
  ),
  landing_value = resolve_fdi_column(
    fdiA,
    c("totvallandg", "total_landing_value", "landing_value"),
    "total landing value"
  )
)

fdi_value_prepared <- fdiA %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(
      .data[[fdi_value_columns$YEAR]]
    ))),
    GSA = normalize_gsa(
      .data[[fdi_value_columns$GSA]],
      strict = FALSE
    ),
    Gear = clean_code(.data[[fdi_value_columns$Gear]]),
    Species = clean_code(.data[[fdi_value_columns$Species]]),
    reference_VL = clean_code(
      .data[[fdi_value_columns$reference_VL]]
    ),
    country = clean_code(.data[[fdi_value_columns$country]]),
    landing_value_eur = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(
      .data[[fdi_value_columns$landing_value]]
    )))
  )

selected_value_gsas <- normalize_gsa(CS_gsas, strict = TRUE)
selected_value_gears <- clean_code(gears_to_submit)
selected_value_species <- clean_code(species_to_submit)
selected_value_years <- as.integer(years_to_submit)

fdi_value_selected <- fdi_value_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$country == clean_code(economic_country_code),
    .data$YEAR %in% selected_value_years,
    .data$GSA %in% selected_value_gsas,
    .data$Gear %in% selected_value_gears
  )

if (nrow(fdi_value_selected) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "FDI Table A contains no first-sale values for the selected economic ",
    "country, years, GSAs and gears.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

invalid_fdi_value_rows <- fdi_value_selected %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(.data$YEAR) |
      is.na(.data$GSA) |
      is.na(.data$Gear) |
      is.na(.data$Species) |
      is.na(.data$reference_VL) |
      !nzchar(.data$Gear) |
      !nzchar(.data$Species) |
      !nzchar(.data$reference_VL) |
      !is.finite(.data$landing_value_eur) |
      .data$landing_value_eur < 0
  )

if (nrow(invalid_fdi_value_rows) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(invalid_fdi_value_rows),
    " selected FDI Table-A rows have invalid landing-value fields. ",
    "Inspect 'invalid_fdi_value_rows'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

fdi_value_by_year_segment <- fdi_value_selected %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$reference_VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    GVL_FDI_all_species = sum(.data$landing_value_eur),
    GVL_FDI_6sp = sum(
      .data$landing_value_eur[
        .data$Species %in% selected_value_species
      ]
    ),
    n_FDI_species = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Species),
    n_FDI_GSAs = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$GSA),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    GVL_FDI_other_species =
      .data$GVL_FDI_all_species - .data$GVL_FDI_6sp,
    six_species_value_share = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$GVL_FDI_all_species > 0,
      .data$GVL_FDI_6sp / .data$GVL_FDI_all_species,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

value_tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(
  1,
  fdi_value_by_year_segment$GVL_FDI_all_species
)

if (any(
  fdi_value_by_year_segment$GVL_FDI_other_species < -value_tolerance
)) {
  stop(
    "The value of the six modelled species exceeds total FDI landing value ",
    "in at least one fleet segment.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

fdi_value_by_year_segment <- fdi_value_by_year_segment %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    GVL_FDI_other_species = pmax(
      0,
      .data$GVL_FDI_other_species
    )
  )

fdi_other_value_reference <- fdi_value_by_year_segment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Gear, .data$reference_VL) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_reference_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    first_reference_year = min(.data$YEAR),
    last_reference_year = max(.data$YEAR),
    mean_GVL_FDI_all_species = mean(
      .data$GVL_FDI_all_species
    ),
    mean_GVL_FDI_6sp = mean(.data$GVL_FDI_6sp),
    GVL_other_reference_total = mean(
      .data$GVL_FDI_other_species
    ),
    six_species_value_share = dplyr::if_else(
      sum(.data$GVL_FDI_all_species) > 0,
      sum(.data$GVL_FDI_6sp) /
        sum(.data$GVL_FDI_all_species),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$Gear, .data$reference_VL)

if (
  any(!is.finite(fdi_other_value_reference$GVL_other_reference_total)) ||
    any(fdi_other_value_reference$GVL_other_reference_total < 0)
) {
  stop("Invalid multiannual FDI residual landing values were produced.")
}

smart31_preview_table(
  fdi_value_by_year_segment,
  "Annual FDI first-sale value represented by all and modelled species"
)

smart31_preview_table(
  fdi_other_value_reference,
  "Fixed multiannual value of the non-modelled species by fleet segment"
)
```

```{r step1-39-estimate-age-proportions, eval=run_age_module, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=TRUE}
smart31_age_log <- function(...) {
  gc_status <- gc()
  used_memory_mb <- sum(gc_status[, 2L], na.rm = TRUE)

  log_line <- sprintf(
    "%s | R memory: %.1f MB | %s",
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    used_memory_mb,
    paste0(..., collapse = "")
  )

  cat(log_line, "\n")
  cat(
    log_line, "\n",
    file = smart31_age_log_file,
    append = TRUE,
    sep = ""
  )
  flush.console()

  invisible(log_line)
}

smart31_age_clean_names <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", x)
  tolower(x)
}

smart31_age_clean_code <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[is.na(x) | !nzchar(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

smart31_age_numeric <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub(",", ".", trimws(as.character(x)), fixed = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

smart31_age_normalize_gsa <- function(x) {
  original <- x
  token <- smart31_age_clean_code(x)
  token <- sub("^GSA[[:space:]_-]*", "", token)
  token <- gsub(",", ".", token, fixed = TRUE)
  token <- gsub("[[:space:]_-]+", "", token)

  output <- rep(NA_character_, length(token))

  integer_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", token)
  if (any(integer_format)) {
    value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(token[integer_format]))
    output[integer_format] <- ifelse(
      value < 100L,
      sprintf("GSA%02d", value),
      paste0("GSA", value)
    )
  }

  decimal_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", token)
  if (any(decimal_format)) {
    parts <- strsplit(token[decimal_format], "\\.")
    output[decimal_format] <- vapply(
      parts,
      function(z) {
        paste0(
          "GSA", sprintf("%02d", as.integer(z[1L])),
          paste0(z[-1L], collapse = "")
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }

  output[is.na(original) | !nzchar(trimws(as.character(original)))] <- NA
  output
}

smart31_age_read_excel <- function(path, required_columns, label) {

  header <- readxl::read_excel(
    path,
    sheet = 1,
    n_max = 0,
    na = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
    .name_repair = "minimal"
  )
  clean_header <- smart31_age_clean_names(names(header))

  if (anyDuplicated(clean_header)) {
    stop(
      "Duplicated column names after standardisation in ", basename(path),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, clean_header)
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      label, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  column_types <- rep("skip", length(clean_header))
  column_types[clean_header %in% required_columns] <- "text"

  result <- readxl::read_excel(
    path,
    sheet = 1,
    na = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
    col_types = column_types,
    .name_repair = "minimal"
  )
  names(result) <- smart31_age_clean_names(names(result))

  tibble::as_tibble(result)
}

smart31_age_read_cache <- function(
    cache_path,
    source_path,
    required_columns,
    expected_filter_scope,
    label) {
  payload <- readRDS(cache_path)

  required_payload_fields <- c(
    "cache_version", "source_file", "source_size", "source_mtime",
    "required_columns", "filter_scope", "n_rows", "data"
  )

  if (!is.list(payload) ||
      !all(required_payload_fields %in% names(payload))) {
    stop(
      label, " is not a valid SMART3.1 MEDITS age cache.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!identical(payload$cache_version, "SMART31.medits.cache.1")) {
    stop(
      label, " was created by an incompatible cache version: ",
      as.character(payload$cache_version),
      ". Rebuild the MEDITS age caches.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  source_information <- file.info(source_path)
  current_source_size <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(source_information$size)[1L]
  )
  cached_source_size <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(payload$source_size)[1L]
  )

  if (!is.finite(current_source_size) ||
      !is.finite(cached_source_size) ||
      current_source_size != cached_source_size) {
    stop(
      label, " has a source-size mismatch with ", basename(source_path),
      " (cache: ", cached_source_size,
      " bytes; current workbook: ", current_source_size,
      " bytes). Rebuild the MEDITS age caches.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  cached_source_file <- gsub(
    "\\\\", "/", as.character(payload$source_file)[1L]
  )

  if (is.na(cached_source_file) || !nzchar(cached_source_file) ||
      basename(cached_source_file) != basename(source_path)) {
    stop(
      label, " was not built from ", basename(source_path),
      ". Rebuild the MEDITS age caches.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!identical(payload$filter_scope, expected_filter_scope)) {
    stop(
      label, " has an unexpected filter scope: ",
      as.character(payload$filter_scope),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  data <- tibble::as_tibble(payload$data)
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(data))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      label, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!identical(as.integer(payload$n_rows), as.integer(nrow(data)))) {
    stop(label, " has an inconsistent row count.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  current_source_md5 <- tolower(
    unname(tools::md5sum(source_path)[[1L]])
  )

  if (length(current_source_md5) != 1L ||
      is.na(current_source_md5) || !nzchar(current_source_md5)) {
    stop(
      "Unable to calculate the MD5 fingerprint of ", basename(source_path),
      ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  cached_source_md5 <- if ("source_md5" %in% names(payload)) {
    tolower(trimws(as.character(payload$source_md5)[1L]))
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }

  cache_validation_method <- if (
    !is.na(cached_source_md5) && nzchar(cached_source_md5)
  ) {
    if (!identical(cached_source_md5, current_source_md5)) {
      stop(
        label, " has a source-content mismatch with ",
        basename(source_path),
        ". Rebuild the MEDITS age caches.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    "source_md5_and_structure"
  } else {

    "legacy_source_size_and_structure"
  }

  data <- data[required_columns]
  attr(data, "SMART31_age_cache_version") <- payload$cache_version
  attr(data, "SMART31_age_cache_filter_scope") <- payload$filter_scope
  attr(data, "SMART31_age_cache_validation") <- cache_validation_method
  attr(data, "SMART31_age_source_md5") <- current_source_md5
  data
}

smart31_age_require_columns <- function(data, required, label) {
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      label, " is missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

smart31_age_ddmm_to_decimal <- function(value, quadrant, axis) {
  axis <- match.arg(axis, c("latitude", "longitude"))
  raw_value <- smart31_age_numeric(value)
  absolute_value <- abs(raw_value)
  maximum_decimal <- if (axis == "latitude") 90 else 180
  finite_value <- is.finite(absolute_value)

  decimal_format <- finite_value & absolute_value <= maximum_decimal
  ddmm_candidate <- finite_value & absolute_value > maximum_decimal
  degrees <- floor(absolute_value / 100)
  minutes <- absolute_value - degrees * 100
  valid_ddmm <- ddmm_candidate &
    degrees >= 0 & degrees <= maximum_decimal &
    minutes >= 0 & minutes < 60

  decimal <- rep(NA_real_, length(absolute_value))
  decimal[decimal_format] <- absolute_value[decimal_format]
  decimal[valid_ddmm] <-
    degrees[valid_ddmm] + minutes[valid_ddmm] / 60

  q <- smart31_age_clean_code(quadrant)
  q <- sub("\\..*$", "", q)

  negative_by_quadrant <- if (axis == "latitude") {
    q %in% c("3", "4", "S", "SW", "SE")
  } else {
    q %in% c("2", "3", "W", "NW", "SW")
  }

  sign_value <- ifelse(raw_value < 0 | negative_by_quadrant, -1, 1)
  decimal <- decimal * sign_value
  decimal[
    !is.finite(decimal) | abs(decimal) > maximum_decimal
  ] <- NA_real_
  decimal
}

smart31_age_row_mean <- function(x, y) {
  result <- rowMeans(cbind(x, y), na.rm = TRUE)
  result[!is.finite(result)] <- NA_real_
  result
}

smart31_age_positive_or_na <- function(x) {
  x <- smart31_age_numeric(x)
  x[!is.finite(x) | x <= 0] <- NA_real_
  x
}

smart31_age_make_haul_id <- function(data) {
  paste(
    smart31_age_clean_code(data$country),
    trimws(as.character(data$area)),
    smart31_age_clean_code(data$vessel),
    trimws(as.character(data$year)),
    trimws(as.character(data$haul_number)),
    smart31_age_clean_code(data$codend_closing),
    smart31_age_clean_code(data$name_of_survey),
    sep = "|"
  )
}

smart31_age_grid_geometry <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "sf")) {
    return(x)
  }
  if (is.list(x) && "grid_sf" %in% names(x) &&
      inherits(x$grid_sf, "sf")) {
    return(x$grid_sf)
  }
  stop("grid_sf must be an sf object or contain grid_sf$grid_sf.", call. = FALSE)
}

      .data$hauling_latitude, .data$hauling_quadrant, "latitude"
    ),
    hauling_longitude_dd = smart31_age_ddmm_to_decimal(
      .data$hauling_longitude, .data$hauling_quadrant, "longitude"
    ),
    shooting_coordinate_valid =
      is.finite(.data$shooting_latitude_dd) &
      is.finite(.data$shooting_longitude_dd),
    hauling_coordinate_valid =
      is.finite(.data$hauling_latitude_dd) &
      is.finite(.data$hauling_longitude_dd),
    latitude = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$shooting_coordinate_valid & .data$hauling_coordinate_valid ~
        (.data$shooting_latitude_dd + .data$hauling_latitude_dd) / 2,
      .data$shooting_coordinate_valid ~ .data$shooting_latitude_dd,
      .data$hauling_coordinate_valid ~ .data$hauling_latitude_dd,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    longitude = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$shooting_coordinate_valid & .data$hauling_coordinate_valid ~
        (.data$shooting_longitude_dd + .data$hauling_longitude_dd) / 2,
      .data$shooting_coordinate_valid ~ .data$shooting_longitude_dd,
      .data$hauling_coordinate_valid ~ .data$hauling_longitude_dd,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    depth_m = smart31_age_row_mean(
      smart31_age_positive_or_na(.data$shooting_depth),
      smart31_age_positive_or_na(.data$hauling_depth)
    ),
    distance_m = smart31_age_positive_or_na(.data$distance),

  grid_gsa_area_11 <- grid_gsa_sf_age %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code %in% c("GSA111", "GSA112"))

  if (nrow(grid_gsa_area_11) == 0L) {

      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  area_11_points <- sf::st_as_sf(
    ta_medits[area_11_index, ],
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(grid_gsa_sf_age))

  nearest_grid_index <- sf::st_nearest_feature(
    area_11_points,
    grid_gsa_area_11
  )

  ta_medits$GSA_code[area_11_index] <-
    grid_gsa_area_11$GSA_code[nearest_grid_index]

  ta_medits$gsa_assignment_distance_m[area_11_index] <- as.numeric(
    sf::st_distance(
      area_11_points,
      grid_gsa_area_11[nearest_grid_index, ],
      by_element = TRUE
    )
  )
}

smart31_age_log("[AGE 3/8] Reconstructing MEDITS biomass by haul and age...")

medits_species_crosswalk <- tibble::as_tibble(.smart31_case$survey$species_crosswalk)
if (!all(c("medits_genus","medits_species","Species") %in% names(medits_species_crosswalk)) ||
    anyNA(medits_species_crosswalk) || anyDuplicated(medits_species_crosswalk[c("medits_genus","medits_species")]))
  stop("Invalid MEDITS species crosswalk in case configuration.")


selected_age_species <- intersect(
  smart31_age_clean_code(species_to_submit),
  stock_parameters$Species
)

age_species_not_parameterized <- setdiff(
  smart31_age_clean_code(species_to_submit),
  selected_age_species
)

if (length(selected_age_species) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "None of species_to_submit has a row in the stock-parameter table.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

prepare_medits_taxon_table <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      country = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$country),
      area = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$area)),
      vessel = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$vessel),
      year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$year)),
      haul_number = trimws(as.character(.data$haul_number)),
      codend_closing = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$codend_closing),
      name_of_survey = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$name_of_survey),
      partit = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$partit),
      catfau = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$catfau),
      genus = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$genus),
      species = smart31_age_clean_code(.data$species),
      medits_genus = substr(.data$genus, 1L, 4L),
      medits_species = substr(.data$species, 1L, 3L),
      haul_id = smart31_age_make_haul_id(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$country %in% .smart31_case$domain$country_aliases,
      .data$name_of_survey == "MEDITS",
      .data$area %in% .smart31_case$survey$areas
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      medits_species_crosswalk,
      by = c("medits_genus", "medits_species"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    )
}

available_medits_taxa <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tb_raw %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      medits_genus = substr(smart31_age_clean_code(.data$genus), 1L, 4L),
      medits_species = substr(smart31_age_clean_code(.data$species), 1L, 3L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(),
  tc_raw %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      medits_genus = substr(smart31_age_clean_code(.data$genus), 1L, 4L),
      medits_species = substr(smart31_age_clean_code(.data$species), 1L, 3L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

medits_crosswalk_diagnostics <- medits_species_crosswalk %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Species %in% selected_age_species) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    available_medits_taxa %>%
      dplyr::mutate(code_found_in_medits = TRUE),
    by = c("medits_genus", "medits_species"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    code_found_in_medits = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$code_found_in_medits,
      FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$Species, dplyr::desc(.data$code_found_in_medits))

medits_species_found <- medits_crosswalk_diagnostics %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$code_found_in_medits) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Species)

missing_target_medits_species <- tibble::tibble(
  Species = selected_age_species
) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    medits_species_found,
    by = "Species"
  )

if (nrow(missing_target_medits_species) > 0L) {
  print(missing_target_medits_species)
  print(
    medits_crosswalk_diagnostics %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$Species %in% missing_target_medits_species$Species)
  )
  stop(
    "At least one target species has no observed MEDITS code in TB/TC. ",
    "Inspect 'missing_target_medits_species' and ",
    "'medits_crosswalk_diagnostics' before continuing.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

smart31_age_log(
  "[AGE 3/8] MEDITS crosswalk validated for ",

)

tb_medits <- prepare_medits_taxon_table(tb_raw) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Species %in% selected_age_species) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ptot_value = smart31_age_numeric(.data$ptot),
    nbtot_value = smart31_age_numeric(.data$nbtot),
    ptot_value = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$ptot_value) & .data$ptot_value >= 0,
      .data$ptot_value,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

tb_haul_species <- tb_medits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$haul_id, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    tb_observed = TRUE,
    ptot_g = if (all(is.na(.data$ptot_value))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(.data$ptot_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    nbtot = if (all(is.na(.data$nbtot_value))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(.data$nbtot_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    ta_medits %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$haul_id, .data$GSA_code, .data$GSA_parameter,
        .data$depth_m, .data$swept_area_km2
      ),
    by = "haul_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

rm(tb_medits, tb_raw)
smart31_age_log("[AGE 3a] TB aggregation completed; raw data released.")

tc_medits <- prepare_medits_taxon_table(tc_raw) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Species %in% selected_age_species) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    ta_medits %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$haul_id, .data$GSA_code, .data$GSA_parameter,
        .data$depth_m, .data$swept_area_km2
      ),
    by = "haul_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    stock_parameters,
    by = c("Species", "GSA_parameter"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    codlon_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(.data$codlon))),
    length_class_mm = smart31_age_numeric(.data$length_class),
    class_width_mm = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$codlon_clean == "m" ~ 1,
      .data$codlon_clean == "0" ~ 5,
      .data$codlon_clean == "1" ~ 10,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    length_mid_mm = .data$length_class_mm + .data$class_width_mm / 2,
    length_for_model = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$Length_unit == "mm" ~ .data$length_mid_mm,
      .data$Length_unit == "cm" ~ .data$length_mid_mm / 10,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    pfrac_value = smart31_age_numeric(.data$pfrac),
    pechan_value = smart31_age_numeric(.data$pechan),
    nblon_value = smart31_age_numeric(.data$nblon),
    valid_pfrac = is.finite(.data$pfrac_value) & .data$pfrac_value > 0,
    valid_pechan = is.finite(.data$pechan_value) & .data$pechan_value > 0,
    raising_factor = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$valid_pfrac & .data$valid_pechan ~
        .data$pfrac_value / .data$pechan_value,
      !.data$valid_pfrac & !.data$valid_pechan ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    n_raised = .data$nblon_value * .data$raising_factor,
    age_continuous = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$length_for_model) &
        .data$length_for_model > 0 &
        .data$length_for_model < .data$Linf,
      .data$t0 - log1p(-.data$length_for_model / .data$Linf) / .data$K,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Age = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(.data$length_for_model) &
        .data$length_for_model >= .data$Linf ~ .data$Age_plus,
      is.finite(.data$age_continuous) ~ pmax(
        .data$Age_min,
        pmin(
          .data$Age_plus,
          as.integer(floor(.data$age_continuous + 0.5))
        )
      ),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    individual_weight_g = .data$a * .data$length_for_model ^ .data$b,
    biomass_proxy_g = .data$n_raised * .data$individual_weight_g
  )

rm(tc_raw)
smart31_age_log(
  "[AGE 3b] TC target-species table prepared: ",
  nrow(tc_medits), " rows; TC raw data released."
)

tc_age_proxy <- tc_medits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$haul_id, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

  dplyr::group_by(.data$haul_id, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    biomass_proxy_total_g = sum(.data$biomass_proxy_g),
    age_biomass_share = .data$biomass_proxy_g /
      .data$biomass_proxy_total_g
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$biomass_proxy_total_g),
    .data$biomass_proxy_total_g > 0,
    is.finite(.data$age_biomass_share)
  )

medits_age_biomass <- tc_age_proxy %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(

      dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$ptot_g), .data$ptot_g > 0) %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$haul_id, .data$Species, .data$ptot_g),
    by = c("haul_id", "Species"),

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

composition_available <- medits_age_biomass %>%

tc_tb_number_check <- tc_age_proxy %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$haul_id, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    tc_n_raised = sum(.data$n_raised),
    .groups = "drop"

  dplyr::left_join(
    tb_haul_species %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$haul_id, .data$Species, .data$nbtot),

    absolute_difference = abs(.data$tc_n_raised - .data$nbtot),

    )
  )

rm(tc_medits, tc_age_proxy)
smart31_age_log("[AGE 3/8] Age-biomass reconstruction completed.")

smart31_age_log(
  "[AGE 4/8] Building the complete MEDITS age-density table..."
)

survey_hauls <- ta_medits %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$haul_id, .data$GSA_code, .data$GSA_parameter,
    .data$depth_m, .data$swept_area_km2
  )

haul_species_frame <- survey_hauls %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    stock_parameters %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$Species %in% selected_age_species) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(.data$GSA_parameter, .data$Species),
    by = "GSA_parameter",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tb_haul_species %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$haul_id, .data$Species, .data$tb_observed,
        .data$ptot_g, .data$nbtot
      ),
    by = c("haul_id", "Species"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    composition_available,
    by = c("haul_id", "Species"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tb_observed = dplyr::coalesce(.data$tb_observed, FALSE),
    composition_available = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$composition_available, FALSE
    ),
    tb_known = !.data$tb_observed |
      (is.finite(.data$ptot_g) & .data$ptot_g >= 0),
    species_present = .data$tb_observed &
      is.finite(.data$ptot_g) & .data$ptot_g > 0,
    usable_for_age_model =
      (!.data$tb_observed) |
      (.data$tb_known & !.data$species_present) |
      (.data$species_present & .data$composition_available)
  )

medits_excluded_haul_species <- haul_species_frame %>%
  dplyr::filter(!.data$usable_for_age_model)

medits_age_density <- haul_species_frame %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$usable_for_age_model) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    age_classes,
    by = c("Species", "GSA_parameter"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    medits_age_biomass %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$haul_id, .data$Species, .data$Age, .data$biomass_kg
      ),
    by = c("haul_id", "Species", "Age"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    biomass_kg = dplyr::case_when(
      !.data$species_present ~ 0,
      .data$species_present & is.na(.data$biomass_kg) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ .data$biomass_kg
    ),
    density_kg_km2 = .data$biomass_kg / .data$swept_area_km2
  )

if (any(
  !is.finite(medits_age_density$density_kg_km2) |
    medits_age_density$density_kg_km2 < 0
)) {
  stop("MEDITS age-density table contains invalid values.", call. = FALSE)
}

medits_model_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  medits_age_density %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model_gsa = .data$GSA_code),
  medits_age_density %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_parameter == 11L) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model_gsa = "GSA11")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$model_gsa %in% c("GSA09", "GSA10", "GSA11", "GSA111", "GSA112")
  )

rm(
  survey_hauls, haul_species_frame, composition_available,
  medits_age_biomass, tb_haul_species
)
smart31_age_log(
  "[AGE 4/8] Density table completed: ",
  nrow(medits_age_density), " rows; model table: ",
  nrow(medits_model_data), " rows."
)

smart31_age_log("[AGE 5/8] Fitting age-specific depth profiles...")

model_key_table <- medits_model_data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$model_gsa, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$model_gsa, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    model_name = paste(.data$model_gsa, .data$Species, .data$Age, sep = "|")
  )

age_depth_models <- stats::setNames(
  vector("list", nrow(model_key_table)),
  model_key_table$model_name
)

for (model_index in seq_len(nrow(model_key_table))) {
  model_key <- model_key_table[model_index, ]
  model_name <- model_key$model_name[[1L]]
  fitted_model <- NULL

  model_data <- medits_model_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$model_gsa == model_key$model_gsa[[1L]],
      .data$Species == model_key$Species[[1L]],
      .data$Age == model_key$Age[[1L]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(log_depth = log1p(.data$depth_m))

  n_total_hauls <- dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$haul_id)
  n_positive_hauls <- dplyr::n_distinct(
    model_data$haul_id[model_data$density_kg_km2 > 0]
  )
  n_positive_depths <- length(unique(
    model_data$depth_m[model_data$density_kg_km2 > 0]
  ))
  observed_depth_range <- range(model_data$depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)

  model_entry <- list(
    status = "constant_insufficient_support",
    model = NULL,
    reference_prediction = 1,
    depth_min_m = observed_depth_range[1L],
    depth_max_m = observed_depth_range[2L],
    n_total_hauls = n_total_hauls,
    n_positive_hauls = n_positive_hauls,
    n_positive_depths = n_positive_depths
  )

  sufficient_support <-
    n_total_hauls >= age_min_total_hauls_for_gam &&
    n_positive_hauls >= age_min_positive_hauls_for_gam &&
    n_positive_depths >= age_min_positive_depths_for_gam

  if (sufficient_support) {
    k_value <- min(
      age_gam_basis_dimension,
      max(3L, length(unique(model_data$log_depth)) - 1L)
    )

    fitted_model <- tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        density_kg_km2 ~ s(log_depth, k = k_value, bs = "tp"),
        data = model_data,
        family = mgcv::tw(link = "log"),
        method = "REML"
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (!inherits(fitted_model, "error")) {
      reference_prediction <- mean(
        stats::predict(fitted_model, type = "response"),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      if (is.finite(reference_prediction) && reference_prediction > 0) {

        fitted_model$model <- NULL
        fitted_model$y <- NULL

        model_entry$status <- "gsa_depth_gam"
        model_entry$model <- fitted_model
        model_entry$reference_prediction <- reference_prediction
      } else {
        model_entry$status <- "constant_invalid_reference_prediction"
      }
    } else {
      model_entry$status <- paste0(
        "constant_gam_error: ", conditionMessage(fitted_model)
      )
    }
  }

  age_depth_models[[model_name]] <- model_entry

  rm(model_data, model_entry)

  if (model_index %% 10L == 0L || model_index == nrow(model_key_table)) {
    smart31_age_log(
      "[AGE 5/8] Fitted ", model_index, " of ",
      nrow(model_key_table), " age-depth model groups."
    )
  }
}

age_model_support <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  names(age_depth_models),
  function(model_name) {
    fields <- strsplit(model_name, "\\|", fixed = FALSE)[[1L]]
    entry <- age_depth_models[[model_name]]
    tibble::tibble(
      model_gsa = fields[1L],
      Species = fields[2L],
      Age = as.integer(fields[3L]),
      model_status = entry$status,
      n_total_hauls = entry$n_total_hauls,
      n_positive_hauls = entry$n_positive_hauls,
      n_positive_depths = entry$n_positive_depths,
      depth_min_m = entry$depth_min_m,
      depth_max_m = entry$depth_max_m
    )
  }
))

rm(
  list = intersect(
    c("model_key_table", "model_key", "model_name", "model_index",
      "fitted_model"),
    ls()
  )
)
smart31_age_log("[AGE 5/8] Age-depth model fitting completed.")

smart31_age_log("[AGE 6/8] Preparing marginal age baselines...")

commercial_age_baseline_report <- smart31_commercial_age_input(.smart31_case$paths$commercial_age_baseline)


medits_baseline_by_gsa <- medits_model_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$model_gsa, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_density = mean(.data$density_kg_km2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$model_gsa, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_age_classes = dplyr::n(),
    raw_total = sum(.data$mean_density),
    raw_proportion = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$raw_total > 0,
      .data$mean_density / .data$raw_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    medits_baseline_proportion =
      (1 - age_medits_uniform_weight) * .data$raw_proportion +
      age_medits_uniform_weight / .data$n_age_classes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$medits_baseline_proportion))

medits_baseline_global <- medits_age_density %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_density = mean(.data$density_kg_km2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_age_classes = dplyr::n(),
    raw_total = sum(.data$mean_density),
    raw_proportion = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$raw_total > 0,
      .data$mean_density / .data$raw_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    global_baseline_proportion =
      (1 - age_medits_uniform_weight) * .data$raw_proportion +
      age_medits_uniform_weight / .data$n_age_classes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$global_baseline_proportion))

rm(medits_model_data, medits_age_density)
smart31_age_log(
  "[AGE 6/8] Marginal baselines completed; density tables released."
)

predict_one_age_profile <- function(data, key) {
  current_gsa <- key$GSA_code[1L]
  current_species <- key$Species[1L]
  current_age <- key$Age[1L]

  preferred_key <- paste(
    current_gsa, current_species, current_age, sep = "|"
  )
  pooled_gsa11_key <- paste(
    "GSA11", current_species, current_age, sep = "|"
  )

  selected_key <- preferred_key
  model_source <- "constant_no_supported_depth_model"

  preferred_entry <- age_depth_models[[preferred_key]]
  preferred_supported <- !is.null(preferred_entry) &&
    identical(preferred_entry$status, "gsa_depth_gam")

  if (preferred_supported) {
    selected_entry <- preferred_entry
    model_source <- "GSA-specific depth GAM"
  } else if (
    current_gsa %in% c("GSA111", "GSA112") &&
      !is.null(age_depth_models[[pooled_gsa11_key]]) &&
      identical(
        age_depth_models[[pooled_gsa11_key]]$status,
        "gsa_depth_gam"
      )
  ) {
    selected_key <- pooled_gsa11_key
    selected_entry <- age_depth_models[[pooled_gsa11_key]]
    model_source <- "pooled GSA11 depth GAM"
  } else {
    selected_entry <- if (!is.null(preferred_entry)) {
      preferred_entry
    } else {
      list(
        n_total_hauls = 0L,
        n_positive_hauls = 0L,
        n_positive_depths = 0L,
        depth_min_m = min(data$depth_m),
        depth_max_m = max(data$depth_m)
      )
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(selected_entry$model)) {
    prediction_depth <- pmax(
      selected_entry$depth_min_m,
      pmin(selected_entry$depth_max_m, data$depth_m)
    )

    predicted_density <- as.numeric(stats::predict(
      selected_entry$model,
      newdata = data.frame(log_depth = log1p(prediction_depth)),
      type = "response"
    ))

    depth_modifier <- predicted_density /
      selected_entry$reference_prediction
    depth_modifier <- pmax(
      age_depth_modifier_bounds[1L],
      pmin(age_depth_modifier_bounds[2L], depth_modifier)
    )
  } else {
    prediction_depth <- data$depth_m
    depth_modifier <- rep(1, nrow(data))
  }

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      depth_used_m = prediction_depth,
      depth_modifier = depth_modifier,
      depth_model_source = model_source,
      depth_model_key = selected_key,
      n_supporting_hauls = selected_entry$n_total_hauls,
      n_positive_supporting_hauls = selected_entry$n_positive_hauls,
      n_positive_supporting_depths = selected_entry$n_positive_depths
    )
}

  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(

      ),

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    baseline_proportion = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$report_baseline_proportion,
      .data$preferred_medits_proportion,
      dplyr::if_else(
        .data$GSA_code %in% c("GSA111", "GSA112"),
        .data$pooled_gsa11_proportion,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .data$global_baseline_proportion
    ),
    baseline_source = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(.data$report_baseline_proportion) ~
        "commercial catch-at-age biomass",
      is.finite(.data$preferred_medits_proportion) ~
        "GSA MEDITS biomass, 1% uniform shrinkage",
      .data$GSA_code %in% c("GSA111", "GSA112") &
        is.finite(.data$pooled_gsa11_proportion) ~
        "pooled GSA11 MEDITS biomass, 1% uniform shrinkage",
      is.finite(.data$global_baseline_proportion) ~
        "all-GSA MEDITS biomass, 1% uniform shrinkage",
      TRUE ~ "missing"
    ),
    unnormalised_age_weight = .data$baseline_proportion *
      .data$depth_modifier
  )
```
