```{r step1-40-plot-age-proportions, eval=run_age_module, fig.align="center", fig.height=8, fig.width=12, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
}

age_species_requested <- unique(
  trimws(as.character(species_to_submit))
)

age_species_requested <- age_species_requested[
  !is.na(age_species_requested) & nzchar(age_species_requested)
]

age_species_available <- unique(age_map_values$Species)

age_species_without_proportions <- setdiff(
  age_species_requested,
  age_species_available
)

if (length(age_species_without_proportions) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "No age-proportion estimates are available for: ",
    paste(age_species_without_proportions, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

age_species_to_plot <- intersect(
  age_species_requested,
  age_species_available
)

if (length(age_species_to_plot) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "None of species_to_submit has age-proportion estimates.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

age_map_normalized_fao_names <- tolower(
  gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "", names(fao3))
)

smart31_age_map_find_fao_column <- function(candidate_names) {
  normalized_candidates <- tolower(
    gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "", candidate_names)
  )

  candidate_positions <- match(
    normalized_candidates,
    age_map_normalized_fao_names,
    nomatch = 0L
  )
  candidate_positions <- candidate_positions[candidate_positions > 0L]

  if (length(candidate_positions) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  names(fao3)[candidate_positions[[1L]]]
}

age_map_species_code_column <- smart31_age_map_find_fao_column(
  c("3A_CODE", "X3A_CODE", "species_code", "Species")
)

age_map_scientific_name_column <- smart31_age_map_find_fao_column(
  c("Scientific_name", "Scientific.name", "scientificname")
)

if (
  is.na(age_map_species_code_column) ||
    is.na(age_map_scientific_name_column)
) {
  stop(
    "Could not identify the species-code and scientific-name columns in fao3.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

age_map_fao_lookup <- fao3 |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Species = trimws(
      as.character(.data[[age_map_species_code_column]])
    ),
    Scientific_name = trimws(
      as.character(.data[[age_map_scientific_name_column]])
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$Species),
    nzchar(.data$Species),
    !is.na(.data$Scientific_name),
    nzchar(.data$Scientific_name)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Species, .keep_all = TRUE)

age_map_species_metadata <- tibble::tibble(
  Species = age_species_to_plot,
  x = age_map_x_range[1L] + 0.10 * diff(age_map_x_range),
  y = age_map_y_range[1L] + 0.10 * diff(age_map_y_range),
  silhouette = file.path(
    "png",
    paste0(age_species_to_plot, ".png")
  )
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(age_map_fao_lookup, by = "Species") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    silhouette_available = file.exists(.data$silhouette),
    plot_title = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(.data$Scientific_name) &
        nzchar(.data$Scientific_name),
      paste0(.data$Species, " – ", .data$Scientific_name),
      .data$Species
    )
  )

age_map_missing_silhouettes <- age_map_species_metadata |>
  dplyr::filter(!.data$silhouette_available)

if (nrow(age_map_missing_silhouettes) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "Silhouette files not found for: ",
    paste(age_map_missing_silhouettes$Species, collapse = ", "),
    ". Maps will be produced without those images.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

age_map_plot_data <- age_map_grid_geometry |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(.data$id_grid) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(age_map_values, by = "id_grid") |>
  sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)

age_map_cells_inside <- lengths(
  sf::st_intersects(
    age_map_plot_data,
    age_map_window
  )
) > 0L

age_map_plot_data <- age_map_plot_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(inside_map_extent = age_map_cells_inside)

if (nrow(age_map_plot_data) != nrow(age_map_values)) {
  stop(
    "The spatial join changed the number of age-proportion records.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

age_map_diagnostic <- age_map_plot_data |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species,
    .data$Age,
    .data$Age_label
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$id_grid),
    n_cells_inside_map = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$id_grid[.data$inside_map_extent]
    ),
    minimum_proportion = min(.data$age_proportion),
    median_proportion = stats::median(.data$age_proportion),
    maximum_proportion = max(.data$age_proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$Species,
    .data$Age,
    .data$GSA_code
  )

age_map_values_outside_extent <- age_map_diagnostic |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$n_cells > .data$n_cells_inside_map)

if (nrow(age_map_values_outside_extent) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "Some age-proportion cells fall outside map_xlim/map_ylim. ",
    "Inspect age_map_values_outside_extent.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

age_map_facet_columns <- 4L

make_age_proportion_map <- function(species_code) {
  species_data <- age_map_plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Species == species_code,
      .data$inside_map_extent
    )

  if (nrow(species_data) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No age-proportion cell for species ",
      species_code,
      " intersects the map extent.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  species_age_levels <- species_data |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::distinct(.data$Age, .data$Age_label) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Age) |>
    dplyr::pull("Age_label")

  species_data <- species_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Age_panel = factor(
        paste0("Age ", .data$Age_label),
        levels = paste0("Age ", species_age_levels),
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    )

  species_data_zero <- species_data |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$age_proportion == 0)

  species_data_positive <- species_data |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$age_proportion > 0)

  species_metadata <- age_map_species_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$Species == species_code)

  if (nrow(species_metadata) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Species metadata are missing or duplicated for ",
      species_code,
      ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  n_modelled_cells <- dplyr::n_distinct(species_data$id_grid)

  map_subtitle <- paste0(
    "White: no estimate; grey: proportion = 0; coloured: proportion > 0",
    " | modelled cells: ",
    n_modelled_cells,
    " | one shared scale across ages"
  )

  map_object <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = age_map_grid_background,
      fill = "white",
      colour = "grey88",
      linewidth = 0.05
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = species_data_zero,
      fill = "grey72",
      colour = "grey58",
      linewidth = 0.05
    )

  if (nrow(species_data_positive) > 0L) {
    maximum_species_proportion <- max(
      species_data_positive$age_proportion
    )

    map_object <- map_object +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(
        data = species_data_positive,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          fill = .data$age_proportion
        ),
        colour = "grey20",
        linewidth = 0.06
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(
        name = "Age proportion",
        option = "plasma",
        begin = 0.15,
        end = 0.95,
        limits = c(0, maximum_species_proportion),
        oob = scales::squish,
        labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1),
        guide = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          barwidth = grid::unit(7, "cm"),
          barheight = grid::unit(0.45, "cm")
        )
      )
  } else {
    map_subtitle <- paste0(
      map_subtitle,
      " — no positive age proportions"
    )
  }

  map_object <- map_object +
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = mp,
      mapping = ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data$long,
        y = .data$lat,
        group = .data$group
      ),
      fill = "grey82",
      colour = "grey50",
      linewidth = 0.15
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ggplot2::vars(Age_panel),
      ncol = age_map_facet_columns,
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_sf(
      crs = sf::st_crs(4326),
      default_crs = sf::st_crs(4326),
      xlim = age_map_x_range,
      ylim = age_map_y_range,
      expand = FALSE,
      clip = "on"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = species_metadata$plot_title[[1L]],
      subtitle = map_subtitle,
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_test(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = NA
      ),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(
        colour = "grey90",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1, "cm"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 8,
        colour = "grey30"
      ),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.5, "cm")
    )

  if (isTRUE(species_metadata$silhouette_available[[1L]])) {
    if (!requireNamespace("ggimage", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop(
        "Package 'ggimage' is required to add species silhouettes.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    image_data <- species_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(.data$x, .data$y, .data$silhouette)

    map_object <- map_object +
      ggimage::geom_image(
        data = image_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = .data$x,
          y = .data$y,
          image = .data$silhouette
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 0.18
      )
  }

  map_object
}

age_proportion_maps <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(age_species_to_plot, make_age_proportion_map),
  age_species_to_plot
)

invisible(lapply(age_proportion_maps, print))

message(
  "\nAge-proportion maps completed: ",
  length(age_proportion_maps),
  " species."
)

message(
  "Individual ggplot objects are stored in 'age_proportion_maps'."
)

message(
  "Map diagnostics are stored in 'age_map_diagnostic'."
)
```

```{r step1-41-set-ibm, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, fig.align="center"}
ibm_memory_mb <- function() {

}

ibm_log <- function(...) {
  log_line <- paste0(
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    " | R memory: ",
    sprintf("%.1f", ibm_memory_mb()),
    " MB | ",
    paste0(..., collapse = "")
  )
  cat(log_line, "\n", file = ibm_log_file, append = TRUE)
  invisible(log_line)
}

required_effort_columns <- c(
  "CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear", "Metier", "id_grid",
  "loa", "fishing_time"
)

effort_records <- data.table::rbindlist(
  lapply(
    effort_sf_gridded_list,
    function(item) {
      plain_item <- if (inherits(item, "sf")) {
        sf::st_drop_geometry(item)
      } else {
        as.data.frame(item)
      }

      missing_columns <- setdiff(required_effort_columns, names(plain_item))
      if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
        stop(
          "An effort table is missing: ",
          paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }

      plain_item[required_effort_columns]
    }
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
    Gear = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Gear))),
    Metier = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Metier))),
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
    loa = as.numeric(.data$loa),
    fishing_time = as.numeric(.data$fishing_time)
  )

if (anyNA(effort_records) ||
    any(!is.finite(effort_records$loa)) ||
    any(!is.finite(effort_records$fishing_time)) ||
    any(effort_records$loa <= 0) ||
    any(effort_records$fishing_time < 0) ||
    any(!nzchar(effort_records$CFR)) ||
    any(!nzchar(effort_records$Gear)) ||
    any(!nzchar(effort_records$Metier)) ||
    any(!nzchar(effort_records$id_grid))) {
  stop(
    "Effort records contain missing, non-finite, invalid or blank values.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

  activity_without_grid_gsa_file <- file.path(
    activity_gsa_diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_activity_without_grid_gsa_",
      format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"),
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    activity_without_grid_gsa_diagnostic,
    activity_without_grid_gsa_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  stop(
    nrow(activity_without_grid_gsa),
    " IBM effort records have no canonical GSA assignment. Diagnostic: ",
    normalizePath(activity_without_grid_gsa_file, mustWork = FALSE),
    ". The records were not discarded; neither harbour nor vessel identity ",
    "was used to infer GSA.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ibm_lpue_support_by_cell <- lpue_cell_diagnostics %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
    GSA_code = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$GSA_code))),
    Species = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Species))),
    Gear = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Gear))),
    id_grid = trimws(as.character(.data$id_grid)),
    total_model_effort = as.numeric(.data$total_model_effort),
    retained = as.logical(.data$retained),
    exclusion_reason = trimws(as.character(.data$exclusion_reason))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_species_diagnosed = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Species),
    n_species_retained = sum(.data$retained, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_below_quantile = any(
      .data$exclusion_reason == "total effort below quantile threshold",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    all_without_positive_model_effort = all(
      .data$exclusion_reason == "no positive effort"
    ),
    .by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lpue_support_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$n_species_retained > 0L ~ "retained_for_one_or_more_targets",
      .data$any_below_quantile ~ "below_quantile_threshold",
      .data$all_without_positive_model_effort ~ "no_positive_model_effort",
      TRUE ~ "excluded_other_reason"
    )
  )

ibm_lpue_primary_status <- lpue_workflow_status %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
    GSA_code = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$GSA_code))),
    Species = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Species))),
    Gear = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Gear))),
    status = tolower(trimws(as.character(.data$status)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_primary_strata = dplyr::n(),
    n_primary_completed = sum(.data$status == "completed"),
    n_primary_failed = sum(.data$status == "failed"),
    n_primary_skipped = sum(.data$status == "skipped"),
    primary_model_status = dplyr::case_when(
      all(.data$status == "completed") ~ "all_primary_models_completed",
      any(.data$status == "failed") ~ "one_or_more_primary_models_failed",
      any(.data$status == "skipped") ~ "one_or_more_primary_models_skipped",
      TRUE ~ "other_primary_model_status"
    ),
    .by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear")
  )

IBM_effort <- IBM_effort %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ibm_lpue_positive_monthly_keys,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ibm_lpue_annual_proxy_keys,
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ibm_lpue_support_by_cell,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ibm_lpue_primary_status,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    positive_monthly_lpue_available = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$positive_monthly_lpue_available,
      FALSE
    ),
    supports_annual_proxy_lpue = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$supports_annual_proxy_lpue,
      FALSE
    ),
    positive_target_lpue_available = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$positive_monthly_lpue_available |
        .data$supports_annual_proxy_lpue,
      FALSE
    ),

    lpue_allocation_complete = TRUE,
    lpue_model_available = .data$lpue_allocation_complete,
    lpue_allocation_status = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$positive_target_lpue_available,
      "positive_allocated_lpue",
      "zero_allocated_lpue"
    ),
    lpue_status = .data$lpue_allocation_status,
    lpue_support_status = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$GSA_code) ~ "outside_lpue_allocation_grid",
      !is.na(.data$lpue_support_status) ~ .data$lpue_support_status,
      TRUE ~ "no_cell_support_diagnostic"
    ),
    primary_model_status = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$primary_model_status,
      "outside_or_undefined_primary_stratum"
    )
  )

IBM_effort_without_lpue <- IBM_effort %>%

IBM_effort_zero_target_lpue <- IBM_effort %>%

)

if (length(missing_price_annual_columns) > 0L) {

    "Missing columns in 'price_annual': ",

    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ibm_price_raw <- price_annual %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
    Species = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Species))),
    GSA = normalize_model_gsa(.data$GSA),
    Price = as.numeric(.data$Price),
    price_source_original = trimws(as.character(.data$price_source))
  )

if (anyNA(ibm_price_raw[c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")]) ||
    any(!nzchar(ibm_price_raw$Species)) ||
    any(!nzchar(ibm_price_raw$GSA))) {
  stop(
    "'price_annual' contains incomplete YEAR-Species-GSA keys.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(ibm_price_raw[c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")])) {
  stop(
    "'price_annual' is not unique by YEAR-Species-GSA.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (any(!is.finite(ibm_price_raw$Price[!is.na(ibm_price_raw$Price)])) ||
    any(ibm_price_raw$Price < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Available annual prices must be finite and non-negative. ",
    "A price equal to zero is valid and is retained.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ibm_required_price_keys <- ibm_lpue_rates_positive %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$YEAR, .data$Species, .data$GSA)

ibm_required_price_combinations <- ibm_required_price_keys %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Species, .data$GSA)

ibm_price_series <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ibm_price_raw %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      ibm_required_price_combinations,
      by = c("Species", "GSA")
    ),
  ibm_required_price_keys %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      ibm_price_raw,
      by = c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Price = NA_real_,
      price_source_original = NA_character_
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$YEAR, .data$Species, .data$GSA, .keep_all = TRUE)

ibm_price_for_join <- ibm_price_series %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Price_original = .data$Price,
    price_source_year = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(.data$Price),
      .data$YEAR,
      NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Species, .data$GSA) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$YEAR, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  tidyr::fill(Price, price_source_year, .direction = "down") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    ibm_required_price_keys,
    by = c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_carried_forward = is.na(.data$Price_original) & !is.na(.data$Price),
    price_source = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$price_carried_forward ~ paste0(
        "carried_forward_",
        .data$price_source_year
      ),
      !is.na(.data$Price_original) ~ dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$price_source_original,
        "annual_price_available_unspecified_source"
      ),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$YEAR, .data$Species, .data$GSA, .data$Price,
    .data$price_source, .data$price_carried_forward,
    .data$price_source_year
  )

IBM_price_carry_forward <- ibm_price_for_join %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$price_carried_forward) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$YEAR, .data$Species, .data$GSA)

IBM_price_keys_still_missing <- ibm_price_for_join %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$Price)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$YEAR, .data$Species, .data$GSA)

ibm_log(
  "[IBM 4/7] Annual prices validated; ",
  nrow(IBM_price_carry_forward),
  " keys carried forward; ",
  nrow(IBM_price_keys_still_missing),
  " keys still missing."
)

assembly_years <- sort(intersect(
  unique(IBM_effort$YEAR),
  unique(ibm_lpue_rates_positive$YEAR)
))

if (length(assembly_years) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No common year exists between IBM_effort and positive LPUE rates.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ibm_year_parts <- vector("list", length(assembly_years))
names(ibm_year_parts) <- as.character(assembly_years)

for (year_index in seq_along(assembly_years)) {
  current_year <- assembly_years[[year_index]]

  effort_year <- IBM_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR == current_year)

  rates_year <- ibm_lpue_rates_positive %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR == current_year) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
      .data$Gear, .data$Species, .data$id_grid,
      .data$lpue_raw, .data$lpue_multiplier,
      .data$calibration_available, .data$lpue,
      .data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis
    )

  observed_rates_year <- rates_year %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$effort_basis == "observed_monthly") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      source_lpue = .data$lpue,
      proxy_reference_effort = NA_real_,
      proxy_allocated_cell_kg = NA_real_
    )

  proxy_rates_year <- ibm_proxy_cell_allocation %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR == current_year) %>%
    dplyr::rename(production_MONTH = MONTH)

  prices_year <- ibm_price_for_join %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR == current_year)

  observed_ibm_year <- effort_year %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      observed_rates_year,
      by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      activity_MONTH = .data$MONTH,
      production_MONTH = .data$MONTH,
      proxy_effort_used = FALSE,
      proxy_observed_cell_effort = NA_real_,
      proxy_activity_share = NA_real_
    )

  proxy_ibm_year <- effort_year %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$effort > 0) %>%
    dplyr::rename(activity_MONTH = MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      proxy_rates_year,
      by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$YEAR, .data$production_MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
      .data$Species, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid,
      .data$allocation_source, .data$effort_basis
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      proxy_observed_cell_effort = sum(.data$effort),
      proxy_activity_share = .data$effort /
        .data$proxy_observed_cell_effort,

      lpue = .data$source_lpue *
        .data$proxy_reference_effort /
        .data$proxy_observed_cell_effort,
      MONTH = .data$production_MONTH,
      proxy_effort_used = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  ibm_year_parts[[year_index]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    observed_ibm_year,
    proxy_ibm_year
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prices_year,
      by = c("YEAR", "Species", "GSA"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      positive_target_lpue_available = TRUE,
      lpue_allocation_status = "positive_allocated_lpue",
      lpue_status = .data$lpue_allocation_status,
      price_available = !is.na(.data$Price),
      W = .data$effort * .data$lpue,

      GVL = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$W == 0 ~ 0,
        .data$price_available ~ .data$W * .data$Price,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )

  ibm_log(
    "[IBM 5/7] Year ",
    current_year,
    " assembled: ",
    nrow(ibm_year_parts[[year_index]]),
    " species-production rows."
  )

  rm(
    effort_year,
    rates_year,
    observed_rates_year,
    proxy_rates_year,
    observed_ibm_year,
    proxy_ibm_year,
    prices_year
  )
  invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
}

non_empty_year_parts <- vapply(ibm_year_parts, nrow, integer(1)) > 0L
if (!any(non_empty_year_parts)) {
  stop("IBM assembly produced no species-production rows.", call. = FALSE)
}

IBM <- data.table::rbindlist(
  ibm_year_parts[non_empty_year_parts],
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$production_MONTH,
    .data$activity_id, .data$Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    production_id = sprintf("PRD%012d", dplyr::row_number()),
    .before = 1
  )

rm(ibm_year_parts)
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

IBM_duplicate_activity_species <- IBM %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data$activity_id,
    .data$production_MONTH,
    .data$Species,
    .data$allocation_source,
    .data$effort_basis,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$n > 1L)

if (nrow(IBM_duplicate_activity_species) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "IBM is not unique by its activity-production-species allocation key. ",
    "Inspect 'IBM_duplicate_activity_species'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

IBM_proxy_allocation_check <- IBM %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$proxy_effort_used) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    proxy_reference_effort = one_numeric_value(
      .data$proxy_reference_effort,
      "proxy_reference_effort"
    ),
    proxy_observed_cell_effort = one_numeric_value(
      .data$proxy_observed_cell_effort,
      "proxy_observed_cell_effort"
    ),
    proxy_activity_share_sum = sum(.data$proxy_activity_share),
    upstream_cell_allocation_kg = one_numeric_value(
      .data$proxy_allocated_cell_kg,
      "proxy_allocated_cell_kg"
    ),
    IBM_cell_allocation_kg = sum(.data$W),
    .by = c(
      "YEAR", "production_MONTH", "GSA_code",
      "Species", "Gear", "id_grid",
      "allocation_source", "effort_basis"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    activity_share_error = .data$proxy_activity_share_sum - 1,
    cell_allocation_difference_kg = .data$IBM_cell_allocation_kg -
      .data$upstream_cell_allocation_kg
  )

maximum_proxy_share_error <- if (nrow(IBM_proxy_allocation_check) == 0L) {
  0
} else {
  max(abs(IBM_proxy_allocation_check$activity_share_error))
}
maximum_proxy_cell_allocation_error_kg <- if (
  nrow(IBM_proxy_allocation_check) == 0L
) {
  0
} else {
  max(abs(IBM_proxy_allocation_check$cell_allocation_difference_kg))
}
proxy_cell_tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * max(
  1,
  if (nrow(IBM_proxy_allocation_check) == 0L) {
    0
  } else {
    max(IBM_proxy_allocation_check$upstream_cell_allocation_kg)
  }
)

if (maximum_proxy_share_error > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) ||
    maximum_proxy_cell_allocation_error_kg > proxy_cell_tolerance) {
  stop(
    "Same-year proxy production is not conserved at grid-cell level. ",
    "Inspect 'IBM_proxy_allocation_check'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (any(!is.finite(IBM$effort)) ||
    any(IBM$effort < 0) ||
    any(!is.finite(IBM$lpue)) ||
    any(IBM$lpue <= 0) ||
    any(!is.finite(IBM$W)) ||
    any(IBM$W < 0) ||
    any(!is.finite(IBM$GVL[!is.na(IBM$GVL)])) ||
    any(IBM$GVL < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("IBM contains invalid effort, LPUE, W, GVL or GSA values.", call. = FALSE)
}

expected_W <- IBM$effort * IBM$lpue
maximum_W_arithmetic_error <- max(abs(IBM$W - expected_W))
W_tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * max(1, max(abs(expected_W)))

priced_rows <- IBM$price_available
expected_GVL <- IBM$W[priced_rows] * IBM$Price[priced_rows]
maximum_GVL_arithmetic_error <- if (length(expected_GVL) == 0L) {
  0
} else {
  max(abs(IBM$GVL[priced_rows] - expected_GVL))
}
GVL_tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * max(
  1,
  if (length(expected_GVL) == 0L) 0 else max(abs(expected_GVL))
)

if (maximum_W_arithmetic_error > W_tolerance ||
    maximum_GVL_arithmetic_error > GVL_tolerance) {
  stop(
    "W or GVL arithmetic validation failed. Inspect 'IBM_mass_check'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ibm_mass_from_rows <- IBM %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    IBM_W_kg = sum(.data$W),
    .by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear")
  )

ibm_non_vms_mass <- non_vms_spatial_allocation %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
    GSA_code = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$GSA_code))),
    Species = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Species))),
    Gear = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Gear))),
    non_vms_biological_removal_kg = as.numeric(.data$landings)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    non_vms_biological_removal_kg = sum(
      .data$non_vms_biological_removal_kg
    ),
    .by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear")
  )

ibm_mass_targets <- lpue_mass_balance %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
    MONTH = normalize_month_integer(.data$MONTH),
    GSA_code = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$GSA_code))),
    Species = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Species))),
    Gear = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Gear))),
    calibrated_target_kg = as.numeric(.data$calibrated_target_kg),
    allocated_kg = as.numeric(.data$allocated_kg),
    permitted_difference_kg = as.numeric(.data$permitted_difference_kg),
    allocation_source = trimws(as.character(.data$allocation_source)),
    effort_basis = trimws(as.character(.data$effort_basis))
  )

IBM_mass_reconciliation <- ibm_mass_targets %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    ibm_mass_from_rows,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    ibm_non_vms_mass,
    by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    IBM_activity_W_kg = dplyr::coalesce(.data$IBM_W_kg, 0),
    non_vms_biological_removal_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$non_vms_biological_removal_kg,
      0
    ),
    total_accounted_kg = .data$IBM_activity_W_kg +
      .data$non_vms_biological_removal_kg,
    difference_kg = .data$total_accounted_kg - .data$allocated_kg,
    IBM_tolerance_kg = .data$permitted_difference_kg +
      sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(1, abs(.data$allocated_kg)),
    IBM_mass_balance_ok = !is.na(.data$allocated_kg) &
      abs(.data$difference_kg) <= .data$IBM_tolerance_kg
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species, .data$Gear
  )

if (anyNA(IBM_mass_reconciliation$IBM_mass_balance_ok) ||
    any(!IBM_mass_reconciliation$IBM_mass_balance_ok)) {
  stop(
    "IBM plus the non-VMS ledger do not reproduce every allocated target. ",
    "Inspect 'IBM_mass_reconciliation'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

maximum_IBM_mass_balance_error_kg <- max(
  abs(IBM_mass_reconciliation$difference_kg)
)

IBM_mass_check <- tibble::tibble(
  diagnostic = c(
    "maximum_W_arithmetic_error",
    "W_tolerance",
    "maximum_GVL_arithmetic_error",
    "GVL_tolerance",
    "maximum_proxy_activity_share_error",
    "maximum_proxy_cell_allocation_error_kg",
    "non_vms_biological_removal_kg",
    "maximum_IBM_mass_balance_error_kg",
    "IBM_mass_balanced_strata"
  ),
  value = c(
    maximum_W_arithmetic_error,
    W_tolerance,
    maximum_GVL_arithmetic_error,
    GVL_tolerance,
    maximum_proxy_share_error,
    maximum_proxy_cell_allocation_error_kg,
    sum(ibm_non_vms_mass$non_vms_biological_removal_kg),
    maximum_IBM_mass_balance_error_kg,
    sum(IBM_mass_reconciliation$IBM_mass_balance_ok)
  )
)

IBM_production_summary <- IBM %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    production_kg = sum(.data$W),
    priced_production_kg = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(.data$price_available, .data$W, 0)
    ),
    unpriced_production_kg = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(!.data$price_available, .data$W, 0)
    ),
    GVL = if (all(.data$price_available[.data$W > 0])) {
      sum(.data$GVL)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Gear", "Species")
  )

IBM_non_vms_summary <- ibm_non_vms_mass %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    non_vms_biological_removal_kg = sum(
      .data$non_vms_biological_removal_kg
    ),
    .by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Gear", "Species")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$Species)

ibm_log("[IBM 6/7] IBM integrity and arithmetic checks completed.")

IBM_lpue_activity_coverage <- IBM_effort %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    activity_records = dplyr::n(),
    fishing_time_h = sum(.data$fishing_time),
    effort_m_h = sum(.data$effort),

IBM_lpue_support_coverage <- IBM_effort %>%

    .data$primary_model_status
  )

IBM_missing_prices <- IBM %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$W > 0, !.data$price_available) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

IBM_price_coverage_summary <- IBM %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    priced_production_kg = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(.data$price_available, .data$W, 0)

IBM_assembly_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c(
    "activity_records",
```

## Calculate vessel economics

```{r step1-42-set-ibm-2, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, fig.align="center"}

economic_workflow_version <- "2026-09-05.3"
required_ibm2eco_version <- "2026-08-15.1"

economic_log_file <- file.path(
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
  "SMART31_IBM2_progress.log"
)

economic_memory_mb <- function() {
  sum(gc(verbose = FALSE)[, 2])
}

economic_log <- function(...) {
  log_line <- paste0(
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    " | R memory: ",
    format(round(economic_memory_mb(), 1), nsmall = 1),
    " MB | ",
    paste0(..., collapse = "")
  )

  cat(log_line, "\n")
  cat(log_line, "\n", file = economic_log_file, append = TRUE)
  invisible(log_line)
}

economic_log(
  "[IBM2 0/6] Economic workflow started; version ",
  economic_workflow_version,
  "."
)

required_economic_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "tibble",
  "ggplot2",
  "ggrepel",
  "scales"
)

missing_economic_packages <- required_economic_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_economic_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    quietly = TRUE,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

if (length(missing_economic_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required packages: ",
    paste(missing_economic_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

required_economic_objects <- c(
  "IBM_effort",
  "IBM",
  "EcoRef",
  "CS_gsas",
  "sala_params",
  "df_harbs_grid_dists",
  "fuel_cost",
  "steaming_speed",
  "mNISEA",
  "fdiG",
  "fdi_other_value_reference",
  "economic_country_code",
  "fishing_time_elasticity_default",
  "steaming_to_fishing_fuel_ratio_default"
)

missing_economic_objects <- required_economic_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_economic_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    envir = .GlobalEnv,
    inherits = FALSE
  )
]

if (length(missing_economic_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing objects required by set IBM2: ",
    paste(missing_economic_objects, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

required_economic_functions <- c(
  "IBM2eco",
  "prepare_economic_rates",
  "assign_vessel_length_class",
  "mean_require_complete",
  "sum_require_complete"
)

missing_economic_functions <- required_economic_functions[
  !vapply(
    required_economic_functions,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    mode = "function",
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_economic_functions) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing economic functions: ",
    paste(missing_economic_functions, collapse = ", "),
    ". Source the current economic-function loader.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

loaded_ibm2eco_version <- attr(IBM2eco, "SMART31_version")

if (
  is.null(loaded_ibm2eco_version) ||
    !identical(loaded_ibm2eco_version, required_ibm2eco_version)
) {
  stop(
    "An obsolete IBM2eco() is loaded. Replace 'R/IBM2eco.R' with the ",
    "version supplied with this chunk and source it again. Required ",
    "SMART31 version: ",
    required_ibm2eco_version,
    "; loaded version: ",
    if (is.null(loaded_ibm2eco_version)) {
      "unspecified"
    } else {
      loaded_ibm2eco_version
    },
    ".",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

required_rate_arguments <- c(
  "target_groups",
  "gear_crosswalk",
  "vessel_length_crosswalk",
  "segment_crosswalk",
  "missing_segment_method"
)

missing_rate_arguments <- setdiff(
  required_rate_arguments,
  names(formals(prepare_economic_rates))
)

if (length(missing_rate_arguments) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "An obsolete prepare_economic_rates() is loaded. Missing arguments: ",
    paste(missing_rate_arguments, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

economic_log("[IBM2 1/6] Preflight completed.")

economic_target_groups <- IBM_effort %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Gear = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$Gear))),
    VL = as.character(assign_vessel_length_class(.data$loa))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

if (
  anyNA(economic_target_groups) ||
    any(!nzchar(economic_target_groups$Gear)) ||

  )

smart31_preview_table(
  economic_reference_gsa_coverage,
  "Geographical coverage of the economic reference data"
)
smart31_preview_table(
  economic_reference_summary,

invalid_activity_distance <- activity_gsa_monthly %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    missing_segment = is.na(.data$reference_VL),
    missing_distance_key = is.na(.data$distance_record_present),

    nonfinite_distance = !is.finite(.data$distance_km),
    negative_distance = is.finite(.data$distance_km) &
      .data$distance_km < 0,
    invalid_fishing_time = !is.finite(.data$fishing_time) |
      .data$fishing_time < 0,
    invalid_trip_information = !is.finite(.data$ntrip) |
      .data$ntrip < 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$missing_segment |
      .data$missing_distance_key |
      .data$nonfinite_distance |
      .data$negative_distance |
      .data$invalid_fishing_time |
      .data$invalid_trip_information
  )

if (nrow(invalid_activity_distance) > 0L) {
  invalid_activity_distance_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    issue = c(
      "missing_segment",
      "missing_distance_key",
      "nonfinite_distance",
      "negative_distance",
      "invalid_fishing_time",
      "invalid_trip_information",
      "total_invalid_activity_rows"
    ),
    activity_rows = c(
      sum(invalid_activity_distance$missing_segment),
      sum(invalid_activity_distance$missing_distance_key),
      sum(invalid_activity_distance$nonfinite_distance),
      sum(invalid_activity_distance$negative_distance),
      sum(invalid_activity_distance$invalid_fishing_time),
      sum(invalid_activity_distance$invalid_trip_information),
      nrow(invalid_activity_distance)
    )
  )

  distance_grid_support <- distance_lookup_economic %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(grid_present_in_lookup = TRUE)

  distance_harbour_support <- distance_lookup_economic %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$harbour) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(harbour_present_in_lookup = TRUE)

  invalid_activity_distance_keys <- invalid_activity_distance %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$missing_distance_key |
        .data$nonfinite_distance |
        .data$negative_distance
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      .data$id_grid,
      .data$harbour,
      .data$distance_km,
      .data$distance_record_present,
      name = "activity_rows"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      distance_grid_support,
      by = "id_grid",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      distance_harbour_support,
      by = "harbour",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      grid_present_in_lookup = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$grid_present_in_lookup,
        FALSE
      ),
      harbour_present_in_lookup = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$harbour_present_in_lookup,
        FALSE
      ),
      issue = dplyr::case_when(
        !.data$grid_present_in_lookup ~ "grid_absent_from_distance_lookup",
        !.data$harbour_present_in_lookup ~
          "harbour_absent_from_distance_lookup",
        is.na(.data$distance_record_present) ~
          "harbour_grid_pair_absent_from_distance_lookup",
        !is.finite(.data$distance_km) ~ "unreachable_harbour_grid_pair",
        .data$distance_km < 0 ~ "negative_distance",
        TRUE ~ "other_distance_issue"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$activity_rows))

  diagnostic_directory <- file.path(project_root, "Diagnostics")
  dir.create(
    diagnostic_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  diagnostic_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
  invalid_activity_summary_file <- file.path(
    diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_invalid_economic_activity_summary_",
      diagnostic_timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )
  invalid_activity_keys_file <- file.path(
    diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_invalid_economic_distance_keys_",
      diagnostic_timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    invalid_activity_distance_summary,
    invalid_activity_summary_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  utils::write.csv(
    invalid_activity_distance_keys,
    invalid_activity_keys_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  smart31_print_full_table(invalid_activity_distance_summary)

  stop(
    nrow(invalid_activity_distance),
    " economic activity rows failed validation. The issue-specific counts ",
    "are shown above. Diagnostic summary: ",
    invalid_activity_summary_file,
    "; distance keys: ",
    invalid_activity_keys_file,
    ". No distance was imputed because fuel use must remain based on the ",
    "water-constrained harbour-cell route.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

activity_gsa_monthly <- activity_gsa_monthly %>%
  dplyr::select(-.data$distance_record_present)

activity_gsa_monthly <- activity_gsa_monthly %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR,
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$MONTH,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$harbour,
    .data$GSA,
    .data$VL,
    .data$reference_VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    loa = one_numeric_value(.data$loa, "loa"),
    ntrip = one_numeric_value(.data$ntrip, "ntrip"),

    weighted_distance_km = {
      distance_values <- .data$distance_km
      fishing_time_weights <- .data$fishing_time

      if (sum(fishing_time_weights) > 0) {
        stats::weighted.mean(
          distance_values,
          fishing_time_weights
        )
      } else {
        mean(distance_values)
      }
    },
    fishing_time = sum_require_complete(.data$fishing_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR,
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$MONTH,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$harbour
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    monthly_fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
    n_gsa_month = dplyr::n(),
    gsa_activity_share = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$monthly_fishing_time > 0,
      .data$fishing_time / .data$monthly_fishing_time,
      1 / .data$n_gsa_month
    ),
    ntrip_allocated = .data$ntrip * .data$gsa_activity_share
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    steaming_time = 2 *
      (.data$weighted_distance_km / steaming_speed) *
      .data$ntrip_allocated,
    total_activity_hours = .data$fishing_time + .data$steaming_time
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_fishing_days %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH,
        .data$observed_fishing_days,
        .data$calendar_days_in_month
      ),
    by = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vessel_month_activity_hours = sum_require_complete(
      .data$total_activity_hours
    ),
    vessel_month_activity_share = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$vessel_month_activity_hours > 0,
      .data$total_activity_hours / .data$vessel_month_activity_hours,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

      .data$vessel_month_activity_share < 0
  )

      .data$total_activity_hours
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

reference_components_are_valid <- function(total, fishing, steaming) {
  tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(1, abs(total))

  is.finite(total) &
    total > 0 &
    total <= 24 &
    is.finite(fishing) &
    fishing >= 0 &
    is.finite(steaming) &
    steaming >= 0 &
    abs(total - fishing - steaming) <= tolerance
}

economic_time_reference_year_diagnostic <-
  activity_time_by_segment_year %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    fdi_days_by_segment_year,
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$FDI_days_at_sea > 0,
    .data$total_activity_hours > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    annual_hours_per_day =
      .data$total_activity_hours / .data$FDI_days_at_sea,
    annual_fishing_hours_per_day =
      .data$fishing_time / .data$FDI_days_at_sea,
    annual_steaming_hours_per_day =
      .data$steaming_time / .data$FDI_days_at_sea,
    annual_time_reference_valid = reference_components_are_valid(
      .data$annual_hours_per_day,
      .data$annual_fishing_hours_per_day,
      .data$annual_steaming_hours_per_day
    ),
    annual_time_reference_issue = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$annual_hours_per_day > 24 ~
        "VMS_activity_exceeds_24_hours_per_FDI_sea_day",
      !is.finite(.data$annual_hours_per_day) ~
        "nonfinite_hours_per_FDI_sea_day",
      .data$annual_hours_per_day <= 0 ~
        "nonpositive_hours_per_FDI_sea_day",
      !.data$annual_time_reference_valid ~
        "invalid_activity_component_or_decomposition",
      TRUE ~ "valid"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$annual_time_reference_valid,
    dplyr::desc(.data$annual_hours_per_day)
  )

invalid_annual_fdi_time_reference <-

  dplyr::filter(!.data$annual_time_reference_valid)

economic_log(

)

economic_time_reference <- activity_gsa_monthly %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$GSA, .data$Gear, .data$reference_VL) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_reference_exact,
    by = c("GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_reference_vl,
    by = c("Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_reference_gear,
    by = "Gear",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    invalid_exact_time_support,
    by = c("GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    reference_hours_per_day = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$reference_hours_per_day_exact,
      .data$reference_hours_per_day_vl,
      .data$reference_hours_per_day_gear
    ),
    reference_fishing_hours_per_day = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day_exact,
      .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day_vl,
      .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day_gear
    ),
    reference_steaming_hours_per_day = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day_exact,
      .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day_vl,
      .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day_gear
    ),
    time_reference_source = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_exact) ~
        "FDI_GSA_gear_VL",
      !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_vl) ~
        "FDI_pooled_GSA_gear_VL",
      !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_gear) ~
        "FDI_pooled_GSA_VL_gear",
      TRUE ~ "unavailable"
    ),
    time_reference_selection_reason = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_exact) ~
        "valid_annual_FDI_rows_at_exact_GSA_gear_VL_level",
      dplyr::coalesce(.data$n_invalid_reference_years_exact, 0L) > 0L &
        !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_vl) ~
        "invalid_exact_annual_FDI_ratio_use_pooled_gear_VL",
      !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_vl) ~
        "exact_FDI_reference_absent_use_pooled_gear_VL",
      !is.na(.data$reference_hours_per_day_gear) ~
        "exact_and_gear_VL_references_absent_use_pooled_gear",
      TRUE ~ "unavailable"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$GSA,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$reference_VL,
    .data$reference_hours_per_day,
    .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day,
    .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day,
    .data$time_reference_source,
    .data$time_reference_selection_reason,
    .data$n_invalid_reference_years_exact,
    .data$maximum_invalid_annual_hours_per_day,
    dplyr::starts_with("n_reference_years")
  )

economic_time_reference_validation <- economic_time_reference %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    decomposition_error_hours =
      .data$reference_hours_per_day -
      .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day -
      .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day,
    decomposition_tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$reference_hours_per_day)),
    missing_or_nonfinite_total =
      !is.finite(.data$reference_hours_per_day),
    nonpositive_total = is.finite(.data$reference_hours_per_day) &
      .data$reference_hours_per_day <= 0,
    exceeds_24_hours = is.finite(.data$reference_hours_per_day) &
      .data$reference_hours_per_day > 24,
    invalid_fishing_component =
      !is.finite(.data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day) |
      .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day < 0,
    invalid_steaming_component =
      !is.finite(.data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day) |
      .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day < 0,
    inconsistent_decomposition =
      !is.finite(.data$decomposition_error_hours) |
      abs(.data$decomposition_error_hours) >
      .data$decomposition_tolerance,
    valid_time_reference = !(
      .data$missing_or_nonfinite_total |
        .data$nonpositive_total |
        .data$exceeds_24_hours |
        .data$invalid_fishing_component |
        .data$invalid_steaming_component |
        .data$inconsistent_decomposition
    )
  )

invalid_economic_time_reference <-
  economic_time_reference_validation %>%
  dplyr::filter(!.data$valid_time_reference) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(.data$exceeds_24_hours),
    dplyr::desc(.data$reference_hours_per_day)
  )

if (nrow(invalid_economic_time_reference) > 0L) {
  diagnostic_directory <- file.path(project_root, "Diagnostics")
  dir.create(
    diagnostic_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  diagnostic_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
  invalid_time_reference_file <- file.path(
    diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_invalid_economic_time_reference_",
      diagnostic_timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )
  time_reference_year_file <- file.path(
    diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_economic_time_reference_by_year_",
      diagnostic_timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    invalid_economic_time_reference,
    invalid_time_reference_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  utils::write.csv(
    economic_time_reference_year_diagnostic,
    time_reference_year_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  smart31_print_full_table(invalid_economic_time_reference)

  stop(
    nrow(invalid_economic_time_reference),
    " FDI-derived activity-hour references are invalid. The table printed ",
    "above identifies the failed condition for every segment. Segment-level ",
    "diagnostic: ",
    invalid_time_reference_file,
    "; annual VMS-FDI components: ",
    time_reference_year_file,
    ". Values were not truncated or imputed.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

sala_activity_reference <- economic_time_reference

economic_activity_baseline <- activity_gsa_monthly %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    activity_time_by_segment_year %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$YEAR,
        .data$GSA,
        .data$Gear,
        .data$reference_VL,
        segment_activity_hours = .data$total_activity_hours
      ),
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fdi_days_by_segment_year,
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    economic_time_reference_year_diagnostic %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$YEAR,
        .data$GSA,
        .data$Gear,
        .data$reference_VL,
        .data$annual_time_reference_valid,
        .data$annual_time_reference_issue,
        .data$annual_hours_per_day
      ),
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    economic_time_reference,
    by = c("GSA", "Gear", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    use_annual_FDI_days = FALSE,
    days_at_sea = .data$observed_fishing_days *
      .data$vessel_month_activity_share,
    days_at_sea_source =
      "observed_unique_UTC_fishing_dates_allocated_by_activity_hours",
    trips_per_sea_day = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$days_at_sea > 0,
      .data$ntrip_allocated / .data$days_at_sea,
      0
    )
  )

economic_activity_baseline_validation <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    missing_or_invalid_time_reference =
      !is.finite(.data$reference_hours_per_day) |
      .data$reference_hours_per_day <= 0,
    invalid_total_activity_hours =
      !is.finite(.data$total_activity_hours) |
      .data$total_activity_hours < 0,
    invalid_observed_fishing_days =
      !is.finite(.data$observed_fishing_days) |
      .data$observed_fishing_days <= 0 |
      .data$observed_fishing_days > .data$calendar_days_in_month,
    invalid_vessel_month_activity_hours =
      !is.finite(.data$vessel_month_activity_hours) |
      .data$vessel_month_activity_hours <= 0,
    invalid_vessel_month_activity_share =
      !is.finite(.data$vessel_month_activity_share) |
      .data$vessel_month_activity_share < 0 |
      .data$vessel_month_activity_share > 1,
    invalid_allocated_trips =
      !is.finite(.data$ntrip_allocated) |
      .data$ntrip_allocated < 0,
    missing_or_nonfinite_days_at_sea =
      !is.finite(.data$days_at_sea),
    negative_days_at_sea =
      is.finite(.data$days_at_sea) &
      .data$days_at_sea < 0,
    missing_or_nonfinite_trip_rate =
      !is.finite(.data$trips_per_sea_day),
    negative_trip_rate =
      is.finite(.data$trips_per_sea_day) &
      .data$trips_per_sea_day < 0,
    positive_trips_with_zero_days =
      is.finite(.data$ntrip_allocated) &
      .data$ntrip_allocated > 0 &
      is.finite(.data$days_at_sea) &
      .data$days_at_sea == 0,
    valid_activity_day_record = !(
      .data$missing_or_invalid_time_reference |
        .data$invalid_total_activity_hours |
        .data$invalid_observed_fishing_days |
        .data$invalid_vessel_month_activity_hours |
        .data$invalid_vessel_month_activity_share |
        .data$invalid_allocated_trips |
        .data$missing_or_nonfinite_days_at_sea |
        .data$negative_days_at_sea |
        .data$missing_or_nonfinite_trip_rate |
        .data$negative_trip_rate |
        .data$positive_trips_with_zero_days
    )
  )

invalid_economic_activity_baseline <-
  economic_activity_baseline_validation %>%
  dplyr::filter(!.data$valid_activity_day_record)

if (nrow(invalid_economic_activity_baseline) > 0L) {
  invalid_economic_activity_summary <-
    invalid_economic_activity_baseline %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::all_of(c(
        "missing_or_invalid_time_reference",
        "invalid_total_activity_hours",
        "invalid_observed_fishing_days",
        "invalid_vessel_month_activity_hours",
        "invalid_vessel_month_activity_share",
        "invalid_allocated_trips",
        "missing_or_nonfinite_days_at_sea",
        "negative_days_at_sea",
        "missing_or_nonfinite_trip_rate",
        "negative_trip_rate",
        "positive_trips_with_zero_days"
      )),
      names_to = "issue",
      values_to = "is_issue"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$is_issue) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      .data$issue,
      .data$YEAR,
      .data$GSA,
      .data$Gear,
      .data$reference_VL,
      .data$days_at_sea_source,
      name = "n_vessel_month_GSA_rows"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_vessel_month_GSA_rows),
      .data$issue,
      .data$YEAR
    )

  diagnostic_directory <- file.path(project_root, "Diagnostics")
  dir.create(
    diagnostic_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  diagnostic_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
  invalid_activity_day_summary_file <- file.path(
    diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_invalid_activity_day_summary_",
      diagnostic_timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )
  invalid_activity_day_rows_file <- file.path(
    diagnostic_directory,
    paste0(
      "SMART31_invalid_activity_day_rows_",
      diagnostic_timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    invalid_economic_activity_summary,
    invalid_activity_day_summary_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  utils::write.csv(
    invalid_economic_activity_baseline,
    invalid_activity_day_rows_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  smart31_print_full_table(invalid_economic_activity_summary)

  stop(
    nrow(invalid_economic_activity_baseline),
    " vessel-month-GSA activity rows contain invalid days or trip rates. ",
    "The issue-specific summary is printed above. Summary file: ",
    invalid_activity_day_summary_file,
    "; row-level file: ",
    invalid_activity_day_rows_file,
    ". Values were not imputed or discarded.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

observed_day_reconciliation <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    allocated_days_at_sea = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    observed_fishing_days = one_numeric_value(
      .data$observed_fishing_days,
      "observed_fishing_days"
    ),
    difference =
      .data$allocated_days_at_sea - .data$observed_fishing_days,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$observed_fishing_days)),
    reconciled = abs(.data$difference) <= .data$tolerance
  )

if (anyNA(observed_day_reconciliation) ||
    any(!observed_day_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
  stop(
    "Allocated activity-component days do not reproduce the unique UTC ",
    "fishing dates of their vessel-month."
  )
}

fdi_day_coverage_diagnostic <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::group_by(

    .data$GSA,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$reference_VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    selected_vms_fishing_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    FDI_days_at_sea = if (all(is.na(.data$FDI_days_at_sea))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      one_numeric_value(
        .data$FDI_days_at_sea[!is.na(.data$FDI_days_at_sea)],
        "FDI_days_at_sea"
      )
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_to_FDI_day_ratio = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$FDI_days_at_sea) & .data$FDI_days_at_sea > 0,
      .data$selected_vms_fishing_days / .data$FDI_days_at_sea,
      NA_real_
    ),
    interpretation =
      "coverage diagnostic only; no equality constraint or scaling"
  )

  dplyr::group_by(

  )

missing_other_value_segments <- vessel_year_segment_days %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$GVL_other_reference_total)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Gear, .data$VL, .data$reference_VL)

if (nrow(missing_other_value_segments) > 0L) {

    "Inspect 'missing_other_value_segments'.",

vessel_other_gvl_reference <- vessel_year_segment_days %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$VL,
    .data$reference_VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    reference_days_at_sea = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    mean_days_at_sea = mean(.data$days_at_sea),
    n_baseline_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    GVL_other_reference_total = one_numeric_value(
      .data$GVL_other_reference_total,
      "GVL_other_reference_total"
    ),
    six_species_value_share = one_numeric_value(
      .data$six_species_value_share,
      "six_species_value_share"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Gear, .data$reference_VL) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    segment_reference_days = sum(.data$reference_days_at_sea),
    vessel_reference_day_share = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$segment_reference_days > 0,
      .data$reference_days_at_sea / .data$segment_reference_days,
      1 / dplyr::n()
    ),
    GVL_other_reference =
      .data$GVL_other_reference_total *
      .data$vessel_reference_day_share
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

fixed_other_gvl_segment_reconciliation <- vessel_other_gvl_reference %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Gear, .data$reference_VL) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    vessel_reference_sum = sum(.data$GVL_other_reference),
    FDI_reference_total = one_numeric_value(
      .data$GVL_other_reference_total,
      "GVL_other_reference_total"
    ),
    difference = .data$vessel_reference_sum - .data$FDI_reference_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$FDI_reference_total)),
    reconciled = abs(.data$difference) <= .data$tolerance
  )

if (any(!fixed_other_gvl_segment_reconciliation$reconciled)) {

    "The fixed vessel residual does not reproduce the FDI segment total."
  )
}

monthly_day_shares <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR,
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$MONTH,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$VL,
    .data$reference_VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    days_at_sea = sum_require_complete(.data$days_at_sea),
    .groups = "drop"

  dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$Gear) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    annual_days_at_sea = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    monthly_day_share = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$annual_days_at_sea > 0,
      .data$days_at_sea / .data$annual_days_at_sea,
      1 / dplyr::n()
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    vessel_other_gvl_reference,
    by = c("CFR", "Gear", "VL", "reference_VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    GVL_other_reference_month =
      .data$GVL_other_reference * .data$monthly_day_share
  )

other_gvl_reconciliation <- monthly_day_shares %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$Gear) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    monthly_sum = sum(.data$GVL_other_reference_month),
    vessel_reference = one_numeric_value(
      .data$GVL_other_reference,
      "GVL_other_reference"
    ),
    difference = .data$monthly_sum - .data$vessel_reference,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$vessel_reference)),
    reconciled = abs(.data$difference) <= .data$tolerance
  )

if (any(!other_gvl_reconciliation$reconciled)) {

steaming_to_fishing_fuel_ratio <- economic_target_groups %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    steaming_to_fishing_ratio = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Gear == "OTB",
      steaming_to_fishing_fuel_ratio_default,
      1
    ),
    ratio_source = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Gear == "OTB",
      "Sala_2022_OTB02_66.0_over_72.8",
      "neutral_ratio_no_activity_specific_reference"
    )
  )

fishing_time_elasticity <- economic_target_groups %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fishing_time_elasticity = fishing_time_elasticity_default,
    elasticity_source = "explicit_sensitivity_parameter"
  )

fuel_models_dynamic <- sala_params %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Gear = clean_code(.data$gear_code),
    loa_exponent = as.numeric(.data$loa_exponent),

    mean_fuel_coefficient_l_per_h = as.numeric(
      .data$fuel_coefficient
    )
  )

if (anyDuplicated(fuel_models_dynamic$Gear)) {
  stop("Sala fuel parameters are not unique by gear.", call. = FALSE)
}

economic_activity_baseline <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fuel_models_dynamic,
    by = "Gear",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    steaming_to_fishing_fuel_ratio,
    by = c("Gear", "VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fishing_time_elasticity,
    by = c("Gear", "VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sala_model_available =
      !is.na(.data$mean_fuel_coefficient_l_per_h) &
      !is.na(.data$loa_exponent),
    mean_fuel_l_per_h = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$sala_model_available,
      .data$mean_fuel_coefficient_l_per_h *
        .data$loa ^ .data$loa_exponent,
      NA_real_
    ),

    daily_fuel_l = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$sala_model_available,
      .data$mean_fuel_l_per_h * .data$reference_hours_per_day,
      NA_real_
    ),
    fuel_normalisation_hours =
      .data$reference_fishing_hours_per_day +
      .data$steaming_to_fishing_ratio *
        .data$reference_steaming_hours_per_day,
    fishing_fuel_l_per_h = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$sala_model_available &
        .data$fuel_normalisation_hours > 0,
      .data$daily_fuel_l / .data$fuel_normalisation_hours,
      NA_real_
    ),
    steaming_fuel_l_per_h =
      .data$steaming_to_fishing_ratio *
      .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h,
    physical_FC = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$sala_model_available,
      .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * .data$fishing_time +
        .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * .data$steaming_time,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

invalid_dynamic_fuel <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$Gear == "OTB",
    !.data$sala_model_available |
      !is.finite(.data$mean_fuel_l_per_h) |
      .data$mean_fuel_l_per_h <= 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$daily_fuel_l) |
      .data$daily_fuel_l <= 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h) |
      .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h <= 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h) |
      .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h <= 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$physical_FC) |
      .data$physical_FC < 0
  )

if (nrow(invalid_dynamic_fuel) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Invalid OTB activity-specific fuel rates were produced. Inspect ",
    "'invalid_dynamic_fuel'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

monthly <- economic_results_legacy$monthly %>%
  dplyr::rename(GVL_6sp = .data$GVL) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -.data$EC,
    -.data$OC,
    -.data$LC,
    -.data$GVA,
    -.data$GP,
    -.data$GPM,
    -.data$FC,
    -.data$equivalent_active_days,
    -.data$fuel_method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    monthly_dynamic_activity,
    by = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear", "harbour", "VL"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    monthly_day_shares %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$CFR,
        .data$YEAR,
        .data$MONTH,
        .data$Gear,
        .data$GVL_other_reference_month
      ),
    by = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    GVL_other_reference = .data$GVL_other_reference_month,
    GVL = .data$GVL_6sp + .data$GVL_other_reference,
    equivalent_active_days = .data$days_at_sea,
    FC = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$sala_model_available ~ .data$physical_FC,
      !.data$sala_model_available &
        .data$fuel_price_eur_per_l > 0 ~
        (.data$GVL * .data$EC_share) /
          .data$fuel_price_eur_per_l,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    EC = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$sala_model_available ~
        .data$FC * .data$fuel_price_eur_per_l,
      !.data$sala_model_available ~ .data$GVL * .data$EC_share,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    fuel_method = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$sala_model_available,
      "Sala_hourly_LOA_normalised_fishing_and_steaming",
      "reference_energy_share_on_total_GVL"
    ),
    OC = .data$GVL * .data$OC_share,
    LC = .data$GVL * .data$LC_share,
    GVA = .data$GVL - .data$EC - .data$OC,
    GP = .data$GVA - .data$LC,
    GPM = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$GVL > 0,
      .data$GP / .data$GVL,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.data$GVL_other_reference_month)

required_dynamic_monthly <- c(
  "days_at_sea",
  "GVL_6sp",
  "GVL_other_reference",
  "GVL",
  "FC",
  "EC",
  "OC",
  "LC",
  "GVA",
  "GP"
)

invalid_dynamic_monthly <- monthly %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::if_any(
      dplyr::all_of(required_dynamic_monthly),
      ~ !is.finite(.x)
    )
  )

if (nrow(invalid_dynamic_monthly) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(invalid_dynamic_monthly),
    " monthly economic records are incomplete after dynamic tuning. ",
    "Inspect 'invalid_dynamic_monthly'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

annual <- monthly %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR,
    .data$YEAR,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$harbour,
    .data$VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_active_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
    n_production_records = sum(.data$n_production_records),
    n_proxy_production_records = sum(.data$n_proxy_production_records),
    loa = one_numeric_value(.data$loa, "loa"),
    days_at_sea = sum_require_complete(.data$days_at_sea),
    fishing_time = sum_require_complete(.data$fishing_time_dynamic),
    steaming_time = sum_require_complete(.data$steaming_time_dynamic),
    FC = sum_require_complete(.data$FC),
    W = sum_require_complete(.data$W),
    annual_proxy_W = sum_require_complete(.data$annual_proxy_W),
    GVL_6sp = sum_require_complete(.data$GVL_6sp),
    GVL_other_reference = sum_require_complete(
      .data$GVL_other_reference
    ),
    GVL = sum_require_complete(.data$GVL),
    EC = sum_require_complete(.data$EC),
    OC = sum_require_complete(.data$OC),
    LC = sum_require_complete(.data$LC),
    GVA = sum_require_complete(.data$GVA),
    GP = sum_require_complete(.data$GP),
    INV_to_GVL = one_numeric_value(.data$INV_to_GVL, "INV_to_GVL"),
    reference_Gear = one_character_value(
      .data$reference_Gear,
      "reference_Gear"
    ),
    requested_reference_VL = one_character_value(
      .data$requested_reference_VL,
      "requested_reference_VL"
    ),
    reference_VL_used = one_character_value(
      .data$reference_VL_used,
      "reference_VL_used"
    ),
    economic_rate_source = one_character_value(
      .data$economic_rate_source,
      "economic_rate_source"
    ),
    minimum_lpue_effort_coverage = min(.data$lpue_effort_coverage),
    minimum_distance_effort_coverage = min(
      .data$distance_effort_coverage
    ),
    fuel_method = paste(sort(unique(.data$fuel_method)), collapse = "+"),
    fishing_time_elasticity = one_numeric_value(
      .data$fishing_time_elasticity,
      "fishing_time_elasticity"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    INV = .data$GVL * .data$INV_to_GVL,
    GPM = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$GVL > 0,
      .data$GP / .data$GVL,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

production_mass_reconciliation <- tibble::tibble(
  quantity = c("W_kg", "GVL_6sp_eur", "GVL_total_identity_eur"),
  production_input = c(
    sum_require_complete(as.numeric(IBM$W)),
    sum_require_complete(as.numeric(IBM$GVL)),
    sum_require_complete(monthly$GVL_6sp) +
      sum_require_complete(monthly$GVL_other_reference)
  ),
  monthly_economic_output = c(
    sum_require_complete(monthly$W),
    sum_require_complete(monthly$GVL_6sp),
    sum_require_complete(monthly$GVL)
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference = .data$monthly_economic_output - .data$production_input,
    tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$production_input)),
    reconciled = abs(.data$difference) <= .data$tolerance
  )

if (any(!production_mass_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
  stop("Dynamic economic mass/value reconciliation failed.")
}

accounting_check <- monthly %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    abs(.data$GVL -
      (.data$GVL_6sp + .data$GVL_other_reference)) >
      sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(1, abs(.data$GVL)) |
      abs(.data$GVA - (.data$GVL - .data$EC - .data$OC)) >
      sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(1, abs(.data$GVL)) |
      abs(.data$GP - (.data$GVA - .data$LC)) >
      sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(1, abs(.data$GVA))
  )

if (nrow(accounting_check) > 0L) {
  stop("Dynamic economic accounting identities are inconsistent.")
}

diagnostics <- economic_results_legacy$diagnostics
diagnostics$production_mass_reconciliation <-
  production_mass_reconciliation
diagnostics$observed_day_reconciliation <- observed_day_reconciliation
diagnostics$fdi_day_coverage <- fdi_day_coverage_diagnostic
diagnostics$economic_time_reference <- economic_time_reference
diagnostics$economic_time_reference_by_year <-
  economic_time_reference_year_diagnostic
diagnostics$invalid_annual_fdi_time_reference <-
  invalid_annual_fdi_time_reference
diagnostics$economic_activity_day_validation <-
  economic_activity_baseline_validation
diagnostics$days_at_sea_usage <- economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data$Gear,
    .data$VL,
    .data$days_at_sea_source,
    name = "n_vessel_month_GSA_records"
  )
diagnostics$other_gvl_reconciliation <- other_gvl_reconciliation
diagnostics$fixed_other_gvl_segment_reconciliation <-
  fixed_other_gvl_segment_reconciliation
diagnostics$fixed_other_gvl_by_vessel <- vessel_other_gvl_reference
diagnostics$fuel_method_usage <- monthly %>%
  dplyr::count(.data$Gear, .data$fuel_method, name = "n_vessel_months")
diagnostics$otb_fuel_rate_summary <- otb_fuel_rate_summary
diagnostics$annual_incomplete <- annual %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::if_any(
      dplyr::all_of(c(
        "days_at_sea", "steaming_time", "FC", "W", "GVL_6sp",
        "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC"
      )),
      ~ !is.finite(.x)
    )
  )

economic_scenario_parameters <- list(
  version = economic_workflow_version,
  effort_constraint = "fixed_days_at_sea",
  baseline_day_definition = "unique_UTC_fishing_dates_by_vessel_month",
  historical_harbour_definition = "one_canonical_harbour_per_vessel",
  future_harbour_definition = "one_canonical_harbour_per_vessel",
  maximum_clock_hours_per_sea_day = 24,
  invalid_annual_fdi_day_handling = paste0(
    "exclude_from_activity_time_calibration_then_use_",
    "GSA_gear_VL_to_gear_VL_to_gear_hierarchical_reference;_",
    "never_allocate_FDI_days_to_vessels"
  ),
  scenario_trip_definition =
    "fixed_days_at_sea_times_baseline_trips_per_sea_day",
  spatial_distance_definition =
    "effort_weighted_water_constrained_round_trip_distance",
  fishing_time_response =
    paste0(
      "positive_part_of_baseline_fishing_hours_minus_elasticity_",
      "times_steaming_change"
    ),
  fishing_time_elasticity = fishing_time_elasticity,
  fuel_parameter_interpretation =
    "q_times_LOA_power_m_is_mean_litres_per_active_hour",
  fuel_rate_normalisation = paste0(
    "activity_specific_rates_preserve_the_LOA_based_mean_hourly_rate_",
    "over_reference_fishing_and_steaming_hours"
  ),
  steaming_to_fishing_fuel_ratio =
    steaming_to_fishing_fuel_ratio,
  time_reference = economic_time_reference,
  vessel_other_gvl_reference = vessel_other_gvl_reference
)

economic_results <- list(
  monthly = monthly,
  annual = annual,
  diagnostics = diagnostics
)

rm(
  legacy_sala_activity_reference,
  economic_results_legacy,
  distance_lookup_economic,
  fuel_models_dynamic
)

IBM.eco <- economic_results$monthly
IBM.eco.annual <- economic_results$annual
IBM.eco.diagnostics <- economic_results$diagnostics

IBM_economic_mass_reconciliation <-
  IBM.eco.diagnostics$production_mass_reconciliation

IBM_proxy_month_alignment <-
  IBM.eco.diagnostics$proxy_month_alignment

IBM_economic_coverage_summary <- tibble::tribble(

  paste0(

  )
)

IBM.eco.agg <- IBM.eco.annual %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Gear) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c("GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")),
      mean_require_complete
    ),
    n_vessel_years = dplyr::n(),
    n_vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR),
    n_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(c("GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")),
    names_to = "SMART_indicator_code",
    values_to = "SMART"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gear_code = .data$Gear)

nisea_reference_prepared <- mNISEA %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    NISEA_indicator_code = toupper(
      trimws(as.character(.data$indicator_code))
    ),
    gear_code = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$gear_code))),
    NISEA = as.numeric(.data$reference_value),

    SMART_indicator_code = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$NISEA_indicator_code == "GVA",
      "GP",
      .data$NISEA_indicator_code
    )
  )

if (
  anyNA(nisea_reference_prepared) ||
    any(!is.finite(nisea_reference_prepared$NISEA)) ||
    anyDuplicated(
      nisea_reference_prepared[
        c("gear_code", "NISEA_indicator_code")
      ]
    )
) {
  stop(
    "mNISEA must contain complete finite values and be unique by ",
    "gear_code-indicator_code.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

df_eco_check <- nisea_reference_prepared %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    IBM.eco.agg,
    by = c("gear_code", "SMART_indicator_code"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    indicator_code = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$NISEA_indicator_code,
      .data$SMART_indicator_code
    ),
    comparison_status = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$NISEA) ~ "SMART_only",
      is.na(.data$SMART) ~ "NISEA_only",
      TRUE ~ "matched"
    ),
    rate = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$NISEA != 0,
      .data$SMART / .data$NISEA,
      NA_real_
    ),
    relative_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$NISEA != 0,
      (.data$SMART - .data$NISEA) / .data$NISEA,
      NA_real_
    ),
    label = paste(
      dplyr::if_else(
        .data$NISEA_indicator_code == "GVA",
        "NISEA GVA / SMART GP",
        .data$indicator_code
      ),
      .data$gear_code,
      sep = " - "
    )
  )

IBM_NISEA_coverage_summary <- df_eco_check %>%
  dplyr::count(.data$comparison_status, name = "n_indicators")

smart31_preview_table(

)

economic_comparison_data <- df_eco_check %>%

g_economic_comparison <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = economic_comparison_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$NISEA,
    y = .data$SMART,
    colour = .data$gear_code
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    ggplot2::aes(label = .data$label),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
    labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",", accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
    labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",", accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Mean annual economic indicators per active vessel-year",
    subtitle = paste(
      "The red line is equality; pseudo-log axes preserve zero and",
      "negative values. NISEA is a benchmark, not an independent validation."
    ),
    x = "NISEA reference (EUR)",
    y = "SMART estimate (EUR)",
    colour = "Gear"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_test(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(g_economic_comparison)

g_economic_relative_difference <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = economic_comparison_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$relative_difference)),

print(g_economic_relative_difference)

IBM2_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
```

```{r step1-44-plot-eco0, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=13, fig.align="center"}
required_economic_columns <- c(

economic_indicator_labels <- c(
```
