df_eco_monetary_long <- df_eco |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      names(economic_indicator_labels)
    ),
    names_to = "indicator_code",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$value)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    indicator = factor(
      unname(
        economic_indicator_labels[
          .data$indicator_code
        ]
      ),
      levels = unname(economic_indicator_labels)
    )
  )

economic_distribution_summary <-
  df_eco_monetary_long |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_vessel_years = dplyr::n(),
    minimum = min(.data$value),
    q05 = stats::quantile(
      .data$value,
      probs = 0.05,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    median = stats::median(.data$value),
    mean = mean(.data$value),
    q95 = stats::quantile(
      .data$value,
      probs = 0.95,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    maximum = max(.data$value),
    negative_values = sum(.data$value < 0),
    .by = c(
      indicator_code,
      indicator,
      Gear
    )
  )

g_economic_indicators <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  df_eco_monetary_long,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$value,
    fill = .data$Gear,
    colour = .data$Gear
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey45",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
    breaks = scales::breaks_extended(n = 4),
    labels = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.1,
      scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
    ),
    guide = ggplot2::guide_axis(
      check.overlap = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ indicator,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Distribution of annual economic indicators",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Values refer to active vessel-years;",
      "INV is estimated capital stock rather than an annual flow"
    ),
    x = "EUR per active vessel-year",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Gear",

  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_test(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

      size = 9
    ),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      size = 8,
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

print(g_economic_indicators)

## Save step1 simulation inputs

```{r step1-47-save-step1-simulation-inputs, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

simulation_bundle_version <- "2026-09-06.2"

save_heavy_effort_inputs <- FALSE

simulation_output_dir <- project_path(
  cfg$output_directory
)

if (!dir.exists(simulation_output_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    simulation_output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

knit_environment <- knitr::knit_global()

simulation_object_exists <- function(object_name) {
  exists(
    object_name,
    envir = knit_environment,
    inherits = TRUE
  )
}

simulation_get_object <- function(object_name) {
  get(
    object_name,
    envir = knit_environment,
    inherits = TRUE
  )
}

simulation_get_objects <- function(object_names) {
  stats::setNames(
    lapply(object_names, simulation_get_object),
    object_names
  )
}

simulation_assert_columns <- function(object_name, required_columns) {
  object_value <- simulation_get_object(object_name)

  if (!is.data.frame(object_value)) {
    stop(
      "Simulation export validation failed: '",
      object_name,
      "' is not a data frame.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(object_value))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Simulation export validation failed: '",
      object_name,
      "' is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

simulation_object_manifest <- function(object_list, object_group) {
  manifest_rows <- lapply(
    names(object_list),
    function(object_name) {
      object_value <- object_list[[object_name]]

      data.frame(
        object_group = object_group,
        object_name = object_name,
        object_class = paste(class(object_value), collapse = "/"),
        n_rows = if (is.data.frame(object_value)) {
          nrow(object_value)
        } else {
          NA_integer_
        },
        object_length = length(object_value),
        size_mb = round(
          as.numeric(utils::object.size(object_value)) / 1024^2,
          3
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(manifest_rows)
}

simulation_atomic_save_rds <- function(object_value, output_file) {
  temporary_file <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(basename(output_file), "_"),
    tmpdir = dirname(output_file),
    fileext = ".tmp"
  )

  on.exit(
    if (file.exists(temporary_file)) {
      unlink(temporary_file)
    },
    add = TRUE
  )

  saveRDS(
    object_value,
    file = temporary_file,
    compress = "gzip",
    version = 3
  )

  temporary_size <- file.info(temporary_file)$size

  if (
    !file.exists(temporary_file) ||
      is.na(temporary_size) ||
      temporary_size <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "The temporary simulation export file was not created correctly: ",
      temporary_file,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  publication_ok <- file.rename(temporary_file, output_file)

  if (!publication_ok) {
    publication_ok <- file.copy(
      temporary_file,
      output_file,
      overwrite = FALSE
    )
  }

  output_size <- file.info(output_file)$size

  if (
    !publication_ok ||
      !file.exists(output_file) ||
      is.na(output_size) ||
      output_size <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "Unable to publish simulation export file: ",
      output_file,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  rds_information <- tryCatch(
    base::infoRDS(output_file),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(rds_information, "error")) {
    stop(
      "The saved RDS header cannot be read: ",
      conditionMessage(rds_information),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(output_file)
}

non_vms_export_declared_kg <- sum(non_vms_landings_ledger$calibrated_kg)
non_vms_export_spatial_kg <- sum(non_vms_spatial_allocation$landings)
non_vms_export_tolerance_kg <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * max(
  1,
  non_vms_export_declared_kg
)

if (!is.finite(non_vms_export_declared_kg) ||
    !is.finite(non_vms_export_spatial_kg) ||
    abs(non_vms_export_spatial_kg - non_vms_export_declared_kg) >
      non_vms_export_tolerance_kg) {
  stop(
    "The non-VMS declared and spatial biological-removal ledgers disagree.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (isTRUE(run_age_module)) {
  age_export_check <- age_proportions |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$GSA_code,
      .data$Species,
      .data$id_grid
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      age_sum = sum(.data$age_proportion),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  invalid_age_profiles <- age_export_check |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.finite(.data$age_sum) |
        abs(.data$age_sum - 1) > 1e-8
    )

  if (nrow(invalid_age_profiles) > 0L) {
    stop(
      nrow(invalid_age_profiles),
      " invalid age-proportion profiles were detected before export.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (
  any(!is.finite(IBM$W)) ||
    any(IBM$W < 0) ||
    any(!is.finite(IBM$GVL[!is.na(IBM$GVL)])) ||
    any(IBM$GVL < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
) {
  stop(
    "'IBM' contains invalid production weights or landing values.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

missing_required_prices <- IBM |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$W > 0,
    is.na(.data$price_available) | !.data$price_available
  )

if (nrow(missing_required_prices) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(missing_required_prices),
    " positive-production records do not have an available price.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

invalid_production_gsa <- IBM |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$W > 0,
    is.na(.data$GSA_code) |
      !nzchar(as.character(.data$GSA_code)) |
      is.na(.data$GSA) |
      !nzchar(as.character(.data$GSA))
  )

if (nrow(invalid_production_gsa) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(invalid_production_gsa),
    " positive-production records do not have a valid GSA assignment.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (simulation_object_exists("IBM_mass_reconciliation")) {
  if (
    !"IBM_mass_balance_ok" %in% names(IBM_mass_reconciliation) ||
      anyNA(IBM_mass_reconciliation$IBM_mass_balance_ok) ||
      !all(IBM_mass_reconciliation$IBM_mass_balance_ok)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The IBM production mass reconciliation is not completely successful.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (simulation_object_exists("economic_blocking_diagnostics")) {
  simulation_assert_columns(
    "economic_blocking_diagnostics",
    c("diagnostic", "n_records")
  )

  if (any(economic_blocking_diagnostics$n_records > 0L)) {
    stop(
      "Economic blocking diagnostics remain unresolved.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

invalid_export_economics <- IBM.eco.annual |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.finite(.data$days_at_sea) |
      .data$days_at_sea < 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$GVL_6sp) |
      .data$GVL_6sp < 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$GVL_other_reference) |
      .data$GVL_other_reference < 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$GVL) |
      abs(
        .data$GVL -
          (.data$GVL_6sp + .data$GVL_other_reference)
      ) > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * pmax(1, abs(.data$GVL)) |
      !is.finite(.data$EC) |
      .data$EC < 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$OC) |
      .data$OC < 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$LC) |
      .data$LC < 0
  )

if (nrow(invalid_export_economics) > 0L) {
  stop(
    nrow(invalid_export_economics),
    " invalid annual economic records were detected before export.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (
  any(!is.finite(economic_time_reference$reference_hours_per_day)) ||
    any(economic_time_reference$reference_hours_per_day <= 0) ||
    any(economic_time_reference$reference_hours_per_day > 24) ||
    any(!is.finite(fishing_time_elasticity$fishing_time_elasticity)) ||
    any(fishing_time_elasticity$fishing_time_elasticity < 0) ||
    any(fishing_time_elasticity$fishing_time_elasticity > 1)
) {
  stop("Invalid economic time or elasticity parameters before export.")
}

invalid_otb_fuel_export <- economic_activity_baseline |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$Gear == "OTB",
    !is.finite(.data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h) |
      .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h <= 0 |
      !is.finite(.data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h) |
      .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h <= 0
  )

if (nrow(invalid_otb_fuel_export) > 0L) {
  stop("Invalid OTB activity-specific fuel rates before export.")
}

optional_simulation_objects <- c(
  "grid_gsa_outside_selected",
  "grid_gsa_coverage_summary",
  "grid_gsa_boundary_conflicts",
  "grid_gsa_conflict_resolution",
  "unresolved_grid_gsa_conflicts",
  "grid_gsa_missing_overlap_candidates",
  "grid_gsa_missing_overlap_resolution",
  "grid_gsa_missing_no_overlap",
  "grid_gsa_nearest_distance_candidates",
  "grid_gsa_nearest_assignment_audit",
  "grid_gsa_nearest_resolution",
  "grid_gsa_nearest_unresolved",
  "distance_navigation_summary",
  "distance_corner_bridge_diagnostics",
  "distance_short_gap_bridge_diagnostics",
  "distance_short_gap_candidate_diagnostics",
  "distance_cell_access_bridge_diagnostics",
  "distance_cell_access_candidate_diagnostics",
  "isolated_navigation_cell_effort_summary",
  "isolated_navigation_cell_effort_records",
  "isolated_navigation_cells_removed",
  "comparison_status_summary",
  "lpue_fallback_summary",
  "lpue_status_summary",
  "lpue_capping_summary",
  "lpue_threshold_diagnostics",
  "df_lpue_performance",
  "lpue_annual_proxy_strata",
  "lpue_relaxed_depth_proxy_strata",
  "lpue_non_vms_proxy_strata",
  "lpue_cell_diagnostics",
  "lpue_workflow_status",
  "age_profile_summary",
  "age_profile_source_summary",
  "age_proportion_check",
  "age_depth_models",
  "IBM_assembly_summary",
  "IBM_lpue_mass_balance_summary",
  "IBM_mass_reconciliation",
  "IBM_mass_check",
  "IBM_price_coverage_summary",
  "IBM_production_summary",
  "IBM_non_vms_summary",
  "IBM2_summary",
  "IBM_economic_coverage_summary",
  "IBM_economic_mass_reconciliation",
  "IBM_NISEA_coverage_summary",
  "observed_day_reconciliation",
  "fdi_day_coverage_diagnostic",
  "other_gvl_reconciliation",
  "fixed_other_gvl_segment_reconciliation",
  "missing_other_value_segments",
  "invalid_dynamic_fuel",
  "invalid_dynamic_monthly",
  "IBM.eco.diagnostics",
  "IBM.eco.agg",
  "df_eco_check"
)

available_optional_objects <- optional_simulation_objects[
  vapply(
    optional_simulation_objects,
    simulation_object_exists,
    logical(1)
  )
]

simulation_inputs <- simulation_get_objects(required_simulation_objects)
simulation_diagnostics <- simulation_get_objects(available_optional_objects)

simulation_manifest <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  simulation_object_manifest(
    simulation_inputs,
    "required_input"
  ),
  simulation_object_manifest(
    simulation_diagnostics,
    "diagnostic_or_supplementary"
  )
)

source_rmd <- tryCatch(
  knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
  error = function(e) NA_character_
)

if (
  length(source_rmd) != 1L ||
    is.na(source_rmd) ||
    !file.exists(source_rmd)
) {
  source_rmd_name <- NA_character_
  source_rmd_md5 <- NA_character_
} else {
  source_rmd_name <- basename(source_rmd)
  source_rmd_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(source_rmd))
}

version_information <- list(
  bundle_version = simulation_bundle_version,
  checkpoint_schema_version = if (
    simulation_object_exists("checkpoint_schema_version")
  ) {
    simulation_get_object("checkpoint_schema_version")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },
  lpue_version = attr(df_prod, "SMART31_mass_conserving_version"),
  ibm_version = attr(IBM, "SMART31_IBM_version"),
  economic_version = if (simulation_object_exists("economic_workflow_version")) {
    simulation_get_object("economic_workflow_version")
  } else if (simulation_object_exists("IBM2eco")) {
    attr(simulation_get_object("IBM2eco"), "SMART31_version")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
)

simulation_bundle <- list(
  metadata = list(
    bundle_type = "SMART3.1 Step 1 simulation inputs",
    bundle_version = simulation_bundle_version,
    created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
    run_id = run_id,
    run_configuration_hash = run_configuration_hash,
    source_rmd = source_rmd_name,
    workflow_schema="SMART31.generic.1", case_id=.smart31_case$case_id,
    workflow_fingerprint=smart31_code_fingerprint(),
    source_rmd_md5 = source_rmd_md5,
    versions = version_information,
    r_version = R.version.string,
    platform = R.version$platform,
    session_info = utils::sessionInfo()
  ),
  inputs = simulation_inputs,
  diagnostics = simulation_diagnostics,
  manifest = simulation_manifest
)

export_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

safe_run_id <- gsub(
  "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]",
  "_",
  as.character(run_id)
)

safe_bundle_version <- gsub(
  "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]",
  "_",
  simulation_bundle_version
)

simulation_file_stem <- paste0(
  "SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_",
  safe_run_id,
  "_v",
  safe_bundle_version,
  "_",
  export_timestamp
)

simulation_bundle_file <- file.path(
  simulation_output_dir,
  paste0(simulation_file_stem, ".rds")
)

simulation_atomic_save_rds(
  simulation_bundle,
  simulation_bundle_file
)

simulation_bundle_md5 <- unname(
  tools::md5sum(simulation_bundle_file)
)

heavy_effort_bundle_file <- NA_character_
heavy_effort_bundle_md5 <- NA_character_
heavy_effort_manifest <- NULL

if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
  required_heavy_effort_objects <- c(
    "effort_sf_gridded_list",
    "effort_gridded_list_wide"
  )

  missing_heavy_effort_objects <- required_heavy_effort_objects[
    !vapply(
      required_heavy_effort_objects,
      simulation_object_exists,
      logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_heavy_effort_objects) > 0L) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The detailed effort export was requested but objects are missing:\n - ",
        paste(missing_heavy_effort_objects, collapse = "\n - ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  heavy_effort_inputs <- simulation_get_objects(
    required_heavy_effort_objects
  )

  heavy_effort_manifest <- simulation_object_manifest(
    heavy_effort_inputs,
    "heavy_effort_input"
  )

  heavy_effort_bundle <- list(
    metadata = list(
      bundle_type = "SMART3.1 Step 1 detailed effort inputs",
      bundle_version = simulation_bundle_version,
      created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      run_id = run_id,
      run_configuration_hash = run_configuration_hash,
      principal_bundle = basename(simulation_bundle_file),
      principal_bundle_md5 = simulation_bundle_md5
    ),
    inputs = heavy_effort_inputs,
    manifest = heavy_effort_manifest
  )

  heavy_effort_bundle_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_dir,
    paste0(simulation_file_stem, "_heavy_effort.rds")
  )

  simulation_atomic_save_rds(
    heavy_effort_bundle,
    heavy_effort_bundle_file
  )

  heavy_effort_bundle_md5 <- unname(
    tools::md5sum(heavy_effort_bundle_file)
  )
}

complete_manifest <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  simulation_manifest,
  heavy_effort_manifest
)

manifest_file <- file.path(
  simulation_output_dir,
  paste0(simulation_file_stem, "_object_manifest.csv")
)

utils::write.csv(
  complete_manifest,
  manifest_file,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

export_file_summary <- data.frame(
  file_role = c(
    "principal_simulation_bundle",
    if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
      "detailed_effort_bundle"
    }
  ),
  file_name = c(
    basename(simulation_bundle_file),
    if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
      basename(heavy_effort_bundle_file)
    }
  ),
  size_mb = round(
    c(
      file.info(simulation_bundle_file)$size,
      if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
        file.info(heavy_effort_bundle_file)$size
      }
    ) / 1024^2,
    3
  ),
  md5 = c(
    simulation_bundle_md5,
    if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
      heavy_effort_bundle_md5
    }
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

checksum_file <- file.path(
  simulation_output_dir,
  paste0(simulation_file_stem, "_checksums.csv")
)

utils::write.csv(
  export_file_summary,
  checksum_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

latest_export_pointer <- list(
  created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
  run_id = run_id,
  run_configuration_hash = run_configuration_hash,
  bundle_version = simulation_bundle_version,
  simulation_bundle_file = basename(simulation_bundle_file),
  simulation_bundle_md5 = simulation_bundle_md5,
  heavy_effort_bundle_file = if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
    basename(heavy_effort_bundle_file)
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },
  heavy_effort_bundle_md5 = if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
    heavy_effort_bundle_md5
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },
  manifest_file = basename(manifest_file),
  checksum_file = basename(checksum_file)
)

latest_pointer_file <- file.path(
  simulation_output_dir,
  "SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_LATEST.rds"
)

temporary_latest_pointer <- tempfile(
  pattern = "SMART31_latest_",
  tmpdir = simulation_output_dir,
  fileext = ".tmp"
)

saveRDS(
  latest_export_pointer,
  temporary_latest_pointer,
  version = 3
)

if (file.exists(latest_pointer_file)) {
  unlink(latest_pointer_file)
}

if (!file.rename(temporary_latest_pointer, latest_pointer_file)) {
  stop(
    "Unable to publish the pointer to the latest simulation export.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

cat(
  "\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "STEP 1 SIMULATION EXPORT COMPLETED AND VERIFIED\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Run ID:             ", run_id, "\n",
  "Configuration hash: ", run_configuration_hash, "\n",
  "Bundle version:     ", simulation_bundle_version, "\n",
  "Required objects:   ", length(required_simulation_objects), "\n",
  "Optional objects:   ", length(available_optional_objects), "\n",
  "Principal bundle:   ", simulation_bundle_file, "\n",
  "Principal MD5:      ", simulation_bundle_md5, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (isTRUE(save_heavy_effort_inputs)) {
  cat(
    "Heavy effort file:  ", heavy_effort_bundle_file, "\n",
    "Heavy effort MD5:   ", heavy_effort_bundle_md5, "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cat(
  "Manifest:           ", manifest_file, "\n",
  "Checksums:          ", checksum_file, "\n",
  "Latest pointer:     ", latest_pointer_file, "\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

smart31_kable(
  export_file_summary,
  caption = paste(
    "Verified Step 1 files available to the simulation procedure"
  ),
  digits = 3
)
```
